Trigger.name: missing ring
Trigger.script:
local names = { "fire", "cold", "electric", "magic" } local resistances = { "fireresist", "coldresist", "electricresist", "magicresist" }
-- Lua uses 'for i = start, end, step' for i = 1, #names do -- Check if the active command matches the specific element in our array if pipeline.activeCommand == "activate " .. names[i] .. " resistance" then
local defName = resistances[i].."_resistance"
-- 1. Remove from the pending pipeline pipeline.defenses[defName] = nil pipeline.activeCommand = ""
-- 2. Disable the defense globally so we stop trying it if defenses[defName] then defenses[defName].enabled = false end
debugEcho("orange","[SYSTEM]: missing ring for " .. names[i] .. ". Moving to next defense.")
-- 3. Move to the next defense tryToDefup()
-- 'break' acts like a C break to exit the loop once found break end end

local affliction = string.gsub(matches[2], "%((%d+)%)","%1") local priority = tonumber(matches[3])
curinglist = curinglist or {}
-- Update curinglist with the manually set priority curinglist[affliction] = priority
-- 1. Safe Global Initialization (only runs if nil) prioBuffer = prioBuffer or {}
-- 2. Capture the current match data safely local aff = matches[2]:lower() -- 🛡️ CRITICAL: Keep lowercase for backend engine data matching! local prio = tonumber(matches[3]) or matches[3]
-- 3. Visual Formatting Variables local displayAff = aff:title() -- Title case purely for looks on the screen local displayName = displayAff:sub(1, 6) .. "..."
-- 4. Gag the individual raw incoming lines from hitting the main screen deleteFull()
-- 5. Add current formatted data to our display buffer table.insert(prioBuffer, string.format("<white>%s <DimGrey>(<goldenrod>%s<DimGrey>)", displayName, prio))
-- 6. Manage the auto-flushing countdown timer cleanly if prioCleanupTimer then killTimer(prioCleanupTimer) end
prioCleanupTimer = tempTimer(0.3, function() if #prioBuffer > 0 then local output = table.concat(prioBuffer, "<white>, ") cecho("\n<white>[<goldenrod>Prio Update<white>]: " .. output .. "\n") prioBuffer = {} -- Wipe the buffer cleanly for the next batch end end)
-- 7. 🛡️ BACKEND PROTECTION: Let the engine clear the lock and update curinglist natively onPriorityResetSent(aff, prio)
-- 8. Persistent Storage Save saveTableToJSON(curinglist, "curinglist")

Alias.name: server configs
Alias.script:
local key = matches[2]:lower() local value = matches[3]
-- 1. Numeric handling local numValue = tonumber(value) local finalValue = numValue or value
-- 2. Update the Local Table -- We keep the key lowercase for Lua consistency if matches[2] == "TELLSOFFMSG" or matches[2] == "RETURNMESSAGE" then if value ~= "NOTHING" or value ~= "nothing" then settings[key] = "set" end else settings[key] = finalValue end
-- 3. Direct Server Pass-Through -- We send exactly what was typed (as uppercase) to the game send("CONFIG " .. matches[2]:upper() .. " " .. value:upper())
-- 4. Global Maintenance saveTableToJSON(settings, "settings") menuServerSettings() -- Redraws the menu to flip the (+) and (-) colors
cecho("\n<SkyBlue>[SYSTEM]: <white>Server config <yellow>" .. key:upper() .. " <white>set to <yellow>" .. value:upper() .. "<white>.")

-- 4. Global Maintenance saveTableToJSON(settings, "settings") menuCuringSettings() -- Redraws the menu to flip the (+) and (-) colors

Alias.name: adv curing configs
Alias.script:
local key = matches[2]:upper() -- e.g., CURINGSET or KAIDOTRANSMUTE local fullValue = matches[3] -- e.g., "SWITCH set1" or "BELOW_HEALTH 95"
-- 1. Split the value into parts local parts = {} for word in string.gmatch(fullValue, "%S+") do table.insert(parts, word) end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- 🧩 1. SPECIAL CASE: CURINGSET LOGIC --------------------------------------------------------- if key == "CURINGSET" then local subCommand = (parts[1] or ""):upper() local targetName = (parts[2] or ""):lower() if subCommand == "NEW" and targetName ~= "" then if not table.contains(settings.curingsetList, targetName) then table.insert(settings.curingsetList, targetName) send("CURINGSET NEW " .. targetName) cecho("\n<SkyBlue>[SYSTEM]: <white>Created new curingset: <yellow>" .. targetName:upper()) else send("CURINGSET LIST") end elseif subCommand == "LIST" and targetName ~= "" then send("CURINGSET LIST") end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- 🔥 2. SPECIAL CASE: KAIDOTRANSMUTE LOGIC --------------------------------------------------------- elseif key == "KAIDOTRANSMUTE" then local subKey = (parts[1] or ""):upper() -- e.g., "BELOW_HEALTH" local rawVal = parts[2] or "" -- e.g., "95" local numVal = tonumber(rawVal)
-- Translate uppercase snake_case to your camelCase settings keys local settingsMapping = { ["BELOW_HEALTH"] = "kaidotransmutebelowhealth", ["ABOVE_MANA"] = "kaidotransmuteabovemana", ["MINIMUM"] = "kaidotransmuteminimum" }
local targetSettingField = settingsMapping[subKey]
if targetSettingField then -- Update your local settings state table accurately settings[targetSettingField] = numVal or rawVal
-- Send the exact syntax to the Achaea server: CURING KAIDOTRANSMUTE BELOW_HEALTH 95 send("CURING KAIDOTRANSMUTE " .. subKey .. " " .. rawVal) cecho(string.format("\n<SkyBlue>[SYSTEM]: <white>Updated %s to <yellow>%s", targetSettingField, rawVal)) else cecho("\n<red>[SYSTEM ERROR]: Invalid Kaido Transmute configuration key: " .. subKey) end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- 🧪 3. STANDARD CURING SETTINGS (MOSSHEALTH, etc.) --------------------------------------------------------- else local numValue = tonumber(fullValue) settings[key:lower()] = numValue or fullValue send("CURING " .. key .. " " .. fullValue:upper()) end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- 💾 MAINTENANCE & UI REDRAW --------------------------------------------------------- -- Ensure you use your centralized framework manager rather than naked functions if needed if jsonManager then saveTableToJSON(settings, "settings") end
-- Re-draw the menu to display your fresh configurations instantly menuAdvancedCuringSettings()

Script.name: methods
Script.script:
-- Utility function to check if a file exists function fileExists(name) local f = io.open(name, "r") if f then f:close() return true else return false end end
function table.deepcopy(orig) local orig_type = type(orig) local copy if orig_type == 'table' then copy = {} for orig_key, orig_value in next, orig, nil do copy[table.deepcopy(orig_key)] = table.deepcopy(orig_value) end setmetatable(copy, table.deepcopy(getmetatable(orig))) else copy = orig end return copy end
function parseElist(vialnum, vialtype, vialamount)
vialInventory = vialInventory or {}
vialInventory[tonumber(vialnum)] = { type = vialtype, sips = tonumber(vialamount) }
end
function ensureDirectoryExists(path) if not lfs.attributes(path, "mode") then lfs.mkdir(path) debugEcho("green","Created directory: " .. path .. "\n") end end
function ensureFileExists(directory, filename, mode, tableToUse) local fullPath = directory .. "/" .. filename
-- Ensure the directory exists if not lfs.attributes(directory, "mode") then lfs.mkdir(directory) debugEcho("green","Created directory: " .. directory .. "\n") end
-- Check if the file exists; if not, create it if not fileExists(fullPath) then local file = io.open(fullPath, "w") if file then file:close() debugEcho("green","Created new file: " .. fullPath .. "\n") if tableToUse then table.save(fullPath, tableToUse) end else debugEcho("red","Error: Could not create file: " .. fullPath .. "\n") return end end
-- Load or save the file depending on the mode if mode == "load" and tableToUse then table.load(fullPath, tableToUse) debugEcho("green","Loaded file: " .. fullPath .. "\n") elseif mode == "save" and tableToUse then table.save(fullPath, tableToUse)
debugEcho("green","Saved file: " .. fullPath .. "\n")
end end
function deepCopy(orig) if type(orig) ~= "table" then return orig end local copy = {} for key, value in pairs(orig) do copy[key] = deepCopy(value) end return copy end
function deepcopyaffstrack() tempafflist = {} for i in pairs(affstrack.score) do tempafflist[i] = affstrack.score[i] end end
function deeppasteaffstrack() for i in pairs(affstrack.score) do affstrack.score[i] = tempafflist[i] end end
function arraytest(testvar) cecho(testvar[1]) end
-- Function to find if a specific item exists in a list (with optional return index) function listfind(list, var, returnIndex) for i = 1, #list do if list[i] == var then return returnIndex and i or true end end return false end
function math.round(n) return math.floor(n + 0.5) end
function flattenTable(t) local result = {} for _, v in ipairs(t) do if type(v) == "table" then for _, nested in ipairs(v) do table.insert(result, nested) end else table.insert(result, v) end end return result end
--[[ safeFlatten(value) Ensures that the input value is returned as a flat list (array-style table), even if it's a single string, nil, or a nested table. This is useful for fields like `requires` or `blockers` that sometimes appear as: - a single string: "sleeping" - a flat table: { "sleeping", "paralysis" } - a nested table: { {"weariness", "recklessness"}, "sleeping" } - or nil ]] function safeFlatten(value) local result = {}
-- Case 1: If value is a table if type(value) == "table" then for _, v in ipairs(value) do -- If it's a nested table (e.g., {"a", "b"} inside the outer list) if type(v) == "table" then for _, nested in ipairs(v) do table.insert(result, nested) end else -- Flat value, insert as-is table.insert(result, v) end end
-- Case 2: If it's a string, number, etc. (non-table but not nil) elseif value ~= nil then table.insert(result, value)
-- Case 3: value is nil → result remains empty end
return result end
--local myList = {"apple", "banana", "cherry"} --local updatedList = listremove(myList, "banana")
-- Function to remove an item from a list function listremove(list, var) local newList = {} -- Create a new list to store items for i = 1, #list do if list[i] ~= var then -- If the item is not equal to the one we're removing, add it to newList table.insert(newList, list[i]) end end return newList -- Return the new list end
--numbers with commas function math.reint(i) return tostring(i):reverse():gsub("%d%d%d", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "") end
function tableLength(t) local count = 0 for _ in pairs(t) do count = count + 1 end return count end
function tableToString(tbl) if tbl == nil then return "" end local result = {} for k, v in pairs(tbl) do if type(v) == "table" then local subResult = {} for subK, subV in pairs(v) do table.insert(subResult, tostring(subK) .. ": " .. tostring(subV)) end table.insert(result, tostring(k) .. ": {" .. table.concat(subResult, ", ") .. "}") else table.insert(result, tostring(k) .. ": " .. tostring(v)) end end return "{" .. table.concat(result, ", ") .. "}" end
function printTable(t, indent) indent = indent or 0 for k, v in pairs(t) do if type(v) == "table" then print(string.rep(" ", indent) .. tostring(k) .. ":") printTable(v, indent + 1) else print(string.rep(" ", indent) .. tostring(k) .. ": " .. tostring(v)) end end end
function tablesEqual(t1, t2) if #t1 ~= #t2 then return false end local seen = {} for _, v in ipairs(t1) do seen[v] = true end for _, v in ipairs(t2) do if not seen[v] then return false end end return true end
function trimDecimal(num) -- Round the number to two decimal places local roundedNum = math.floor(num * 100 + 0.5) / 100 -- Format the number to a string with two decimal places return string.format("%.2f", roundedNum) end
-- Function to silence the output of tempTimer
function silentTempTimer(seconds, callback) local originalPrint = print -- Backup original print function print = function() end -- Override print function to do nothing tempTimer( seconds, function() print = originalPrint -- Restore original print function callback() end ) end
function deepcopy(orig) local orig_type = type(orig) local copy if orig_type == 'table' then copy = {} for orig_key, orig_value in next, orig, nil do copy[deepcopy(orig_key)] = deepcopy(orig_value) end setmetatable(copy, deepcopy(getmetatable(orig))) else -- number, string, boolean, etc copy = orig end return copy end
--BETTER RANDOM
function betterRand() randomtable = {} for i = 1, 97 do randomtable[i] = math.random() end local x = math.random() local i = 1 + math.floor(97 * x) x, randomtable[i] = randomtable[i], x return x end
-- Function to find the index of an element in a table
function findIndex(tbl, value) for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do if v == value then return i end end return nil end
-- Function to copy a table
function copyTable(orig) local copy = {} for key, value in pairs(orig) do copy[key] = value end return copy end
function toggleDebugMode() if settings.debug then settings.debug = false settings.debug = settings.debug cecho("\n<red>Debug mode has been turned off.") else settings.debug = true settings.debug = settings.debug cecho("\n<green>Debug mode has been turned on.") end end
function findkey(list, item, var) for v, k in pairs(list) do if v == item then return true end end return false end
function removeElement(tbl, value) for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do if v == value then table.remove(tbl, i) --return true end end --return false end
-- Utility function to check if any elements from subset are present in elements
function containsAny(elements, subset) for _, v in pairs(subset) do if table.contains(elements, v) then return true end end return false end
function get_aff_modifiers(cure_type) local keys = {} local aff_modifiers = balance_data[cure_type].aff_modifiers for k, v in pairs(aff_modifiers) do local entry = {affliction = k, multiplier = v.multiplier, offset = v.offset} table.insert(keys, entry) end return keys end
function myTimerEcho(dbug, balanceType, string, color) local nextline = "" local debug = dbug moveCursorEnd("main") if getCurrentLine() ~= "" then nextline = "\n" end if debug then cecho("" .. nextline .. "<" .. color .. ">" .. balance_data[balanceType].echo_title .. string) end end
function debugEcho(color, string) local nextline = "" local debug = settings.debug moveCursorEnd("main") if getCurrentLine() ~= "" then nextline = "\n" end if debug then cecho("" .. nextline .. "<" .. color .. ">" .. string) end end
function tryingtodo(what) -- Removing trailing semicolon local trimmedWhat = what:gsub(";$", "") -- Outputting the trimmed value cecho( "\n<LightBlue>CURES QUEUED: <DarkSlateGrey>(<LightBlue>" .. trimmedWhat .. "<DarkSlateGrey>)" ) end
function myEcho(color, string) local nextline = "" moveCursorEnd("main") if getCurrentLine() ~= "" then nextline = "\n" end cecho("" .. nextline .. "<" .. color .. ">" .. string) end
function myHEcho(string) local nextline = "" --local debug = settings.debug moveCursorEnd("main") if getCurrentLine() ~= "" then nextline = "\n" end --if debug then hecho(nextline .. string) --end end
-- Function to check if matches[2] is one of the desired words, case-insensitive
function checkWord(matches) -- Possible words to check local validWords = {"yes", "true", "on"} -- Generate all possible capitalizations for each word for _, word in ipairs(validWords) do local validCapitalizations = generateCapitalizations(word) -- Check if matches[2] matches any capitalization of the word for _, capitalization in ipairs(validCapitalizations) do if matches[2] == capitalization then return true end end end return false end
-- Function to generate all capitalization combinations of a word
function generateCapitalizations(word) local combinations = {}
local function generate(word, index) if index > #word then table.insert(combinations, word) return end -- Try both lowercase and uppercase for each letter generate( word:sub(1, index - 1) .. word:sub(index, index):lower() .. word:sub(index + 1), index + 1 ) generate( word:sub(1, index - 1) .. word:sub(index, index):upper() .. word:sub(index + 1), index + 1 ) end
generate(word, 1) return combinations end
function checkBooleanString(value) -- Convert the input value to uppercase for case-insensitive comparison value = string.upper(value) -- Check if the value matches any of the predefined true values if value == "YES" or value == "ON" or value == "TRUE" or value == "1" then return true else return false end end
function city_capture() for k, v in pairs(gmcp.Char.Status) do if k == "city" then if string.starts(v, "(None)") then return "None" end if string.starts(v, "Ashtan") then return "Ashtan" end if string.starts(v, "Eleusis") then return "Eleusis" end if string.starts(v, "Mhaldor") then return "Mhaldor" end if string.starts(v, "Hashan") then return "Hashan" end if string.starts(v, "Targossas") then return "Targossas" end if string.starts(v, "Cyrene") then return "Cyrene" end end end end
function inaparty() if not gmcp.Comm then return false end for _, v in ipairs(gmcp.Comm.Channel.List) do if v.name == "party" then return true end end return false end
function afflictionClassEnabled() local affliction_classes = {"apostate", "serpent", "shaman", "bard", "jester"} for _, v in pairs(affliction_classes) do if enemyclass[string.lower(v)].enabled then return true end end return false end
function channels() display(gmcp.Comm.Channel.List) end
keystolist = function(t) local r = {} for k, v in pairs(t) do r[#r + 1] = k end return r end
function listfind(list, var, vartwo) local re = false for i = 1, #list, 1 do if list[i] == var then re = true if vartwo then re = i end end end return re end
function flip(var) if var == true then return false else return true end end
function ts(var) if var < os.clock() then return true else return false end end
function highlightline(selectstring) selectString(selectstring, 1) setItalics(true) fg("red") resetFormat() deselect() end
function highlightline(selectstring, bgcolor, fgcolor, bold, italics) setBold(false) setItalics(true) bg(bgcolor) fg(fgcolor) resetFormat() deselect() end
function boxDisplay(msg, color) deselect() local colTbl = {}
if color then colTbl = string.split(color, ":") -- Handle potential empty strings from split for k = 1, 2 do if colTbl[k] == "" then colTbl[k] = nil end end if colTbl[2] then bg(colTbl[2]) end end
colTbl[1] = colTbl[1] or "red" fg(colTbl[1])
local mes = string.upper(msg) local leng = ((2 * string.len(mes)) + 11)
echo("\n ") echo(string.rep("-", leng + 2)) echo(" \n| " .. mes .. " | " .. mes .. " |\n ") echo(string.rep("-", leng + 2)) echo(" \n")
resetFormat() end
function loadMethods()
-- Reload the updated script (if srvQueue is defined in it) dofile(getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/methods.lua") -- Adjust the path as needed debugEcho("green","Methods File Loaded") end

Script.name: PLAYER
Script.script:
-- Define custom silver color if not already defined color_table.zsSilver = color_table.zsSilver or {160, 160, 160}
PLAYER = { gmcpData = { me = { name = "", prefix = "", suffix = "", fullname = "", race = "", racespec = "", fullrace = "", class = "", gender = "", level = 0, xp = 0, target = "", directory = { "name", "prefix", "suffix", "fullname", "race", "racespec", "fullrace", "class", "gender", "level", "xp", "target" } }, currency = { gold = 0, bgold = 0, tgold = 0, credits = 0, bcredits = 0, tcredits = 0, crowns = 0, bcrowns = 0, tcrowns = 0, lessons = 0, directory = { "gold", "bgold", "tgold", "credits", "bcredits", "tcredits", "crowns", "bcrowns", "tcrowns", "lessons" } }, room = { name = "", area = "", env = "", indoors = false, directory = {"name", "area", "env", "indoors"} }, comms = { channel = "", cname = "", text = "", speaker = "", decho = "", directory = {"channel", "cname", "text", "speaker", "decho"} }, players = { list = {}, revlist = {}, textlist = "", num = 0, directory = {"list", "revlist", "textlist", "num"}, }, time = { time = "", day = 0, month = "", mon = 0, year = 0, daystring = "0th", season = "", fullseason = "", shortseason = "", directory = {"time", "day", "month", "mon", "season", "fullseason", "shortseason", "year", "daystring"}, revdirectory = {}, }, directory = {"me", "stats", "currency", "room", "items", "players", "comms", "time"}, revdirectory = {}, },
}
function PLAYER:getResourceData(type) local map = { health = { cur = "hp", max = "maxhp" }, mana = { cur = "mp", max = "maxmp" }, willpower = { cur = "wp", max = "maxwp" }, endurance = { cur = "ep", max = "maxep" } }
local entry = map[type] if not entry then error("Unknown resource type: " .. tostring(type)) end
local cur = self.gmcpData[entry.cur] local max = self.gmcpData[entry.max]
if not cur or not max then cecho(string.format("<red>GMCP missing data for %s: cur=%s, max=%s\n", type, tostring(cur), tostring(max))) end
return { current = cur or 50, total = max or 50 } end
function PLAYER:manaData() return self:getResourceData("mana") end function PLAYER:healthData() return self:getResourceData("health") end function PLAYER:willpowerData() return self:getResourceData("willpower") end function PLAYER:enduranceData() return self:getResourceData("endurance") end
-- Time parser function PLAYER:parseTime(scope) local t = self.gmcpData.time local g = gmcp.IRE.Time[scope] local tonum = {day = true, mon = true, year = true} for k, v in pairs(g) do if t.revdirectory[k] then t[k] = tonum[k] and tonumber(v) or v end if k == "time" then local replace = { "It is ", "It's ", " in Achaea", "The sun has awakened from its long slumber. ", " has overtaken the light", "The sun sits at its apex. ", "The shadows have lengthened. ", "Darkness rules the land. " } for _, r in ipairs(replace) do t.time = t.time:gsub("(%w*)" .. r .. "(%w*)", "%1%2") end t.time = t.time:sub(1, -2):lower() end if k == "day" then local d = tonumber(v) local suffix = (d == 1 and "st") or (d == 2 and "nd") or (d == 3 and "rd") or "th" t.daystring = v .. suffix end if k == "mon" then t.shortseason = ({"mWi", "lWi", "eSp", "mSp", "lSp", "eSu", "mSu", "lSu", "eAu", "mAu", "lAu", "eWi"})[tonumber(v)] t.season = ({"mid winter", "late winter", "early spring", "mid spring", "late spring", "early summer", "mid summer", "late summer", "early autumn", "mid autumn", "late autumn", "early winter"})[tonumber(v)] t.fullseason = ({"winter", "winter", "spring", "spring", "spring", "summer", "summer", "summer", "autumn", "autumn", "autumn", "winter"})[tonumber(v)] end end raiseEvent("gmcpData.time") end
-- Directory utility helpers function PLAYER:getDirectoryIndex(name) return self.gmcpData.revdirectory[name] end
function PLAYER:listDirectory() return self.gmcpData.directory end
-- GMCP Event Handler function handleGMCPVitalsUpdate() if gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals then for k, v in pairs(gmcp.Char.Vitals) do local num = tonumber(v) PLAYER.gmcpData[k] = num or v end
-- Derived percentages PLAYER.gmcpData.php = math.floor((PLAYER.gmcpData.hp or 0) / (PLAYER.gmcpData.maxhp or 1) * 100) PLAYER.gmcpData.pmp = math.floor((PLAYER.gmcpData.mp or 0) / (PLAYER.gmcpData.maxmp or 1) * 100) PLAYER.gmcpData.pep = math.floor((PLAYER.gmcpData.ep or 0) / (PLAYER.gmcpData.maxep or 1) * 100) PLAYER.gmcpData.pwp = math.floor((PLAYER.gmcpData.wp or 0) / (PLAYER.gmcpData.maxwp or 1) * 100)
-- Booleans PLAYER.gmcpData.bal = gmcp.Char.Vitals.bal == "1" PLAYER.gmcpData.eq = gmcp.Char.Vitals.eq == "1"
-- XP and Rage parsing from charstats if gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats and gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats[2] then local rage = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats[2]:match("Rage:%s*(%d+)")) if rage then PLAYER.gmcpData.rage = rage end end
PLAYER.gmcpData.xp = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.nl) end end
-- Parse character info from gmcp.Char.Status function PLAYER:parseMeStatus() local g = gmcp.Char.Status local m = self.gmcpData.me local c = self.gmcpData.currency
if not g then return end
-- Me block m.name = g.name m.fullname = g.fullname m.prefix = g.fullname:match("^(.+)" .. g.name:gsub("([%%-%%.%%+%%[%]%%(%%)%%$%%^%%%%%%?%%*])", "%%%%%1")) or "" m.suffix = g.fullname:match(g.name:gsub("([%%-%%.%%+%%[%]%%(%%)%%$%%^%%%%%%?%%*])", "%%%%%1") .. "(.+)$") or ""
local isdragon = g.race:find("Dragon") ~= nil local havespec = g.specialisation ~= "" m.race = isdragon and "Dragon" or g.race m.racespec = isdragon and g.race:match("^(.+) Dragon") or g.specialisation m.fullrace = havespec and (m.race .. " " .. m.racespec) or g.race m.class = g.class m.gender = g.gender
local levelMatch = g.level:match("^(%d+)") local xpMatch = g.level:match("%%(([%d%.]+)%%%%%)") m.level = tonumber(levelMatch) or 0 m.xp = tonumber(xpMatch) or 0 m.target = g.target raiseEvent("gmcpData.me")
-- Currency block c.gold = tonumber(g.gold) c.bgold = tonumber(g.bank) c.tgold = c.gold + c.bgold c.credits = tonumber(g.unboundcredits) c.bcredits = tonumber(g.boundcredits) c.tcredits = c.credits + c.bcredits c.crowns = tonumber(g.mayancrowns) c.bcrowns = tonumber(g.boundmayancrowns) c.tcrowns = c.crowns + c.bcrowns c.lessons = tonumber(g.lessons) raiseEvent("gmcpData.currency") -- myDataOutput() end
-- Register the handler (Mudlet-specific) registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Vitals", "handleGMCPVitalsUpdate") registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Status", function() PLAYER:parseMeStatus() end) registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Room.Info", function() local g = gmcp.Room.Info local r = PLAYER.gmcpData.room
if not g then return end
r.name = g.name r.env = g.environment r.area = g.area r.indoors = g.name:sub(-9, -1) == "(indoors)"
raiseEvent("gmcpData.room") end)
registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Comm.Channel.Text", function() local g = gmcp.Comm.Channel.Text local list = {} local c = PLAYER.gmcpData.comms
local chan = g.channel if chan:sub(1, 4) == "tell" then chan = "tells" else for _, v in pairs(gmcp.Comm.Channel.List or {}) do list[v.name] = v.caption end chan = list[chan] or chan if chan:sub(1, 8) == "The Clan" then chan = chan:sub(13) end end
c.channel = chan c.cname = g.channel c.text = ansi2string(g.text) c.decho = ansi2decho(g.text) c.speaker = g.talker
raiseEvent("gmcpData.comms") end)
function PLAYER:myclass(extract) -- Guard clause to prevent errors if GMCP data hasn't arrived yet if not gmcp or not gmcp.Char or not gmcp.Char.Status then return "unknown" end
local class = gmcp.Char.Status.class or "" local race = gmcp.Char.Status.race or ""
-- If you explicitly request the unedited data, bypass all logic if extract == "raw" then return class end
-- 1. Force everything to lowercase right away for matching stability local cleanClass = class:lower() local cleanRace = race:lower()
-- 2. Master Check: Dragon Forms override normal classes if cleanRace:find("dragon") then return "dragon" end
-- 3. Consolidated Elemental Check: Strip away random server suffix variations if cleanClass:find("elemental") then if cleanClass:find("water") then return "water elemental" end if cleanClass:find("fire") then return "fire elemental" end if cleanClass:find("earth") then return "earth elemental" end if cleanClass:find("air") then return "air elemental" end end
-- 4. Default: Return standard class clean and lowercase (e.g., "serpent", "magi") return cleanClass end
function PLAYER:getAbilityType() local class = self.gmcpData.me.class:lower() local classTypeMap = { alchemist = "formulation", apostate = "apostasy", bard = "sagas", blademaster = "shindo", depthswalker = "terminus", druid = "reclamation", infernal = "malignity", jester = "puppetry", magi = "artificing", monk = "telepathy", occultist = "domination", paladin = "valour", pariah = "charnel", priest = "zeal", psion = "emulation", runewarden = "discipline", sentinel = "skirmishing", serpent = "hypnosis", shaman = "vodun", sylvan = "weatherweaving", unnamable = "dominion" } return classTypeMap[class] or "unknown" end
function PLAYER:getAbilityCommand(abilityName) local class = self.gmcpData.me.class:lower() local abilityMap = { shroud = { serpent = "conjure cloak", occultist = "shroud" }, relax = { serpent = "dispel me", occultist = "unshroud" } } return abilityMap[abilityName] and abilityMap[abilityName][class] or nil end
-- Initialize reverse directory for k, v in ipairs(PLAYER.gmcpData.time.directory) do PLAYER.gmcpData.time.revdirectory[v] = true end
for k, v in ipairs(PLAYER.gmcpData.directory) do PLAYER.gmcpData.revdirectory[v] = k end
registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.IRE.Time.List", function() PLAYER:parseTime("List") end) registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.IRE.Time.Update", function() PLAYER:parseTime("Update") end)

Script.name: json
Script.script:
--[[ Fully recoverable, auto-backup-capable JSON persistence system with Deep Key Union Engine for update safe delivery. ]]
function fetchDKJSON() local libsDir = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/"
--------------------------------------------------------- -- 📦 DKJSON LIBRARY LOADER --------------------------------------------------------- if not dkjson then local dkjsonPath = libsDir .. "dkjson.lua"
if fileExists(dkjsonPath) then return dofile(dkjsonPath) else debugEcho("red","CRITICAL: dkjson.lua missing from " .. libsDir) return {} end end end
dkjson = dkjson or fetchDKJSON()
-- Helper function to deeply copy a table (decouples from global memory tracking) local function deepCopyTable(orig) local orig_type = type(orig) local copy if orig_type == 'table' then copy = {} for orig_key, orig_value in pairs(orig) do if type(orig_value) == 'table' then copy[orig_key] = deepCopyTable(orig_value) else copy[orig_key] = orig_value end end else copy = orig end return copy end
-- Helper function to deeply union missing system keys into saved user data structures local function deepKeyUnion(userData, systemDefaults) if type(systemDefaults) ~= "table" then return userData end if type(userData) ~= "table" then userData = {} end
for key, value in pairs(systemDefaults) do if userData[key] == nil then -- The user completely lacks this new feature or structure from the update. Graft it in! if type(value) == "table" then userData[key] = deepCopyTable(value) else userData[key] = value end elseif type(value) == "table" and type(userData[key]) == "table" then -- If both contain a sub-table, recursively union their keys down the tree deepKeyUnion(userData[key], value) end end return userData end
-- Helper function to safely resolve nested global variables from string keys local function getGlobalValue(targetStr) local parts = string.split(targetStr, ".") local current = _G for _, part in ipairs(parts) do if type(current) ~= "table" then return nil end current = current[part] end return current end
-- Helper function to safely write nested global variables from string keys local function setGlobalValue(targetStr, val) local parts = string.split(targetStr, ".") local current = _G for i = 1, #parts - 1 do local part = parts[i] if current[part] == nil or type(current[part]) ~= "table" then current[part] = {} end current = current[part] end current[parts[#parts]] = val end
-- Load data from JSON function loadTableFromJSON(tblRef, filename) if not dkjson then debugEcho("red","Cannot load: dkjson not loaded.") return end
local path = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/json/" .. filename .. ".json"
if not fileExists(path) then debugEcho("red","No file found for '" .. filename .. "' to load.") return end
local file = io.open(path, "r") if not file then debugEcho("red","Failed to open file for '" .. filename .. "'.") return end
local contents = file:read("*a") file:close()
local decoded, _, err = dkjson.decode(contents, 1, nil) if err or type(decoded) ~= "table" then debugEcho("red","Error decoding " .. filename .. ": " .. (err or "invalid format")) return end
-- Clear existing table and update it in place for k in pairs(tblRef) do tblRef[k] = nil end for k, v in pairs(decoded) do tblRef[k] = v end
debugEcho("green",string.format("Loaded data from '%s.json'.", filename)) end
-- Save data to JSON with directory verification function saveTableToJSON(tbl, filename, directory) if not dkjson then debugEcho("red","Cannot save: dkjson not loaded.") return end
if not tbl or type(tbl) ~= "table" then debugEcho("red","Invalid table passed to save.") return end
local baseDir = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System" local subDirs = {"/system", "/system/libs", "/system/libs/json"}
local currentPath = baseDir for _, sub in ipairs(subDirs) do if not lfs.attributes(currentPath, "mode") then lfs.mkdir(currentPath) end currentPath = getMudletHomeDir() .. sub end
directory = directory or (getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/json/") local path = string.format("%s/%s.json", directory, filename)
local file, err = io.open(path, "w") if not file then debugEcho("red","Error saving " .. filename .. ": " .. (err or "unknown error")) return end
local ok, jsonString = pcall(dkjson.encode, tbl, { indent = true }) if not ok then debugEcho("red","Error encoding JSON for " .. filename) file:close() return end
file:write(jsonString) file:close()
debugEcho("green",string.format("<green>Saved '%s' to %s", filename, path)) end
function jsonBackup() if not dkjson then debugEcho("red","Cannot create backups: dkjson not loaded.") return end
local cutoffSeconds = BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS * 24 * 60 * 60 local now = os.time()
local backupDir = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/backup" local timestamp = os.date("%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")
if not lfs.attributes(backupDir, "mode") then lfs.mkdir(backupDir) end
local filesToBackup = { {name = "settings", table = settings}, {name = "lustlist", table = lustlist}, {name = "enemylist", table = enemylist}, {name = "allylist", table = allylist}, {name = "cityallylist", table = NDB and NDB.cityList or {}}, {name = "cityenemylist", table = NDB and NDB.cityEnemies or {}}, {name = "huntmasterlist", table = targetMasterList}, {name = "areaignorelist", table = areaIgnoreList}, {name = "huntsettings", table = huntSettingsData}, {name = "battlerage", table = bragelist}, {name = "balance_data", table = balance_data}, {name = "curinglist", table = curinglist}, {name = "defenses", table = defenses}, {name = "afflictions", table = afflictions}, }
for _, file in ipairs(filesToBackup) do local path = string.format("%s/%s_backup_%s.json", backupDir, file.name, timestamp) local success, result = pcall(dkjson.encode, file.table, { indent = true })
if success then local f = io.open(path, "w") if f then f:write(result) f:close() end debugEcho("green",string.format("🔁 Backup created: %s\n", path)) else debugEcho("red",string.format("<red>⚠️ Error encoding %s: %s\n", file.name, result)) end end
for file in lfs.dir(backupDir) do if file:match("_backup_.*%.json$") then local fullPath = backupDir .. "/" .. file local attr = lfs.attributes(fullPath) if attr and (now - attr.modification > cutoffSeconds) then os.remove(fullPath) cecho(string.format("<yellow>🗑️ Deleted old backup: %s\n", file)) end end end end
function loadJsonWithBackup(primaryPath, label) local function decodeJsonFile(path) local f = io.open(path, "r") if not f then return nil, "File not found" end local contents = f:read("*a") f:close() return dkjson.decode(contents, 1, nil) end
local decoded, _, err = decodeJsonFile(primaryPath) if not err and type(decoded) == "table" then debugEcho("green",string.format("<green>Loaded %s from JSON.", label)) return decoded end
debugEcho("yellow","[WARN] Failed to load %s. Trying backup...", label)
local bakPath = primaryPath .. ".bak" local bakDecoded, _, bakErr = decodeJsonFile(bakPath) if not bakErr and type(bakDecoded) == "table" then local jsonString = dkjson.encode(bakDecoded, { indent = true }) local out = io.open(primaryPath, "w") if out then out:write(jsonString) out:close() cecho(string.format("<green>[RECOVERY] Restored %s from backup.\n", label)) end return bakDecoded else cecho(string.format("<red>[FAILURE] Could not load %s or its backup.\n", label)) local crossPlatformBackupDir = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/backup" cecho(string.format("<yellow>Try restoring %s manually from:\n<white>%s\n", label, crossPlatformBackupDir)) end
return nil end
-- MAIN JSON FUNCTION (Supports Safe Read, Deep Reports, and Secure Pointer Writes) function jsonManager(opts) opts = opts or {} local safe = opts.safe local diff = opts.diff local path = opts.path local fallback = opts.fallback
local writeMode = opts.write local writeData = opts.data
local libsDir = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/" local jsonDir = libsDir .. "json/"
--------------------------------------------------------- -- ACTION BLOCK: SECURE WRITE MODE --------------------------------------------------------- if writeMode and path and writeData then local f = io.open(path, "w") if f then f:write(dkjson.encode(writeData, { indent = true })) f:close()
local bakPath = path .. ".bak" local bFile = io.open(bakPath, "w") if bFile then bFile:write(dkjson.encode(writeData, { indent = true })) bFile:close() end return true else debugEcho("red", "JSON Save Failure: Direct file pointer access denied for path: " .. path) return false end end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- ACTION BLOCK: SAFE READ MODE --------------------------------------------------------- if safe and path and fallback then if not fileExists(path) then debugEcho("yellow","JSON not found, creating empty: " .. path) local f = io.open(path, "w") if f then f:write(dkjson.encode(fallback or {}, { indent = true })) f:close() end return fallback or {} end
local file = io.open(path, "r") local contents = file and file:read("*a") if file then file:close() end
local decoded, _, err = dkjson.decode(contents or "", 1, nil) if decoded and type(decoded) == "table" then return decoded end
debugEcho("red",string.format("Corrupted JSON: %s → %s\n", path, err or "unknown"))
local bakPath = path .. ".bak" if fileExists(bakPath) then local bFile = io.open(bakPath, "r") local bContents = bFile and bFile:read("*a") if bFile then bFile:close() end local bDecoded = dkjson.decode(bContents or "", 1, nil) if bDecoded and type(bDecoded) == "table" then debugEcho("green","✔ Loaded backup from .bak file\n") return bDecoded end end
local name = path:match("([^/\\]+)%.json$") local backupDirs = { libsDir .. "backup" } local latestBackup, latestTime = nil, 0 for _, dir in ipairs(backupDirs) do if lfs.attributes(dir, "mode") == "directory" then for file in lfs.dir(dir) do if file:match("^" .. name .. "_backup_.*%.json$") then local fullPath = dir .. "/" .. file local attr = lfs.attributes(fullPath) if attr and attr.modification > latestTime then latestTime = attr.modification latestBackup = fullPath end end end end end
if latestBackup then local f = io.open(latestBackup, "r") local contents = f and f:read("*a") if f then f:close() end local decoded = dkjson.decode(contents or "", 1, nil) if decoded and type(decoded) == "table" then debugEcho("green","✔ Loaded latest backup: " .. latestBackup) return decoded end end
local archivedDir = libsDir .. "archived" local suggestedZip = nil if lfs.attributes(archivedDir, "mode") == "directory" then for file in lfs.dir(archivedDir) do if file:match("%.zip$") and file:find(name) then suggestedZip = file end end end
if suggestedZip then debugEcho("green",string.format("<magenta>📦 Suggest restoring from archive:\n<white> archived/%s\n", suggestedZip)) else debugEcho("red",string.format("🚫 No restorable data or archive found for '%s'.\n", name)) end
os.rename(path, path .. ".corrupt") cecho("<yellow>🚨 JSON corrupted. Renamed and replaced with empty.\n") local f = io.open(path, "w") if f then f:write(dkjson.encode(fallback or {}, { indent = true })) f:close() end return fallback or {} end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- ACTION BLOCK: STANDARD REPORT MODE --------------------------------------------------------- local LAST_LOADED = {} local files = { {name = "settings", ref = settings}, {name = "lustlist", ref = lustlist}, {name = "enemylist", ref = enemylist}, {name = "allylist", ref = allylist}, {name = "cityallylist", ref = NDB and NDB.cityList or {}}, {name = "cityenemylist", ref = NDB and NDB.cityEnemies or {}}, {name = "huntmasterlist", ref = targetMasterList}, {name = "areaignorelist", ref = areaIgnoreList}, {name = "huntsettings", ref = huntSettingsData}, {name = "battlerage", ref = bragelist}, {name = "balance_data", ref = balance_data}, {name = "curinglist", ref = curinglist}, {name = "defenses", ref = defenses}, {name = "afflictions", ref = afflictions}, }
cecho("\n<white>" .. (diff and "📦 JSON Table Report + Diff" or "🔍 JSON Table Report") .. ":\n")
for _, file in ipairs(files) do local name, ref = file.name, file.ref local path = string.format("%s/%s.json", jsonDir, name) local liveSize = (type(ref) == "table") and table.size(ref) or 0 local exists, jsonSize = fileExists(path), "N/A"
if exists then local f = io.open(path, "r") local contents = f and f:read("*a") if f then f:close() end local decoded = dkjson.decode(contents or "", 1, nil) jsonSize = (type(decoded) == "table") and table.size(decoded) or 0 end
local match = (tonumber(jsonSize) == liveSize) local color = exists and (match and "<green>" or "<yellow>") or "<red>" local label = exists and (match and "✔ Match" or "✘ Diff") or "❌ Missing"
if diff then LAST_LOADED[name] = os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") cecho(string.format(" - %-20s <white>[json: %4s] %s%s\n", name .. ".json", jsonSize, color, label)) else cecho(string.format(" - %-20s <white>Live: %-4s JSON: %-4s %s%s\n", name, liveSize, jsonSize, color, label)) end end end
-- Main load function (Updated with Deep Key Union Data Protection) function loadAllTablesFromJSON() if not dkjson then debugEcho("red", "Cannot load JSON: dkjson not loaded.") return end
local jsonDir = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/json/"
-- Mapping names to actual table references local fileMap = { settings = settings, lustlist = lustlist, enemylist = enemylist, allylist = allylist, huntmasterlist = targetMasterList, areaignorelist = areaIgnoreList, huntsettings = huntSettingsData, battlerage = bragelist, balance_data = balance_data, curinglist = curinglist, defenses = defenses, afflictions = afflictions, }
-- 1. Load standard tables for filename, tableRef in pairs(fileMap) do local path = string.format("%s/%s.json", jsonDir, filename) local savedData = jsonManager({ safe = true, path = path, fallback = {} })
if type(savedData) == "table" and next(savedData) then local unionedData = deepKeyUnion(savedData, tableRef) -- Clear and re-fill the table safely for k in pairs(tableRef) do tableRef[k] = nil end for k, v in pairs(unionedData) do tableRef[k] = v end debugEcho("green", "<green>✔ Loaded & Unioned " .. filename) end end
-- 2. Handle NDB specifically (since they are nested) local ndbFiles = { {name = "cityallylist", target = "cityList"}, {name = "cityenemylist", target = "cityEnemies"} }
for _, file in ipairs(ndbFiles) do local path = string.format("%s/%s.json", jsonDir, file.name) local savedData = jsonManager({ safe = true, path = path, fallback = {} })
if type(savedData) == "table" and next(savedData) then NDB[file.target] = savedData for _, name in ipairs(savedData) do NDB_Acquire(name) end debugEcho("green", "<green>✔ Loaded NDB: " .. file.name) end end end
-- Main save function function saveAllTablesAsJSON() if not dkjson then cecho("<red>Cannot save JSON: dkjson not loaded.\n") return end
local jsonDir = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/json/"
local filesToConvert = { {name = "settings", table = settings}, {name = "lustlist", table = lustlist}, {name = "enemylist", table = enemylist}, {name = "allylist", table = allylist}, {name = "cityallylist", table = NDB and NDB.cityList or {}}, {name = "cityenemylist", table = NDB and NDB.cityEnemies or {}}, {name = "huntmasterlist", table = targetMasterList}, {name = "areaignorelist", table = areaIgnoreList}, {name = "huntsettings", table = huntSettingsData}, {name = "battlerage", table = bragelist}, {name = "balance_data", table = balance_data}, {name = "curinglist", table = curinglist}, {name = "defenses", table = defenses}, {name = "afflictions", table = afflictions}, }
for _, file in ipairs(filesToConvert) do local jsonPath = string.format("%s/%s.json", jsonDir, file.name) local success, result = pcall(dkjson.encode, file.table, { indent = true })
if not success then cecho(string.format("<red>Error encoding %s to JSON: %s\n", file.name, result)) else if fileExists(jsonPath) then local bakPath = jsonPath .. ".bak" local oldFile = io.open(jsonPath, "r") if oldFile then local oldContents = oldFile:read("*a") oldFile:close() local bakFile = io.open(bakPath, "w") if bakFile then bakFile:write(oldContents) bakFile:close() debugEcho("yellow","↩ Created .bak: " .. bakPath) end end end
local f, err = io.open(jsonPath, "w") if f then f:write(result) f:close() debugEcho("green","Saved JSON: " .. jsonPath) else debugEcho("green",string.format("<red>Failed to write %s.json: %s", file.name, err or "unknown error")) end end end
if not SAVE_ALREADY_BACKED_UP then jsonBackup() SAVE_ALREADY_BACKED_UP = true end end
function simulateArchiveOldBackups() local backupDir = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/backup" local archiveDir = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/archived" local now = os.time() local cutoffSeconds = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 -- 30 days
cecho("<cyan>🔍 Simulating archive of backups older than 30 days...\n")
for file in lfs.dir(backupDir) do if file:match("_backup_.*%.json$") then local fullPath = backupDir .. "/" .. file local attr = lfs.attributes(fullPath) if attr then local age = now - attr.modification if age > cutoffSeconds then local daysOld = math.floor(age / (24 * 60 * 60)) local datePart = file:match("_(%d%d%d%d%-%d%d%-%d%d)_") local archiveName = datePart and (archiveDir .. "/" .. datePart .. ".zip") or "unknown"
cecho(string.format(" <yellow>Would archive: <white>%s\n", file)) cecho(string.format(" Age: %d days\n", daysOld)) cecho(string.format(" Target ZIP: %s\n", archiveName)) end end end end
cecho("<cyan>✅ Simulation complete.\n") end

-- ============================================================================= -- VERSION CONTROL & UTILITY FUNCTIONS -- =============================================================================
function getLocalVersion() local versionPath = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/config.lua" local version = "unknown" if not lfs.attributes(versionPath) then return version end
for line in io.lines(versionPath) do local v = line:match('version%s*=%s*%[%[(.-)%]%]') if v then version = v break end end return version end
function incrementLocalVersion() local versionPath = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/config.lua" local lines = {} local found = false
if not lfs.attributes(versionPath) then cecho("<red>🚫 config.lua not found at " .. versionPath .. "\n") return false end
for line in io.lines(versionPath) do -- We look for three sets of digits separated by dots. -- Example match: 2.0.120 local major, minor, patch = line:match("(%d+)%.(%d+)%.(%d+)")
if major then major, minor, patch = tonumber(major), tonumber(minor), tonumber(patch) patch = patch + 1
-- We rebuild the string without the "v_" and without padding zeros. -- This format (X.X.X) is exactly what MPKG expects. local newVString = string.format("%d.%d.%d", major, minor, patch)
-- Replace the old version string in the line with the new one local newLine = line:gsub("%d+%.%d+%.%d+", newVString)
table.insert(lines, newLine) found = true else table.insert(lines, line) end end
if not found then cecho("<red>🚫 Version line (X.X.X) not found in config.lua\n") return false end
local f = io.open(versionPath, "w") if f then for _, l in ipairs(lines) do f:write(l .. "\n") end f:close() cecho("<green>🔄 Version incremented to standard format in config.lua.\n") return true end return false end
function isNewerVersion(remote, localVersion) local function parseVersion(v) -- If v is nil or not a string, match will error. We add a check. if not v or type(v) ~= "string" then return 0, 0, 0 end
-- Clean numeric match: 1.2.3 local major, minor, patch = v:match("(%d+)%.(%d+)%.(%d+)")
-- Return numbers if found, otherwise return 0s so the comparison doesn't break return tonumber(major) or 0, tonumber(minor) or 0, tonumber(patch) or 0 end
local rMaj, rMin, rPat = parseVersion(remote) local lMaj, lMin, lPat = parseVersion(localVersion)
-- Comparison logic (this part is perfect as you had it) if rMaj ~= lMaj then return rMaj > lMaj end if rMin ~= lMin then return rMin > lMin end return rPat > lPat end
function gitUpdateCheck() local gitDir = [[C:\Users\JS\Documents\Mudlet-Git\Achaean System]] cecho("------------------------------------------------------------------------------") cecho("\n<yellow>🛡️ GIT EXPORT PRE-FLIGHT CHECK\n") cecho("\n<white>1. Go to <cyan>Toolbox > Package Exporter <white> in Mudlet.") cecho("\n<white>2. <cyan>** <white>remember to increment version in exporter. <cyan>**") cecho("\n<white>3. Unzip and copy <green>'Achaean System.xml'<white> to your Git directory.") echo("\n\n")
-- Option 1: Proceed if done cechoLink("<green>[ YES: I have copied the XML ]", function() exportToGitAsync() end, "Run the full Git Push now", true)
echo(" ") -- Spacing between links
-- Option 2: Open folder if not done cechoLink("<red>[ NO: Open Git Folder ]", function() openUrl("file:///" .. gitDir:gsub("\\", "/")) end, "Open folder to copy XML", true) cecho("\n-----------------------------------------------------------------------------") send("") end
-- ============================================================================= -- THE "MODERN" ASYNC UPDATE SYSTEM (IMPORT) -- =============================================================================
function checkForAsyncUpdate() cecho("<yellow>🔍 Checking remote version...\n") -- The URL we send local url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/caevora/core/main/Achaean%20System/config.lua" -- The "Expected" URL with spaces for matching local expectedUrl = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/caevora/core/main/Achaean System/config.lua"
registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysGetHttpDone", function(_, rurl, body) -- Normalize the returning URL by converting %20 back to spaces for comparison local normalizedUrl = rurl:gsub("%%20", " ")
if normalizedUrl ~= expectedUrl then return end
local remoteVersion = body:match('version%s*=%s*%[%[(.-)%]%]') local localVersion = getLocalVersion()
cecho(string.format("<white> [Debug] Local: %s | Remote: %s\n", localVersion, remoteVersion))
if remoteVersion and isNewerVersion(remoteVersion, localVersion) then cecho(string.format("<yellow>🆕 Update Available: <red>%s<reset> -> <green>%s<reset>\n", localVersion, remoteVersion)) cechoLink("<cyan>[ Click to Update Now ]\n", function() updateFromGitAsync(remoteVersion) end, "Install " .. remoteVersion, true) else cecho("<green>✅ System is up to date.\n") end end, true)
getHTTP(url) end

-- Create the unique backup path string local backupFolderName = "Backup Achaean System " .. os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H-%M-%S") local backupDir = mudletDir .. "/" .. backupFolderName local packageUrl = "https://github.com/caevora/core/releases/download/" .. version .. "/Achaean.System.mpackage"
--------------------------------------------------------- -- 💾 STEP 0: WRITE THE TRACKING FILE FIRST (Maximum Stability) --------------------------------------------------------- local trackFile = mudletDir .. "/update_migration_path.txt" local f = io.open(trackFile, "w") if f then f:write(backupDir) f:close() cecho("<yellow>💾 Migration path locked to disk...\n") else cecho("<red>🚫 CRITICAL ERROR: Could not write tracking file!\n") end

PHYSICAL RENAME (Step 1) --------------------------------------------------------- cecho("<yellow>📂 Renaming local folder to backup...\n") collectgarbage() local winTarget = targetDir:gsub("/", "\\") local winBackup = backupDir:gsub("/", "\\") local cmd = string.format([[powershell -Command "Rename-Item -Path '%s' -NewName '%s' -Force"]], winTarget, winBackup) os.execute(cmd)

local mudletDir = getMudletHomeDir() local trackFile = mudletDir .. "/update_migration_path.txt"

Folder not found at: " .. sourceLibsDir .. "\n") -- Left os.remove(trackFile) commented out so the file stays put for you to see! return end
cecho("\n<SkyBlue>📦 [MIGRATOR]: <white>Fresh package detected. Synchronizing complete /libs tree...\n")
-- Format paths safely for Windows PowerShell execution local winSource = sourceLibsDir:gsub("/", "\\") local winTarget = targetLibsDir:gsub("/", "\\")

os.execute(cmd)
cecho("<green>✅ [MIGRATOR]: Complete /libs directory (including json, ndb, and backups) successfully restored!\n")
-- Clean up the tracking text file ONLY after a successful copy operation os.remove(trackFile)

Script.name: prompt
Script.script:
function prompt() -- 1. Immediate Exit Conditions if table.contains(myaffs, "blackout") then return end if not settings.systemLoaded then return end if not settings.promptEnabled then return end
local promptstring = ""
-- 2. Line-Start Status Overlays if settings.systemPaused then moveCursor(0, getLineNumber()) cinsertText("<red>[P] ") moveCursorEnd() end
if settings and settings.defupmode then moveCursor(0, getLineNumber()) cinsertText("<red>[DEFMODE] ") moveCursorEnd() end
-- 3. Calculate Vitals Differentials (All 4 Stats) local currentHP = tonumber(vitals.health.current) or 0 local prevHP = tonumber(vitals.health.previous) or currentHP local currentMP = tonumber(vitals.mana.current) or 0 local prevMP = tonumber(vitals.mana.previous) or currentMP local currentEP = tonumber(vitals.ep.current) or 0 local prevEP = tonumber(vitals.ep.previous) or currentEP local currentWP = tonumber(vitals.wp.current) or 0 local prevWP = tonumber(vitals.wp.previous) or currentWP
local hpDiff = currentHP - prevHP local mpDiff = currentMP - prevMP local epDiff = currentEP - prevEP local wpDiff = currentWP - prevWP
-- 4. Status & Environment if settings.showSelfishness then local sl_color = (defenses.selfishness and defenses.selfishness.keepup) and "<green>" or "<red>" promptstring = promptstring .. sl_color .. " SL<white> " end
if settings.showTargetClass then local cur_target = target or "none" local prompt_target = NDB_getClass(cur_target):lower() promptstring = promptstring .. "<white>Class:[<orange>" .. prompt_target:lower() .. "<white>] " end
if settings.showMonolithSigils then if table.contains(inv_room, "a monolith sigil") then promptstring = promptstring .. "<purple>MONO<white> " end end
if settings.showLightWall then if table.contains(inv_room, "a lightwall") then promptstring = promptstring .. "<yellow>LW<white> " end end
-- 5. Vitals Flux (Single Unified Client-Calculated Toggle) if settings.showVitalsFlux then if hpDiff ~= 0 then promptstring = promptstring .. (hpDiff > 0 and "<green>+" or "<red>") .. hpDiff .. "h " end if mpDiff ~= 0 then promptstring = promptstring .. (mpDiff > 0 and "<cyan>+" or "<red>") .. mpDiff .. "m " end if epDiff ~= 0 then promptstring = promptstring .. (epDiff > 0 and "<yellow>+" or "<red>") .. epDiff .. "e " end if wpDiff ~= 0 then promptstring = promptstring .. (wpDiff > 0 and "<magenta>+" or "<red>") .. wpDiff .. "w " end end
-- 6. Class-Specific Resources if settings.showClassStats then local myClass = gmcp.Char.Status.class local classMap = { ["Occultist"] = { label = "Karma", key = "Karma" }, ["Apostate"] = { label = "Essence", key = "Essence" }, ["Paladin"] = { label = "Wrath", key = "Wrath" }, ["Monk"] = { label = "Kai", key = "Kai" }, ["Serpent"] = { label = "Venom", key = "Venom" }, ["Unnamable"] = { label = "Karma", key = "Karma" }, ["Priest"] = { label = "Conv", key = "conviction" }, ["Blademaster"]= { label = "Shin", key = "Shin" } }
local config = classMap[myClass] if config then local val = getCharStat(config.key) promptstring = promptstring .. string.format("<white>[<ansi_yellow>%s:<white>%s] ", config.label, val) end end
-- 7. Hitcount (LimbTracker) if settings.showHitCount then promptstring = promptstring .. "<white>|" .. LimbTrackerGetColor("head") .. LimbTracker.data["head"] .. "<white>|" .. LimbTrackerGetColor("torso") .. LimbTracker.data["torso"] .. "<white>|" .. LimbTrackerGetColor("left leg") .. LimbTracker.data["left leg"] .. "<white>|" .. LimbTrackerGetColor("right leg") .. LimbTracker.data["right leg"] .. "<white>|" .. LimbTrackerGetColor("left arm") .. LimbTracker.data["left arm"] .. "<white>|" .. LimbTrackerGetColor("right arm") .. LimbTracker.data["right arm"] .. "<white>| " end
-- ⛵ 8. CLICKABLE EXITS APPENDED LAST if settings.showExits and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info.exits then cecho(" <ansi_yellow>[") for dir, _ in pairs(gmcp.Room.Info.exits) do cechoLink("<white>" .. dir:upper(), function() send("go " .. dir) end, "Click to go " .. dir, true) cecho("<DimGrey>|") end cecho("<ansi_yellow>]") end
-- 🟢 9. RENDER BUILT BASE STRING FIRST -- This appends your custom trackers perfectly along the original server text frame cecho(promptstring)
-- 10. Affliction list debug tracking if settings.debug then afflictionlist() end end

function afflictionlist()

-- 1. Prepend the total count if we have afflictions if totalAffs > 0 then affstring = "<white>[<red>" .. totalAffs .. "<white>] " end
-- 2. Build the string from your master database -- We use your new table structure: data.prompt for aff_key, data in pairs(afflictions) do if table.contains(myaffs, aff_key) then affstring = affstring .. (data.prompt or aff_key) .. " " end end
-- 3. Add special checks (Bleeding, etc.) -- Append the live bleeding counter string prefix local bleed = bleedcheckprompt() if bleed ~= "" then affstring = bleed .. " " .. affstring end
-- 4. Handle the "Clean" state if totalAffs == 0 and bleed == "" then affstring = "<white> - " end
-- 5. GUI Update clearWindow("affwindow.middle") GUI.affwindow.middle:cecho(affstring)
-- Debugging debugEcho("yellow","[DEBUG] Total Affs: " .. totalAffs)
end

Script.name: fetchGameFeed
Script.script:
-- Helper function to format the date and adjust for the timezone
function formatEventTime(eventTime) -- Parse the original event time: "2024-12-07 22:39:08" local year, month, day, hour, min, sec = eventTime:match("(%d+)-(%d+)-(%d+) (%d+):(%d+):(%d+)") -- Convert the hour to number for math operations hour = tonumber(hour) -- Add 5 hours to the time (adjust for the time difference) hour = (hour + 4) % 24 -- Wrap the hour back around if it exceeds 24 -- Map the numeric month to the abbreviated month name local months = {"Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"} local monthName = months[tonumber(month)] -- Convert the time from 24-hour to 12-hour format local hour12 = hour % 12 if hour12 == 0 then hour12 = 12 end -- Special case for midnight -- Format the new time string: "Dec-07 2:39" return string.format("%s-%02d %d:%02d", monthName, tonumber(day), hour12, tonumber(min)) end
-- Event handler triggered when the HTTP request is successfully completed
function sysGetHttpDoneHandler(event, url, response) if url:match("https://api.achaea.com/gamefeed.json") then -- Safe parse block local debug = io.open(getMudletHomeDir().."/last_feed_response.json", "w") debug:write(response or "nil") debug:close()
response = response and response:match("^(.-)%s*$") or "" if not response:match("[%}%]]$") then cecho("<red>[SYS ERROR] Incomplete or malformed JSON from gamefeed — see last_feed_response.json\n") return end
local ok, data = pcall(yajl.to_value, response) if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then cecho("<red>[SYS ERROR] Failed to parse gamefeed JSON — see last_feed_response.json\n") return end
-- Process each event local lastPlayerName = nil for _, event in ipairs(data) do if event.caption ~= "Arena Duel" then if event.type == "DEA" then local playerName = event.description:match("^(%S+) was slain") if playerName then local eventTime = event.date local formattedTime = formatEventTime(eventTime) if not slainPlayers[eventTime] then slainPlayers[eventTime] = playerName
-- GUI display GUI.deathsight:cecho( string.format( "[%s]: <red>%s<reset> - %s \n", formattedTime, playerName, event.description ) )
lastPlayerName = playerName end end end end end
-- Optional auto-command if lastPlayerName and settings.systemLoaded then if not balance_data.balance.in_use then if not table.contains(NDB.cityEnemies, lastPlayerName) and not table.contains(enemylist, lastPlayerName) then if table.contains(NDB.cityList, lastPlayerName) or table.contains(allylist, lastPlayerName) or NDB_isCitizenOf("Eleusis", lastPlayerName) or NDB_isCitizenOf("Cyrene", lastPlayerName) then -- send("caress skull " .. lastPlayerName) end end end end end end
-- Register the event handler for the HTTP request completion registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysGetHttpDone", "sysGetHttpDoneHandler") -- Event handler triggered when the HTTP request fails
function sysGetHttpErrorHandler(event, response, url) if settings.systemLoaded then debugEcho("red", "sysGetHttpError event triggered! URL: " .. url .. " Error: " .. response .."") end end
function startGameFeedPolling() stopGameFeedPolling() fetchGameFeed() gameFeedTimer = tempTimer(2.5, startGameFeedPolling) end
function stopGameFeedPolling() if gameFeedTimer then killTimer(gameFeedTimer) gameFeedTimer = nil end end
-- Register the event handler for HTTP errors registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysGetHttpError", "sysGetHttpErrorHandler") -- Function to fetch the game feed
function fetchGameFeed() if settings.systemLoaded then -- Print a debug message to confirm the function is called debugEcho("green","⏹️ Fetching game feed...") -- Send the HTTP GET request to the game feed API getHTTP("https://api.achaea.com/gamefeed.json") gameFeedTimer = nil end end

Script.name: updateCharStats
Script.script:
-- Update character stats function updateCharStats() for _, v in pairs(gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats) do local function updateStat(pattern, var) if v:match(pattern) then _G[var] = string.gsub(v, pattern .. ": ", "") return _G[var] end return false end
updateStat("Karma", "karma") updateStat("Anathema", "anathema") updateStat("Manifestation", "manifestation") if updateStat("Rage", "rage") then _G.rage = tonumber(_G.rage) end updateStat("Morph", "morph") updateStat("Voice", "voice") updateStat("Age", "age") updateStat("Word", "word") if updateStat("Stance", "stance") then _G.stance = _G.stance:lower() end if updateStat("Kai", "kai") then _G.kai = tonumber(_G.kai) end updateStat("Kata", "kata") updateStat("Angelpower", "angelpower") updateStat("Devotion", "devotion") updateStat("conviction", "conviction") updateStat("prayer_length", "prayerlength") updateStat("Prayer", "prayer") updateStat("Wrath", "wrath") updateStat("wrathbal", "wrathbal") updateStat("Channels", "channels") updateStat("Shin", "shin") updateStat("Essence", "essence") updateStat("Spirits", "spirits") updateStat("epitaph_length", "epitaph") updateStat("Entity", "entity") updateStat("empower", "empower") updateStat("Venom", "venom") if updateStat("Form", "form") then _G.stance = _G.form:lower() end end end
function getCharStat(statName) if not gmcp.Char or not gmcp.Char.Vitals or not gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats then return 0 end
for _, v in pairs(gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats) do -- Matches "StatName: Value" local match = v:match(statName .. ":%s*(.+)") if match then -- Clean it up: convert numbers if possible, otherwise keep string return tonumber(match) or match end end return 0 end

Script.name: installSystem
Script.script:
function installSystem() -- 1. Get the foundation ready systemLogin()
-- 2. CRITICAL: Load files BEFORE initializing logic initializeFileLoads()
-- 3. Now that files are loaded, setup the logic initializeSettings() initializeGUIContainers() initializeGUIWindows() initializeGUIGauges()
-- These now have actual data to work with because initializeFileLoads() finished initializeCurativeTable() initializeDefensiveTable()
-- 4. Finalize settings.systemInstalled = true saveTableToJSON(settings, "settings")
cecho("\n<green>[SYSTEM] Installation and Data Synchronization complete.") end

Script.name: resetVitals
Script.script:
-- Initialize the base global table framework once at script load time vitals = vitals or { health = {}, mana = {}, ep = {}, wp = {}, rank = {} } interpolationState = interpolationState or { health = false, mana = false, ep = false, wp = false, rank = false }
function resetVitals() -- Safeguard: ensure GMCP data is physically present before processing updates if not gmcp or not gmcp.Char or not gmcp.Char.Vitals then return end
-- 1. Mutate health properties in-place local maxHP = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxhp) or 1 vitals.health.max = maxHP vitals.health.current = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.hp) or maxHP vitals.health.previous = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.hp) or maxHP vitals.health.halflife = maxHP * 0.50
-- 2. Mutate mana properties in-place local maxMP = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxmp) or 1 vitals.mana.max = maxMP vitals.mana.current = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.mp) or maxMP vitals.mana.previous = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.mp) or maxMP vitals.mana.halflife = maxMP * 0.50
-- 3. Mutate endurance properties in-place local maxEP = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxep) or 1 vitals.ep.max = maxEP vitals.ep.current = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.ep) or maxEP vitals.ep.previous = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.ep) or maxEP vitals.ep.halflife = maxEP * 0.50
-- 4. Mutate willpower properties in-place local maxWP = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxwp) or 1 vitals.wp.max = maxWP vitals.wp.current = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.wp) or maxWP vitals.wp.previous = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.wp) or maxWP vitals.wp.halflife = maxWP * 0.50
-- 5. Safe Experience Parsing (Eliminates the 'string.cut' crash trap) local rawXP = (gmcp.Char.Status and gmcp.Char.Status.xp) or "0" -- Uses safe regex pattern matching to extract numbers, ignoring characters like '%' local parsedXP = tonumber(string.match(tostring(rawXP), "%d+%.?%d*")) or 0
vitals.rank.max = 100 vitals.rank.current = math.floor(parsedXP) vitals.rank.previous = math.floor(parsedXP) vitals.rank.halflife = 50
-- 6. Clean Reset of Interpolation States for k, _ in pairs(interpolationState) do interpolationState[k] = false end end

Script.name: resetCuringList
Script.script:
-- Function to reset curinglist using a deep copy function resetCuringList() -- Guard clause: If afflictions isn't a table or is empty, get out. if type(afflictions) ~= "table" or not next(afflictions) then debugEcho("yellow","Skipping resetCuringList — afflictions not loaded yet.") return end
for key, value in pairs(afflictions) do -- Extra safety: make sure the specific affliction has a priority table if value and value.priority then curinglist[key] = deepCopy(value.priority) end end end
-- Function to update curinglist dynamically function updateCuringList() for key, value in pairs(afflictions) do -- Only add afflictions not already in curinglist if curinglist[key] == nil then curinglist[key] = value.priority end end end

Script.name: resetCureBalance
updateCurativeTable
Script.script:
function updateCurativeTable() local cs = settings.cmdsep or ";"
-- 1. Grab current class data baseline local class = PLAYER:myclass() if not class then cecho("<red>⚠️ Cannot initialize curatives: class not detected.\n") return end
local data = activeCureData[class] if not data then cecho("<red>⚠️ No cure data found for class: " .. tostring(class) .. "\n") return end
-- Safety check: exit if afflictions table hasn't been created yet if not afflictions then return end
-- 2. Agnostic separator rebuilder function local function rebuildCommand(cmdField, newCS) if type(cmdField) == "string" then local actions = {} for action in string.gmatch(cmdField, "[^;:|,]+") do action = string.match(action, "^%s*(.-)%s*$") table.insert(actions, action) end return table.concat(actions, newCS) elseif type(cmdField) == "table" then local updatedTable = {} for key, value in pairs(cmdField) do updatedTable[key] = rebuildCommand(value, newCS) end return updatedTable end return cmdField end
-- 3. THE SAFE REFRESH LOOP for affName, affData in pairs(afflictions) do if affData.cures and type(affData.cures) == "table" then for i, cureBlock in ipairs(affData.cures) do
-- 🟢 THE HOT-SWAP TRIGGER: -- Check the handle or slot configuration to find the class cure. -- In your setup, the class slot is always the last entry (handle 3 or 4). -- We can identify it precisely if its type matches a dynamic variable, -- or if it represents the specialized class block.
if cureBlock.handle == 3 or cureBlock.handle == 4 then -- If this slot matches a dynamic class-based cure requirement, -- hot-swap the entire sub-block data structure using the new class payload. -- This strips the old class skill out instantly! afflictions[affName].cures[i].type = data.type afflictions[affName].cures[i].cooldown = data.cooldown afflictions[affName].cures[i].requires = safeFlatten(data.requires) afflictions[affName].cures[i].blockers = safeFlatten(data.blockers)
-- Inject the new class command string directly as the fresh base formula cureBlock.command = data.command end
-- 🟢 THE REWRITE EXECUTION: -- Process the command field (whether generic or the newly injected class command) -- to ensure it uses the user's active separator rule. if cureBlock.command then afflictions[affName].cures[i].command = rebuildCommand(cureBlock.command, cs) end end end end
saveTableToJSON(afflictions, "afflictions")
end

Script.name: updateDefensiveTable
Script.script:
function updateDefensiveTable() -- Grab the live separator rule from settings local cs = settings.cmdsep or ";"
if not defenses then return end
-- Helper function to dismantle and rebuild strings in place local function rebuildCommand(cmdField, newCS) if type(cmdField) == "string" then local actions = {}
-- 🟢 THE PLUG-AND-PLAY FIX: -- Added '|' to the excluded character set [^;:|,] -- This cleanly catches and splits actions regardless of if they use ;, :, ,, or | for action in string.gmatch(cmdField, "[^;:|,]+") do -- Trim any accidental trailing/leading spaces action = string.match(action, "^%s*(.-)%s*$") table.insert(actions, action) end
-- Stitch them back together using the live 'cs' choice return table.concat(actions, newCS)
elseif type(cmdField) == "table" then local updatedTable = {} for key, value in pairs(cmdField) do updatedTable[key] = rebuildCommand(value, newCS) end return updatedTable end return cmdField end
-- Loop through defenses and swap out ONLY the command payload keys for defName, data in pairs(defenses) do if data.command then defenses[defName].command = rebuildCommand(data.command, cs) end end
saveTableToJSON(defenses, "defenses")
end

Script.name: updateActiveCureData
