NDB_Failed
Script.script:
-- Make sure this function is hooked up to the Mudlet event: sysDownloadError function NDB_Failed(event, filepath) debugEcho("red", "Error downloading information.")
local tablesDir = getNDBPath()
if filepath:match("server replied: Not Found") then debugEcho("yellow", "API Error: " .. filepath)
-- FIXED: Robust pattern matching that strips out the name regardless of \ or / slashes local person = filepath:match("([^/\\]+)%.json")
if person and person ~= "Online" then person = person:title() local fpr = tablesDir .. "/" .. person .. ".json"
-- Track them in your memory table so your system doesn't query them again NDB = NDB or {} NDB.doesNotExist = NDB.doesNotExist or {} NDB.doesNotExist[person] = true
debugEcho("red", "This person does not exist on the Achaea server: " .. person)
-- If NDB_Remove exists in your system, let it clean up memory anchors if type(NDB_Remove) == "function" then NDB_Remove(person) else if NDB.players then NDB.players[person] = nil end end
-- FIXED: Swapped out legacy saveTableToJSON for your standard robust jsonManager interface jsonManager({ write = true, path = tablesDir .. "/doesnotexist.json", data = NDB.doesNotExist })
-- Clean up the empty/broken file Mudlet might have initialized on the hard drive if lfs.attributes(fpr, "mode") then os.remove(fpr) end end else debugEcho("red", "Unknown network/server error while downloading: " .. filepath) end end

Script.name: NDB_Success
Script.script:
function NDB_Success(event, filepath) if not filepath or not (filepath:find("ndb") or filepath:find("Online")) then return end
if filepath:find("Online", 1, true) then NDB_ProcessOnlineList(filepath) return end
local success, errorMsg = pcall(function() local f = io.open(filepath, "r") if not f then return end local s = f:read("*a") f:close()
if not s or s:find("fullname") == nil then os.remove(filepath) return end
local ok, t = pcall(yajl.to_value, s) if not ok then return end
local name = t.name:title()
--------------------------------------------------------- -- 🛡️ PROTECTIVE OVERRIDE GUARDS --------------------------------------------------------- -- 1. Check City: If API returns hidden but you have a manual city set, preserve yours! local incomingCity = t.city and t.city:title() or "None" local finalCity = incomingCity
if (incomingCity == "Hidden" or incomingCity == "(hidden)") and NDB and NDB.players and NDB.players[name] then local currentStoredCity = NDB.players[name].city or "None" if currentStoredCity ~= "None" and currentStoredCity ~= "Hidden" and currentStoredCity ~= "(hidden)" then finalCity = currentStoredCity end end
-- 2. Check House: If API returns hidden but you have a manual house set, preserve yours! local incomingHouse = t.house and t.house:title() or "None" local finalHouse = incomingHouse
if (incomingHouse == "Hidden" or incomingHouse == "(hidden)") and NDB and NDB.players and NDB.players[name] then local currentStoredHouse = NDB.players[name].house or "None" if currentStoredHouse ~= "None" and currentStoredHouse ~= "Hidden" and currentStoredHouse ~= "(hidden)" then finalHouse = currentStoredHouse end end ---------------------------------------------------------
-- Table Construction using protected city and house values NDB.players[name] = { name = name, title = t.fullname or name, house = finalHouse, xp_rank = tonumber(t.xp_rank) or 0, city = finalCity, level = tonumber(t.level) or 0, class = t.class and t.class:title() or "Unknown", pks = tonumber(t.player_kills) or 0, lastUpdate = os.date("%m/%d/%y %H:%M:%S"), }
-- 💾 SECURE OVERWRITE: Save via your newly fixed write engine! local safeName = name:title() jsonManager({ write = true, path = getNDBPath() .. "/" .. safeName .. ".json", data = NDB.players[name] })
-- Clean up the temporary API download file from your system os.remove(filepath)
-- TRACKER LOGIC if NDB.updateQueueSize and NDB.updateQueueSize > 0 then NDB.updatesCompleted = (NDB.updatesCompleted or 0) + 1 if NDB.updatesCompleted >= NDB.updateQueueSize then cecho("\n<gold>NDB: <green>FINISHED UPDATING NDB NAME DATA.\n") NDB.updateQueueSize = 0 NDB.updatesCompleted = 0 end end
-- HONOURS DISPLAY LOGIC if NDB.checking then NDB_displayWho(name) NDB.checking = false end
raiseEvent("NDB Check Highlight", name) end)
if not success then cecho("\n<red>CRITICAL ERROR IN NDB_SUCCESS: " .. tostring(errorMsg)) end end
function NDB_ProcessOnlineList(filepath) debugEcho("yellow","1. Reading Online.json...") local file = io.open(filepath, "r") if not file then debugEcho("red","FAILED to open file.") return end
local contents = file:read("*a") file:close()
debugEcho("yellow","2. Decoding JSON...") local data = dkjson.decode(contents)
if data and data.characters then local total = #data.characters local newCount = 0 debugEcho("yellow","3. Found " .. total .. " characters in API.")
-- Ensure peopleOnline is a table if type(peopleOnline) ~= "table" then cecho("\n<red>Warning: peopleOnline was not a table. Initializing now.") peopleOnline = {} end
for _, char in ipairs(data.characters) do local name = char.name peopleOnline[name] = true
if not NDB_Exists(name) then cecho("\n<white> - New: " .. name) NDB_Acquire(name) newCount = newCount + 1 else -- 🟢 ADD THIS ELSE BLOCK: -- If they are already tracked in memory, ensure their hard drive file exists or overwrite it fresh! local safeName = name:title() jsonManager({ write = true, path = getNDBPath() .. "/" .. safeName .. ".json", data = NDB.players[safeName] }) end end
debugEcho("green","SUCCESS: Triggered " .. newCount .. " downloads.")
if newCount == 0 then debugEcho("cyan","4. Sorting display initiated...")
-- AUDIT: Initialize global list apiOnlineFound = {} debugEcho("grey","DEBUG: apiOnlineFound type: " .. type(apiOnlineFound))
local insertCount = 0 for name, _ in pairs(peopleOnline) do -- AUDIT: Check if table.insert is being called on a valid table if type(apiOnlineFound) == "table" then table.insert(apiOnlineFound, name) insertCount = insertCount + 1 else cecho("\n<red>CRITICAL: apiOnlineFound is not a table inside loop!") end end
debugEcho("grey","DEBUG: Inserted " .. insertCount .. " names into apiOnlineFound.")
if #apiOnlineFound > 0 then table.sort(apiOnlineFound) debugEcho("grey","DEBUG: Table sorted. Calling NDB_displayOnline...") NDB_RenderDisplay(apiOnlineFound) else debugEcho("red","ERROR: apiOnlineFound is empty after loop.") end end
else debugEcho("red","FAILED: JSON data was empty or invalid.") end
parsingQW = false os.remove(filepath) debugEcho("yellow","5. Cleanup complete. File removed.") end

Script.name: get information
Script.script:
function NDB_GetOnline() local ndbPath = getNDBPath()
-- Ensure the directory exists if not lfs.attributes(ndbPath, "mode") then lfs.mkdir(ndbPath) end
-- Trigger the download local url = "http://api.achaea.com/characters.json" local savePath = ndbPath .. "/Online.json"
downloadFile(savePath, url) debugEcho("yellow","Syncing with Achaea API... ") end
function handleNDBDownload(event, filename) local ndbPath = getNDBPath()
--------------------------------------------------------- -- CASE 1: GLOBAL ONLINE LIST DOWNLOADED --------------------------------------------------------- if filename:find("Online.json", 1, true) then -- Route directly to your high-efficiency, clean decoder function NDB_SortOnline(filename) return end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- CASE 2: INDIVIDUAL CHARACTER DATA DOWNLOADED --------------------------------------------------------- local personName = filename:match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
-- Ensure the file is inside our NDB folder and matches an individual download if personName and filename:find(ndbPath, 1, true) and personName ~= "Online" and personName ~= "doesnotexist" then
-- Use jsonManager to safely pull the freshly downloaded person data from the API stream local data = jsonManager({ safe = true, path = filename, fallback = {} })
if data and data.name then NDB = NDB or {} NDB.players = NDB.players or {} local name = data.name:title()
-- Construct the structured player layout profile cleanly NDB.players[name] = { name = name, title = data.fullname or name, house = data.house and data.house:title() or "None", xp_rank = tonumber(data.xp_rank) or 0, city = data.city and data.city:title() or "None", level = tonumber(data.level) or 0, class = data.class and data.class:title() or "Unknown", pks = tonumber(data.player_kills) or 0, lastUpdate = os.date("%m/%d/%y %H:%M:%S"), }
-- 💾 Force write the individual player profile to your hard drive securely! NDB_SavePlayerFile(name)
-- HONOURS DISPLAY HOOK (For individual manual inspect lookups) if NDB.checking then NDB_displayWho(name) NDB.checking = false end
raiseEvent("NDB Check Highlight", name)
if settings.debug then cecho("\n<cyan>[NDB]: Automatically updated and saved profile for: " .. name) end end end end
function NDB_Acquire(person) if not person or person == "" then return end local person = person:title()
if NDB and NDB.doesNotExist and NDB.doesNotExist[person] then debugEcho("yellow","Skipping " .. person .. " — known invalid.\n") return end
local ndbPath = getNDBPath() local savePath = ndbPath .. "/" .. person .. ".json" local url = "http://api.achaea.com/characters/" .. person .. ".json"
downloadFile(savePath, url) end
function NDB_SavePlayerFile(name) if not name or name == "" then return end local name = name:title()
if not NDB or not NDB.players or not NDB.players[name] then return end
local ndbPath = getNDBPath() local fullPath = ndbPath .. "/" .. name .. ".json" local playerData = NDB.players[name]
jsonManager({ write = true, path = fullPath, data = playerData }) end
function NDB_NameList(names) for _, name in pairs(names) do if not NDB_Exists(name) and not table.contains(NDB.divine, name) then NDB_Acquire(name) end end end

Script.name: NDB API
Script.script:
function getNDBPath() local base = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/ndb" if not lfs.attributes(base, "mode") then lfs.mkdir(base) debugEcho("green","Created NDB data folder: " .. base .. "\n") end return base end
function NDB_Exists(name) if not NDB or not NDB.players or not name then return false end return NDB.players[name:title()] ~= nil end
function NDB_isMark(name) if not name or not NDB_Exists(name) then return false end local person = name:title() return NDB.players[person].mark or false end
function NDB_armyRank(name) if not name or not NDB_Exists(name) then return 0 end local person = name:title() return NDB.players[person].armyRank or 0 end
function NDB_isEnemy(name) if not name or not NDB or not NDB.cityEnemies then return false end return table.contains(NDB.cityEnemies, name:title()) end
function NDB_getHouse(name) if not name or not NDB_Exists(name) then return "Unknown" else return NDB.players[name:title()].house or "None" end end
function NDB_getClass(name) if not name or not NDB_Exists(name) then return "Unknown" else return NDB.players[name:title()].class or "Unknown" end end
function NDB_getCitizenship(name) if not name or not NDB_Exists(name) then return "Unknown" end local person = name:title() local city = NDB.players[person].city or "None"
if city:lower() == "none" or city:lower() == "(hidden)" or city:lower() == "underworld" then return "Rogues" else return city end end
function NDB_getColour(name) if not name or not NDB_Exists(name) then return "white" else local citizenship = NDB_getCitizenship(name)
if citizenship == "Unknown" or citizenship == "None" or citizenship == "Rogues" then return NDB.highlighting.Rogues or "white" elseif citizenship:lower() == "underworld" then return NDB.highlighting.Underworld or "white" else return NDB.highlighting[citizenship] or "white" end end end
function NDB_isCitizenOf(city, name) if not name or not city then return false end if NDB_Exists(name) then return NDB.players[name:title()].city == city:title() else debugEcho("red","That person's information has not yet been gathered.") return false end end
function NDB_Ignore(name) if not name or name == "" then return end local person = name:title()
NDB = NDB or {} NDB.doesNotExist = NDB.doesNotExist or {} NDB.doesNotExist[person] = true
-- FIXED: Unified legacy saveTableToJSON with your robust jsonManager jsonManager({ write = true, path = getNDBPath() .. "/doesnotexist.json", data = NDB.doesNotExist }) debugEcho("yellow","Added " .. person .. " to ignore list.") end
function NDB_Remove(name) if not name or name == "" then return end local person = name:title()
if NDB_Exists(person) then NDB.players[person] = nil
if NDB.highlightTriggers and NDB.highlightTriggers[person] then killTrigger(NDB.highlightTriggers[person]) NDB.highlightTriggers[person] = nil end
-- Clean up the file from your computer's hard drive as well local fullPath = getNDBPath() .. "/" .. person .. ".json" if lfs.attributes(fullPath, "mode") then os.remove(fullPath) end
debugEcho("red", person .. " has been fully purged from memory and disk storage.") else debugEcho("red", person .. " is not tracked in the system database.") end end
function NDB_SortOnline(filepath) -- Safely decode using your active system jsonManager local data = jsonManager({ safe = true, path = filepath, fallback = {} }) if not data or not data.characters then debugEcho("red","[JSON ERROR] Incomplete or malformed global data stream parsed.") return end
apiOnlineFound = {} local apiNeedUpdate = {}
-- Parse active characters out of the downloaded server file for _, tab in ipairs(data.characters) do local cName = tab.name:title() if not tab.name:find("masked") and not table.contains(NDB.divine, cName) then table.insert(apiOnlineFound, cName) end end
-- Sync and cross-reference against your live Mudlet GMCP player channel feeds if gmcp and gmcp.Comm and gmcp.Comm.Channel and gmcp.Comm.Channel.Players then for _, tab in ipairs(gmcp.Comm.Channel.Players) do local name = tab.name:title() if not name:find("masked") and not table.contains(NDB.divine, name) and not table.contains(apiOnlineFound, name) then table.insert(apiOnlineFound, name) end end end
-- Clean up the temporary online file wrapper if lfs.attributes(filepath, "mode") then os.remove(filepath) end table.sort(apiOnlineFound)
-- Detect who is completely missing from your computer folders local count = 0 for _, name in ipairs(apiOnlineFound) do if not NDB_Exists(name) and not table.contains(NDB.divine, name) then count = count + 1 table.insert(apiNeedUpdate, name) end end
if count > 0 then cecho(string.format("\n<yellow>%d new names identified, acquiring profiles...", count)) cecho("\n<DarkSlateGray> Downloading missing logs: " .. table.concat(apiNeedUpdate, ", ") .. ".") NDB_NameList(apiNeedUpdate) else -- 🟢 THE MISSING PIECE: If everyone is already tracked in memory, make sure their individual -- files are actually backed up on the hard drive right now instead of skipping them entirely! for _, name in ipairs(apiOnlineFound) do local safePath = getNDBPath() .. "/" .. name .. ".json" if not io.exists(safePath) then NDB_SavePlayerFile(name) end end
-- Render your newly streamlined UI layouts! if parsingCity and parsingCity ~= "All" then if parsingCity:lower() == "classes" then NDB_displayOnlineClass(apiOnlineFound) else NDB_displayOnlineCity(apiOnlineFound) end else NDB_RenderDisplay(apiOnlineFound) end end
parsingQW = false parsingCity = nil end

Script.name: NDB highlighting
Script.script:
function NDB_Unhighlight() if not NDB or not NDB.highlightTriggers or not next(NDB.highlightTriggers) then return end
for k, v in pairs(NDB.highlightTriggers) do killTrigger(v) end
NDB.highlightTriggers = {} end
function NDB_enemyHighlights() cecho("\n<DarkSlateGray>Clearing all highlights to prevent errors. One moment, please...") NDB_Unhighlight() tempTimer(1.5, function() cecho("\n<DarkSlateGray>Loading new highlights now.") NDB_loadHighlights() end) end
function NDB_loadHighlights() NDB = NDB or {} NDB.highlightTriggers = NDB.highlightTriggers or {} collectgarbage("stop")
NDB_Unhighlight()
if NDB.highlightNames and NDB.players then for _, person in pairs(NDB.players) do if person.name then NDB_highlightName(person.name:title(), person.city) end end elseif NDB.special then for person, colour in pairs(NDB.special) do NDB_highlightName(person:title(), "None") end end
collectgarbage() end
function NDB_addHighlight(_, name)
if not NDB.highlightNames then return end if not name then return end if not NDB.players[name] then return end
NDB_highlightName( NDB.players[name].name, NDB.players[name].city) end
function NDB_updateHighlights(city, colour)
NDB.highlighting[city] = colour
for name, trig in pairs(NDB.highlightTriggers) do if NDB.players[name].city == city then killTrigger(trig) if NDB.highlightNames then NDB_highlightName( NDB.players[name].name, NDB.players[name].city ) end elseif city == "Rogues" or city == "(hidden)" or city == "underworld" then if NDB_getCitizenship(name) == "None" then killTrigger(trig) if NDB.highlightNames then NDB_highlightName( NDB.players[name].name, NDB.players[name].city ) end end end end end
function NDB_highlightName(who, city) if not who or who == "" then return end local person = who:title()
NDB.highlightTriggers = NDB.highlightTriggers or {}
-- Clear out existing triggers tracking this exact player name first if NDB.highlightTriggers[person] then killTrigger(NDB.highlightTriggers[person]) NDB.highlightTriggers[person] = nil end
-- FIXED: Leverage your custom color system function instead of repeating manual color logic chains! local colour = NDB_getColour(person)
-- Override with explicit enemy settings if highlight priority demands it if NDB.highlightPriority == "enemies" and NDB_isEnemy(person) then colour = NDB.highlighting.Enemies or "red" end
-- Overwrite with explicit manual special colors if present if NDB.special and NDB.special[person] then colour = NDB.special[person] end
-- Construct the exact dynamic tempTrigger anchor NDB.highlightTriggers[person] = tempTrigger(person, string.format([[NDB_highlight("%s", "%s")]], person, colour or "white")) end
function NDB_highlight(name, colour) if not name or name == "" then return end local person = name:title()
local c, k = 1, 1 while k > 0 do k = line:find(person, k) if k == nil then return end c = c + 1
-- Verify alphanumeric boundary structures strictly if k == line:find("%f[%a]" .. person .. "%f[%A]", k) then if selectString(person, c - 1) > -1 then if colour then fg(colour) end
-- Inject extra enemy format decorations safely if NDB.highlightPriority == "enemies" and NDB_isEnemy(person) and NDB.enemySettings then if NDB.enemySettings.bold then setBold(true) end if NDB.enemySettings.underline then setUnderline(true) end if NDB.enemySettings.italics then setItalics(true) end end resetFormat() else return end end k = k + 1 end end
registerAnonymousEventHandler("NDB Check Highlight", "NDB_addHighlight")

Script.name: NDB display API
Script.script:
function NDB_RenderDisplay(players) -- 1. Argument Check players = (players and #players > 0) and players or apiOnlineFound if not players or #players == 0 then cecho("
<red>RENDER ERROR: No players found in the list.") return end
-- 2. Setup Buckets (Standardized keys to Match the Display Order Array) local onlinePeople = { Ashtan = {}, Cyrene = {}, Eleusis = {}, Hashan = {}, Mhaldor = {}, Targossas = {}, Rogues = {}, Underworld = {}, Untracked = {} }
for _, person in ipairs(players) do local name = person:title() if not NDB_Exists(name) then table.insert(onlinePeople.Untracked, name) else local city = NDB_getCitizenship(name) -- Use our unified getCitizenship function to filter into the exact bucket names if city == "Rogues" or city == "Unknown" or city == "None" then table.insert(onlinePeople.Rogues, name) elseif city:lower() == "underworld" then table.insert(onlinePeople.Underworld, name) elseif onlinePeople[city] then table.insert(onlinePeople[city], name) else table.insert(onlinePeople.Rogues, name) end end end
-- 3. UI Config local lineWidth = 80 local nameIndent = 21 local headerLine = "<white>+" .. string.rep("-", lineWidth - 2) .. "+" local divider = "
<DarkSlateGray>" .. string.rep(".", lineWidth)
-- 4. Manual Wrap Helper local function cechoWrappedNames(prefix, list, color) local namesString = table.concat(list, ", ") .. "." local words = {} for word in namesString:gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(words, word) end
local currentLine = prefix local currentLen = nameIndent
for _, word in ipairs(words) do -- Strip any internal tags to calculate clean horizontal visual character spacing local cleanWord = word:gsub("<[^>]+>", "") if currentLen + #cleanWord > lineWidth then cecho("
" .. currentLine) currentLine = string.rep(" ", nameIndent) .. "<" .. color .. ">" .. word .. " " currentLen = nameIndent + #cleanWord + 1 else currentLine = currentLine .. "<" .. color .. ">" .. word .. " " currentLen = currentLen + #cleanWord + 1 end end cecho("
" .. currentLine) end
-- 5. The Output Header Display cecho("
" .. headerLine) local headerText = string.format("| <gold>WHO IS ONLINE <white>| <green>Total Tracked: <white>%d", #players) local cleanHeader = headerText:gsub("<[^>]+>", "") cecho("
<white>" .. headerText .. string.rep(" ", lineWidth - #cleanHeader - 1) .. "|") cecho("
" .. headerLine)
local displayOrder = {"Ashtan", "Cyrene", "Eleusis", "Hashan", "Mhaldor", "Targossas", "Rogues", "Underworld"}
for _, cityKey in ipairs(displayOrder) do local list = onlinePeople[cityKey] if list and #list > 0 then table.sort(list) local color = (NDB.highlighting and NDB.highlighting[cityKey]) or "white"
local prefix = string.format("<white>%-10s <%s>: <white>(<orange>%d<white>) ", cityKey:sub(1,10), color, #list) cechoWrappedNames(prefix, list, color) cecho(divider) end end
-- 6. Untracked if #onlinePeople.Untracked > 0 then table.sort(onlinePeople.Untracked) local prefix = string.format("<grey>%-10s <grey>: <white>(<orange>%d<white>) ", "Untracked", #onlinePeople.Untracked) cechoWrappedNames(prefix, onlinePeople.Untracked, "grey") cecho(divider) end
cecho("
" .. headerLine .. "
") send(" ", false) end
-- Fallback alias mapper in case your engine loops redirect here function NDB_displayOnline(players) NDB_RenderDisplay(players) end
function NDB_displayOnlineCity(players) if not parsingCity then return end local targetCity = parsingCity:title() local color = (NDB.highlighting and NDB.highlighting[targetCity]) or "white"
cecho(string.format("
<green>Data acquisition completed. Showing online players from <%s>%s<reset>.
", color, targetCity))
for _, person in pairs(players) do local name = person:title() if NDB_isCitizenOf(targetCity, name) then local pClass = NDB_getClass(name) cecho(string.format("
 <%s>%-13s<reset> - <NavajoWhite>%s", color, name, pClass)) end end echo("
") send(" ") parsingCity = nil end
function NDB_displayWho(person) if not person or person == "" then return end NDB.checking = nil local name = person:title()
if not NDB_Exists(name) then cecho("
<red>" .. name .. " is not yet tracked in the database!") else local x = NDB.players[name] local c = NDB_getColour(name)
-- Safety string casts to prevent length calculation errors on nil fields local pTitle = tostring(x.title or name) local pCity = tostring(x.city or "Unknown") local pLevel = tostring(x.level or "Unknown") local pHouse = tostring(x.house or "None") local pRank = tostring(x.xp_rank or "Unknown") local pClass = tostring(x.class or "Unknown") local pKills = tostring(x.pks or "0") local u = "Checked: " .. tostring(x.lastUpdate or "n/a")
cecho("

<blue>- <" .. c .. ">" .. pTitle .. " <blue>" .. string.rep("-", math.max(5, 70 - (#pTitle + 3))) .. "
") cecho(string.format("
<cyan> City : <NavajoWhite>%-31s <cyan> Level: <NavajoWhite>%s", pCity, pLevel)) cecho(string.format("
<cyan> House: <NavajoWhite>%-31s <cyan> Rank : <NavajoWhite>%s", pHouse, pRank)) cecho(string.format("
<cyan> Class: <NavajoWhite>%-31s <cyan> Kills: <NavajoWhite>%s", pClass, pKills))
if NDB_armyRank(name) > 0 then local rankColor = NDB_armyRank(name) > 3 and "red" or "NavajoWhite" cecho(string.format("
<cyan> Army : <%s>%s", rankColor, NDB_armyRank(name))) end
if NDB_isMark(name) then local markColor = NDB_isMark(name) == "Ivory" and "NavajoWhite" or "purple" cecho(string.format("
<cyan> Mark : <%s>%s", markColor, NDB_isMark(name))) end
echo("
 ") if NDB.player_Notes and NDB.player_Notes[name] and #NDB.player_Notes[name] > 0 then cecho("
<cyan> Notes:") for num, note in pairs(NDB.player_Notes[name]) do cecho(string.format("
 <DarkSlateBlue>%d) <reset>%s", num, note)) end echo("
 ") end
cecho("
 <green>" .. string.rep(" ", math.max(1, 69 - #u)) .. u) cecho("
<blue>" .. string.rep("-", 70)) cecho("
 ") send(" ", false) end end

Script.name: Helpers
Script.script:
------------------------------------ -----------HELPERS CALLS------------ ------------------------------------ function addToggle(label, settingKey, typeHandler, example, extra, callback)
cechoLink(" <white>(toggle) ", function() -- 1. Flip the local boolean value settings[settingKey] = not settings[settingKey]
-- 2. Feedback in the console local status = settings[settingKey] and "<green>ON" or "<red>OFF" cecho("\n<white>Setting: ["..typeHandler.."] <yellow>" .. label .. "<white> is now " .. status)
-- 3. Save to JSON immediately so it persists! saveTableToJSON(settings, "settings")
-- 🎯 4. SERVER AUTOMATION LAYER: Send the corresponding config command out to Achaea if settings[settingKey] then if example then send(example:lower()) end else if extra then send(extra:lower()) end end
-- 5. Run the callback (like updatePrompt) if provided if callback then callback() end
-- 6. Refresh the UI menu automatically local targetMenuFunc = "menu" .. typeHandler .. "Settings" if _G[targetMenuFunc] then _G[targetMenuFunc]() else cecho("\n<red>Error: Function " .. targetMenuFunc .. " does not exist!") end end, "Click to toggle " .. label, true)
if settings.showScrollbar then enableScrollBar("main") else disableScrollBar() end
-- Display the current state in the menu local val = settings[settingKey] local color = val and "<green>" or "<red>" local state = val and "ON" or "OFF" cecho("<white>(+) " .. color .. label .. "<white>: " .. state) end
-- Unified Input Helper Updated for Curing Set Logic function addInput(label, settingKey, example, typeHandler) local commandPrefix = typeHandler:lower() .. "input"
cechoLink(" <white>(click) ", function() if label == "CURINGSET New" then clearCmdLine() appendCmdLine("CURINGSET NEW [NAME]") elseif label == "CURINGSET List" then send("curingset list") else clearCmdLine() appendCmdLine(commandPrefix .. " " .. settingKey:upper() .. " " .. example:upper()) end end, "click to set '"..label.."'", true)
local val = tostring(settings[settingKey] or "") local isSet = val ~= "" local statusColor = (val:upper() == "OFF") and "<yellow>" or "<green>"
-- 1. Check for Action labels if label:find("New") then local newLabel = "CURINGSET NEW" cecho("<white>(+) <green>" .. newLabel)
elseif label:find("List") then local newLabel = "CURINGSET LIST" cecho("<white>(+) <green>" .. newLabel)
-- 2. Main CURINGSET label (Shows current active set) elseif label == "CURINGSET" then local activeSet = settings["curingset"] or "None" local displayVal = (#activeSet > 10) and (activeSet:sub(1,7).."...") or activeSet cecho("<white>(+) <green>" .. label .. ": <white>" .. displayVal)
-- 🟢 SANITIZED PIPE TRACKING LOOKUPS (Prevents Nil Crashes): elseif label == "refill skullcap" then local pipeVal = (pipes and pipes.skullcap and pipes.skullcap.refill) or settings[settingKey] or example cecho("<white>(+) <green>" .. label .. ": <white>" .. tostring(pipeVal))
elseif label == "refill valerian" then local pipeVal = (pipes and pipes.valerian and pipes.valerian.refill) or settings[settingKey] or example cecho("<white>(+) <green>" .. label .. ": <white>" .. tostring(pipeVal))
elseif label == "refill elm" then local pipeVal = (pipes and pipes.elm and pipes.elm.refill) or settings[settingKey] or example cecho("<white>(+) <green>" .. label .. ": <white>" .. tostring(pipeVal))
-- 3. Standard Logic for everything else elseif isSet then local displayVal = (#val > 10) and (tostring(val):sub(1,7).."...") or val cecho("<white>(+) " .. statusColor .. label .. "<white>: " .. displayVal) else cecho("<white>(-) <DarkSlateGray>" .. label .. ": Not Set") end
end

------------------------------------ -----------FUNCTION CALLS----------- ------------------------------------
function updatePrompt() -- 1. If the prompt is disabled entirely, kill it immediately and exit if not settings.promptEnabled then send("CONFIG PROMPT OFF") return end
-- Create an array to collect our active prompt chunks local chunks = {}
-- 🕒 SERVER TIME if settings.showServerTime then table.insert(chunks, "#Y[*s]") end
-- 🩸 HEALTH SECTOR if settings.showHealth then if settings.showHealthPercentages then table.insert(chunks, "*h#W(#G*%h#W)#Gh#W") else table.insert(chunks, "*h#Gh") end end
-- 💧 MANA SECTOR if settings.showMana then if settings.showManaPercentages then table.insert(chunks, "*m#W(#G*%m#W)#Cm#G#W") else table.insert(chunks, "*m#Cm") end end
-- 🧠 WILLPOWER SECTOR if settings.showWillpower then if settings.showWillpowerPercentages then table.insert(chunks, "#W(#G*%w#W)#Mw#G#W") else table.insert(chunks, "*w#Mw") end end
-- 🏃 ENDURANCE SECTOR if settings.showEndurance then if settings.showEndurancePercentages then table.insert(chunks, "#W(#G*%e#W)#Ye#G#W") else table.insert(chunks, "*e#Ye") end end
-- ⚔️ SYSTEM CORE STATUS (Balances, defenses, and custom profession resources) local coreTokens = ""
if settings.showCoreBalances then coreTokens = coreTokens .. "#w*b" -- "e" (Equilibrium) and "x" (Physical Balance) end
if settings.showCoreDefences then coreTokens = coreTokens .. "*d" -- "b" (Blind), "d" (Deaf), "k" (Kola), "c" (Cloak) end
if settings.showClassBalances then coreTokens = coreTokens .. "*c" end
if settings.showKnightResources then coreTokens = coreTokens .. "*k" end
if #coreTokens > 0 then table.insert(chunks, coreTokens) end
-- 🌋 CLASS RESOURCES & COOLDOWNS (Like Rage) if settings.showBattleRage then table.insert(chunks, "#R*R") end
if settings.showMorph then table.insert(chunks, "#m*a") -- Tracks current transformation morph state end
-- 🌍 ENVIRONMENT & LOCATION DATA if settings.showEnvironment then -- Displays indoors/outdoors (*i) and elevation level (*v) table.insert(chunks, "#wLoc:#G*i #wElv:#c*v") end
-- 📊 PROGRESS TRACKING if settings.showExpRank then table.insert(chunks, "#g[Rank:*x]") end
-- 🎯 ENEMY TRACKING SECTOR -- Only inserts tracking formatting if an active target exists to prevent empty empty strings like '-(())-'
if settings.showEnemyName then table.insert(chunks, "#W*t") end
if settings.showEnemyHealth then table.insert(chunks, "#W*T") end
-- 2. Stitch and send to the server local promptstring = table.concat(chunks, " ") send("CONFIG PROMPT CUSTOM " .. promptstring)
-- 3. AUTOMATED HOUSEKEEPING saveTableToJSON(settings, "settings") if menuServerSettings then menuServerSettings() end
debugEcho("yellow","[PROMPT ENGINE] Sent Layout: " .. promptstring)
end

Script.name: load Curing Queue
Script.script:
-- Initialize an empty table to serve as the prototype for the queue local queue = {}
-- Set the metatable index to allow 'queue' to serve as its own prototype queue.__index = queue
-- Constructor for a new queue function queue:new() local obj = {items = {}, heap = {}, nodes = {}} setmetatable(obj, self) return obj end
-- Initialize 'remedy' with a new instance of 'queue' if 'remedy' is nil or false remedy = remedy or queue:new()
-- Method to clear all items from the queue function queue:clear() self.items = {} self.heap = {} self.nodes = {} end
-- Method to get the size of the queue function queue:size() return #self.items end
-- Method to reset the queue (same as clearing it) function queue:reset() self:clear() end
-- Print the queued command for debugging function queue:echo(command) cecho("\n<DarkSlateGray>CURING COMMAND: <white>- <PowderBlue>" .. command:upper() .. "\n") end
-- Check if any blockers are active for a cure function queue:blockers(cure) if not cure.blockers or #cure.blockers == 0 then return false end
local blockersSet = {} for _, blocker in ipairs(cure.blockers) do blockersSet[blocker] = true end
for _, aff in ipairs(myaffs) do if blockersSet[aff] then return true end end
return false end
-- Select the best cure type based on priorities function queue:priority(cures, affliction, priority) local commands = {} local numPriority = tonumber(priority) or 25
-- Construct command structure with required fields for _, cure in ipairs(cures or {}) do table.insert(commands, { type = cure.type, command = cure.command, cooldown = cure.cooldown, requires = cure.requires, handle = cure.handle, name = affliction, priority = numPriority, prompt = cure.prompt, blockers = cure.blockers }) end
-- Sort commands based on priority safely table.sort(commands, function(a, b) return (a.priority or 25) < (b.priority or 25) end)
return commands end
-- Create a table of afflictions sorted by priority function queue:createLocalAffs() local localAffs = {}
for _, affliction in ipairs(myaffs) do local affDetails = afflictions[affliction] if affDetails then local p = tonumber(affDetails.priority) or 25 table.insert(localAffs, {name = affliction, priority = p}) end end return localAffs end
-- Sort the local afflictions by priority function queue:sortAfflictionsByPriority(localAffs) table.sort(localAffs, function(a, b) return (a.priority or 25) < (b.priority or 25) end) end
-- Check if an affliction is on cooldown function queue:isCureOnCooldown(affliction) local afflictionPipeline = pipeline.afflictions[affliction] return afflictionPipeline and afflictionPipeline.cooldown_end and os.time() < afflictionPipeline.cooldown_end and afflictionPipeline.in_progress end
-- Get the cooldown time for a cure type function queue:getCureCooldown(cureType) local cureData = balance_data[cureType] return cureData and cureData.avg_time or 0.08 end
-- Check if a cure is valid based on required balances, cooldowns, and blockers function queue:isCureValid(cure) local hasRequiredBalance, hasRequiredCooldown = true, true
-- Check balance requirements if type(cure.requires) == "table" then for _, balance in ipairs(cure.requires) do if not balance_data[balance] or balance_data[balance].in_use then hasRequiredBalance = false break end end elseif type(cure.requires) == "string" then if not balance_data[cure.requires] or balance_data[cure.requires].in_use then hasRequiredBalance = false end end
-- Check cooldown requirements if type(cure.cooldown) == "table" then for _, cooldown in ipairs(cure.cooldown) do if not balance_data[cooldown] or balance_data[cooldown].in_use then hasRequiredCooldown = false break end end elseif type(cure.cooldown) == "string" then if not balance_data[cure.cooldown] or balance_data[cure.cooldown].in_use then hasRequiredCooldown = false end end
-- Ensure there are no active blockers return hasRequiredBalance and hasRequiredCooldown and not self:blockers(cure) end
function queue:clearPipelineOnCommand(balanceType) for affliction, cureData in pairs(pipeline.afflictions) do if cureData.curetype == balanceType then pipeline.afflictions[affliction] = nil
if settings.debug then self:echo("Cleared pipeline entry for " .. affliction .. " due to cure type: " .. balanceType) end end end end
function queue:process() if not settings.systemLoaded or settings.systemPaused or (balance_data.stunned and balance_data.stunned.in_use) then return end
local afflictionData = afflictions local localAffs = self:createLocalAffs() self:sortAfflictionsByPriority(localAffs)
local validCures = {} local usedCureTypes = {} local seenCommands = {}
for _, affData in ipairs(localAffs) do local affliction = affData.name local details = afflictionData[affliction]
if details and not self:isCureOnCooldown(affliction) then local bestCure = self:processCure(affliction, details)
if bestCure then local cureType = bestCure.type local existingCure = usedCureTypes[cureType]
if not existingCure or affData.priority < existingCure.priority then usedCureTypes[cureType] = bestCure end end end end
for _, bestCure in pairs(usedCureTypes) do local command if type(bestCure.command) == "table" then command = table.concat(bestCure.command, ", ") else command = tostring(bestCure.command) end
local cureKey = command .. ":" .. bestCure.name
if not seenCommands[cureKey] then seenCommands[cureKey] = true table.insert(validCures, bestCure) end end
if settings.debug then self:echo("---- Valid Cures Processed ----") for _, cure in ipairs(validCures) do self:echo(string.format("Command: %s | Affliction: %s", type(cure.command) == "table" and table.concat(cure.command, ", ") or cure.command, cure.name)) end end
if #validCures > 0 then if settings.batching then self:sendBatchCures(validCures) else self:sendSingleCure(validCures[1]) end end end
function queue:sendSingleCure(cure) local pipelineAfflictions = pipeline.afflictions local curingList = curinglist local afflictionData = afflictions local currentTime = os.time() local networkLatency = getNetworkLatency() local nonPrioritizedCures = { "herb", "salve", "smoke", "writhe", "wake", "balance" } local affliction = cure.name local cureType = cure.type local command = cure.command
if cureType == "herb" or cureType == "smoke" then command = settings.cureMethod == "alchemical" and cure.command.alchemical or cure.command.herbal end
if pipelineAfflictions[affliction] then if settings.debug then self:echo("Cure type already in progress for: " .. affliction) end return end
-- Server-side automated system priorities mapping if table.contains(nonPrioritizedCures, cureType) then local currentSlot1Aff = nil
for aff, prio in pairs(curingList) do if tonumber(prio) == 1 then currentSlot1Aff = aff break end end
if currentSlot1Aff and currentSlot1Aff ~= affliction then local defaultPriority = afflictionData[currentSlot1Aff] and tonumber(afflictionData[currentSlot1Aff].priority) or 25 if (tonumber(curingList[currentSlot1Aff]) or 25) ~= defaultPriority then if settings.debug then self:echo("Reset " .. currentSlot1Aff .. " to default priority " .. defaultPriority) end end end
if (tonumber(curingList[affliction]) or 25) ~= 1 then if not sentPriorityCommands[affliction] then sentPriorityCommands[affliction] = true send("curing prio " .. affliction .. " 1") if settings.debug then self:echo("Set " .. affliction .. " to priority 1.") end end end end
-- Opt-out check for automated native server rules local cmd_str = tostring(command):lower() if (cmd_str == "touch tree" and settings.tree == true) or (cmd_str == "focus" and settings.focus == true) then if settings.debug then self:echo("<yellow>Skipping client command: " .. command .. " (Server Opt-Out Active)</yellow>") end return end
-- ✅ FIXED: Pipeline tracking and sending execution block completely decoupled -- This ensures commands like stand, writhe, and wake execute safely. pipelineAfflictions[affliction] = { name = affliction, command = command, in_progress = true, curetype = cureType, cooldown_end = currentTime + self:getCureCooldown(cureType) + networkLatency, priority = afflictionData[affliction] and tonumber(afflictionData[affliction].priority) or 25 }
if settings.debug then self:echo("Sending cure command: " .. command) end send(command) end
function queue:sendBatchCures(validCures) local cs = settings.cmdsep local serverCommands = {} local batchCommands = {} local seenBatchCommands = {} local usedCureTypes = {} local pipelineAfflictions = pipeline.afflictions local curingList = curinglist local afflictionData = afflictions local currentTime = os.time() local networkLatency = getNetworkLatency() local nonPrioritizedCures = { "herb", "salve", "smoke", "writhe", "wake", "balance" } local highestPrioAff = nil local highestPriority = 25
for _, cure in ipairs(validCures) do local affliction = cure.name local cureType = cure.type local affPriority = afflictionData[affliction] and tonumber(afflictionData[affliction].priority) or 25
if not pipelineAfflictions[affliction] and not usedCureTypes[cureType] and table.contains(nonPrioritizedCures, cureType) then if affPriority < highestPriority then highestPrioAff = affliction highestPriority = affPriority end end end
if highestPrioAff then local command = "curing prio " .. highestPrioAff .. " 1" if not sentPriorityCommands[highestPrioAff] then if (tonumber(curingList[highestPrioAff]) or 25) ~= 1 then sentPriorityCommands[highestPrioAff] = true table.insert(serverCommands, command) end end end
if #serverCommands > 0 then while #serverCommands > 4 do table.remove(serverCommands) end send(table.concat(serverCommands, cs)) if settings.debug then self:echo("Sent priority commands: " .. table.concat(serverCommands, cs)) end end
for _, cure in ipairs(validCures) do local affliction = cure.name local cureType = cure.type local command = cure.command
if cureType == "herb" or cureType == "smoke" then command = settings.cureMethod == "alchemical" and cure.command.alchemical or cure.command.herbal end
local cmd_str = tostring(command):lower()
if (cmd_str == "touch tree" and settings.tree == true) or (cmd_str == "focus" and settings.focus == true) then if settings.debug then self:echo("<yellow>Skipping batch command: " .. command .. " (Server Opt-Out Active)</yellow>") end else if not pipelineAfflictions[affliction] and not usedCureTypes[cureType] and not seenBatchCommands[command] then local affPriority = afflictionData[affliction] and tonumber(afflictionData[affliction].priority) or 25
pipelineAfflictions[affliction] = { name = affliction, command = command, in_progress = true, curetype = cureType, cooldown_end = currentTime + self:getCureCooldown(cureType) + networkLatency, priority = affPriority }
seenBatchCommands[command] = true table.insert(batchCommands, command) usedCureTypes[cureType] = true end end end
if #batchCommands > 0 then while #batchCommands > 10 do table.remove(batchCommands) end send(table.concat(batchCommands, cs)) end end
function queue:setAfflictionPriorities() local afflictionCommands = {} local priority = 0
cecho("<yellow>\nStarting affliction iteration...<reset>") for affliction, data in pairs(afflictions) do priority = 0
if table.contains({"fear", "aeon", "entangled", "blackout", "bound", "daeggerimpale", "impaled", "sleeping", "transfixation", "voyria", "webbed", "prone", "disrupted"}, affliction) then priority = 2 elseif data and data.priority then priority = tonumber(data.priority) or 25 else cecho("<red>Warning: No priority set for affliction '" .. affliction .. "'. Defaulting to 0.<reset>\n") end
if data.cures and data.cures[1] and data.cures[1].type == "time" then table.insert(afflictionCommands, "curing prio " .. affliction .. " 26") afflictions[affliction].priority = 26 else table.insert(afflictionCommands, "curing prio " .. affliction .. " " .. priority) afflictions[affliction].priority = priority end end
scheduleBatchProcessing(afflictionCommands) end
function scheduleBatchProcessing(afflictionCommands) local maxCommandsPerBatch = 4 local totalCommands = #afflictionCommands local delayStep = 1.3 local sendTime = 0 local totalBatches = math.ceil(totalCommands / maxCommandsPerBatch) local currentBatch = 0
for i = 1, totalCommands, maxCommandsPerBatch do local batchEndIndex = math.min(i + maxCommandsPerBatch - 1, totalCommands) local batch = {}
for j = i, batchEndIndex do table.insert(batch, afflictionCommands[j]) end
sendTime = sendTime + delayStep currentBatch = currentBatch + 1 local thisBatch = currentBatch
tempTimer(sendTime, function() sendBatch(batch)
if thisBatch == totalBatches then tempTimer(3, function() cecho("\n<green>[SUCCESS]: <white>Hard Reset Complete.") cecho("\n<white>All <yellow>" .. totalCommands .. " <white>priorities are now synced to the server.") cecho("\n<cyan>" .. gmcp.Char.Name.name .. "<white>, is ready for combat.<reset>") cecho("\n<white>[ ") cechoLink("<green>CLICK TO VIEW PRIORITIES", [[send("curing prio list")]], "View List", true) cecho("<white> ]\n")
saveTableToJSON(curinglist, "curinglist") end) end end) end
cecho("\n<white>[<yellow>SYSTEM<white>]: Hard Reset initiated. (ETA: <yellow>" .. math.ceil(sendTime) .. "s) \n<cyan>Syncing <white>" .. totalBatches .. " <cyan>batches in background (Gagged).\n<reset>") end
function sendBatch(batch) local cs = ";" local batchString = table.concat(batch, cs)
if batchString and batchString ~= "" then send(batchString, false) end end
function updateCuringListPriorities() for affliction, data in pairs(afflictions) do if data.cures and data.cures[1] and data.cures[1].type == "time" then curinglist[affliction] = 26 else curinglist[affliction] = tonumber(data.priority) or 25 end end end
function queue:processCure(affliction, details) local prioritizedCures = self:priority(details.cures, affliction, details.priority)
for _, cure in ipairs(prioritizedCures) do if self:isCureValid(cure) then return cure end end return nil end
function onCureSuccess(affliction) if pipeline.afflictions[affliction] then pipeline.afflictions[affliction] = nil end end
function onCureFail(affliction) if pipeline.afflictions[affliction] then pipeline.afflictions[affliction] = nil end end
function resetCuringProcess() pipeline.afflictions = {}
for _, affliction in pairs(myaffs) do if pipeline.afflictions[affliction] then pipeline.afflictions[affliction].in_progress = false pipeline.afflictions[affliction].attempts = 0 end end end

Script.name: load Defences Queue
Script.script:
-- Initialize an empty table to serve as the prototype for the queue. local queue = {}
-- Set the metatable index to allow 'queue' to serve as its own prototype. queue.__index = queue
-- Constructor for a new queue
function queue:new() local obj = {items = {}, heap = {}, nodes = {}} setmetatable(obj, self) return obj
end
-- Initialize 'defenses' with a new instance of 'queue' if 'defenses' is nil or false. fortify = fortify or queue:new()
-- Method to clear all items from the queue
function queue:clear() self.items = {} self.heap = {} self.nodes = {} end
-- Method to get the size of the queue
function queue:size() return #self.items end
-- Method to reset the queue
function queue:reset() self:clear() end
-- Print the defense command for debugging
function queue:echo(command)
cecho("\n<DarkSlateGray>DEFENSE COMMAND: <white>- <PowderBlue>" .. command:upper() .. "\n")
end
-- Check if queue already contains special key in heap.
function queue:contains(item)
local key = item.type .. "-" .. item.name
return self.nodes[key] ~= nil
end
-- Helper method to check if active afflictions block a new detail
function queue:blockers(blockers)
for _, blocker in ipairs(blockers) do
for _, aff in ipairs(myaffs) do
if aff == blocker then
return true
end
end
end
return false
end
function fortify:update(defense, value) -- 1. Track down the true unique table key and clean name matching this defense identifier local targetKey = nil local plainName = nil local currentClass = PLAYER:myclass() local baseSkills = skillTreeList[currentClass] or {}
for key, details in pairs(defenses) do -- FIX: Check if the incoming string matches the plain name OR the literal table key if details.name == defense or key == defense then targetKey = key plainName = details.name -- Pull the true clean name (e.g., "astralvision")
-- If it belongs to one of our active class skill groups, we found our perfect match! if table.contains(baseSkills, details.type) then targetKey = key plainName = details.name break -- Exit early, we have our exact class-specific skill match end end end
-- Fallbacks to maintain system stability if no match was found in the table data local activeKey = targetKey or defense local trackingName = plainName or defense
if defenses[activeKey] then if settings.debug then queue:echo("Updating defense: " .. activeKey) end else if defense == "tree" then if settings.debug then queue:echo("TREE GONE - <white>GET A PERMA TATTOO!!!") end else if settings.debug then queue:echo("No such defense found in defenses table: " .. tostring(defense)) end end end
if value then -- FIXED: Always use the clean name (e.g., "astralvision") for tracking array synchronization if not table.contains(mydefs, trackingName) then table.insert(mydefs, trackingName) end
-- FIXED: Clears BOTH the raw input string AND the resolved tracking name from the pipeline pipeline.defenses[defense] = nil pipeline.defenses[trackingName] = nil pipeline.activeCommand = ""
if defenses[activeKey] then defenses[activeKey].active = value defenses[activeKey].enabled = value end
if settings.debug then queue:echo("Cleared pipeline key: " .. tostring(trackingName)) end else -- FIXED: Removes the clean tracking name from active array records when dropped if table.contains(mydefs, trackingName) then table.remove(mydefs, table.index_of(mydefs, trackingName)) end
-- FIXED: Clears BOTH variations from the pipeline table on negative updates pipeline.defenses[defense] = nil pipeline.defenses[trackingName] = nil
if defenses[activeKey] then defenses[activeKey].active = value defenses[activeKey].enabled = value end end end
function fortify:relax() local cs = settings.cmdsep local currentClassType = PLAYER:myclass() local validSkillTree = skillTreeList[currentClassType] local list = table.n_union(validSkillTree, {"vision", "free", "survival", "herb", "salve", "smoke", "tattoo", "yourMissingType1", "yourMissingType2"}) local relaxCommands = {}
-- Iterate over each defense for defenseName, defense in pairs(defenses) do -- Check the conditions safely if defense.active and string.find(defense.relax or "", "relax") and table.contains(list, defense.type) and (defense.drain == "mana" or defense.drain == "endurance") and not (defense.type == "blindness" or defense.type == "deafness" or defense.type == "insomnia") then
-- Add the relax command to the list table.insert(relaxCommands, defense.relax) end end
-- Send all relax commands if any were found if #relaxCommands > 0 then local relaxCommandString = table.concat(relaxCommands, cs) send(relaxCommandString) else echo("No relax commands to send.") end end
-- Method to remove and return the highest priority item function queue:pop() if #self.items == 0 then print("Queue is empty") return nil end
-- Remove the highest priority item (first item in the sorted list) local item = table.remove(self.items, 1) local key = item.type .. "-" .. item.name self.nodes[key] = nil
-- Update the nodes table to reflect the new indices of remaining items for i, v in ipairs(self.items) do local k = v.type .. "-" .. v.name self.nodes[k] = i end
return item end
function queue:process() if not settings.systemLoaded or settings.systemPaused or balance_data.stunned.in_use then return end
fortify:reset()
-- 1. Build the list of allowed skills dynamically based on class local currentClassType = PLAYER:myclass() local baseSkills = {}
if currentClassType == "monk" then if type(updateMonkSubclass) == "function" then updateMonkSubclass() end if skillTreeList["monk"] then for _, skill in ipairs(skillTreeList["monk"]) do if skill ~= "tekura" and skill ~= "shikudo" then table.insert(baseSkills, skill) end end end if monkSubclass then table.insert(baseSkills, monkSubclass) end else baseSkills = skillTreeList[currentClassType] or {} end
local list = table.n_union(baseSkills, {"vision", "free", "survival", "herb", "salve", "smoke", "tattoo", "resistance"}) local validDefenses = {}
-- 2. Filter the global defenses table for candidates for defenseKey, details in pairs(defenses) do local defenseType = details.type
-- Handle multi-type defenses (e.g. skills that belong to multiple trees) if type(defenseType) == "table" then for _, v in ipairs(defenseType) do if table.contains(baseSkills, v) then defenseType = v break end end end
-- FIXED: Check details.name against mydefs instead of the unique table key string if table.contains(list, defenseType) and not table.contains(mydefs, details.name) then local hasRequiredBalance, hasRequiredCooldown = true, true
-- Balance Checks for _, balance in ipairs(details.requires or {}) do if not balance_data[balance] or balance_data[balance].in_use then hasRequiredBalance = false break end end
-- Cooldown Checks for _, cooldown in ipairs(details.cooldown or {}) do if not balance_data[cooldown] or balance_data[cooldown].in_use then hasRequiredCooldown = false break end end
-- If balances are up, check if this defense is flagged to be queued if hasRequiredBalance and hasRequiredCooldown then if ((details.enabled and defupmode) or (not defupmode and details.keepup)) and not details.active then table.insert(validDefenses, details) end end end end
-- 3. Sort candidates safely to prevent invalid order function crashes table.sort(validDefenses, function(a, b) local valA = tonumber(a.priority) or 25 local valB = tonumber(b.priority) or 25 return valA < valB end)
-- 4. THE PROMPT & STATE SYNC if table.is_empty(pipeline.defenses) and #validDefenses == 0 then if defupmode then defupmode = false if settings.debug then cecho("\n<green>[SYSTEM]: All defenses active. DEFUP cleared.") end updatePrompt() end end
-- 5. Execution Logic if #validDefenses > 0 then local bestDefense = validDefenses[1]
-- If we aren't already waiting for this specific defense to land on the server... if not pipeline.defenses[bestDefense.name] then pipeline.defenses[bestDefense.name] = true pipeline.activeCommand = bestDefense.command
if settings.debug then self:echo("Sending Defense: " .. bestDefense.name) end
-- Send to the server via your system's sender self:send(bestDefense) end end end
function queue:debugPipeline() if settings.debug then self:echo("Pipeline contents:") end for k, v in pairs(pipeline.defenses) do if settings.debug then cecho("\n<white> - " .. k) end end end
function queue:send(defense) local command = defense.command
if not defense.name then if settings.debug then cecho("\n<red>[ERROR] Defense is missing name!") end return end
-- Adjust command if herbal/alchemical if defense.type == "herb" or defense.type == "smoke" then command = settings.cureMethod == "alchemical" and defense.command.alchemical or defense.command.herbal end
send(command)
-- Defenses that are delayed in confirming local delayed = { "levitating", "insulation", "speed", "poisonresist", "fangbarrier", "rebounding", "density", "dragonbreath" }
local isDelayed = table.contains(delayed, defense.name)
if isDelayed then -- Manually simulate GMCP if not table.contains(mydefs, defense.name) then table.insert(mydefs, defense.name) end
if defenses[defense.name] then defenses[defense.name].active = true defenses[defense.name].enabled = true end
-- Actually tell the system this was successfully applied fortify:update(defense.name, true)
if settings.debug then self:echo("Marked delayed defense as active and cleared key:", defense.name) end end
self:debugPipeline() return end
-- Initialize cleanup timer once lastPipelineCleanup = lastPipelineCleanup or 0
function queue:cleanPipeline() local now = os.clock() if now - lastPipelineCleanup < 2 then return end -- throttle to every 2 seconds lastPipelineCleanup = now
local cleaned = 0 local currentClass = PLAYER:myclass() local baseSkills = skillTreeList[currentClass] or {}
for name, _ in pairs(pipeline.defenses) do -- 🔍 Look up the true tracking entry by details.name and class matching local def = nil for _, details in pairs(defenses) do if details.name == name then def = details -- Fallback match if table.contains(baseSkills, details.type) then def = details break -- Exact class skill found end end end
-- FIXED: Successfully validates the active status of class-appended keys if def and not def.active and not table.contains(mydefs, name) then pipeline.defenses[name] = nil cleaned = cleaned + 1 end end
if cleaned > 0 then if settings.debug then self:echo("Cleaned " .. cleaned .. " stale pipeline entr" .. (cleaned == 1 and "y." or "ies.")) end end end

Script.name: load Hunting File
Script.script:
function toggleHuntingMode(mode) mode = mode or "manual"
if mode == "manual" then hunting = not hunting
if hunting then defenses.hiding.keepup = false if PLAYER:myclass() == "serpent" then send("emerge") end GUI.datawindow:activateTab("Room") huntTargetCooldown = false huntStart() cecho("\n<white>(<gold>Hunt<white>): <green>Hunting Enabled") else defenses.hiding.keepup = true cecho("\n<white>(<gold>Hunt<white>): <red>Hunting Disabled") end
elseif mode == "auto" then autohunting = not autohunting
if autohunting then cecho("\n<white>(<gold>Hunt<white>): <green>Auto Hunting Enabled") send("look") else cecho("\n<white>(<gold>Hunt<white>): <red>Auto Hunting Disabled") end
else cecho("<red>[ERROR] Unknown hunting mode: " .. tostring(mode) .. "\n") end end
function loadHuntMasterList()
local jsonDir = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/json/" local savePath = jsonDir .. "/huntmasterlist.json"
if io.exists(savePath) then local f = io.open(savePath, "r") if f then local contents = f:read("*a") f:close() local decoded, _, err = dkjson.decode(contents, 1, nil) if not err and type(decoded) == "table" and not table.is_empty(decoded) then targetMasterList = decoded return true end end end return false end
function saveTargetMasterList()
if not dkjson or not targetMasterList or table.is_empty(targetMasterList) then return end local jsonDir = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/json/" local savePath = jsonDir .. "/huntmasterlist.json"
local json = dkjson.encode(targetMasterList, { indent = true }) local f = io.open(savePath, "w") if f then f:write(json) f:close() end end
-- Check if the character is alone in the room.
function isAloneInRoom() if not table.contains(myaffs, "blackout") then if #gmcp.Room.Players <= 1 then return true else return false end end end
function isTargetAlive(target) return findkey(roomstufflist, target) end
function findNextHuntTarget() local target = lasthunttarget or "" local targetimportance = 99 local targetPriorityList = updateDenizenPriorities() for k, v in pairs(extermlist) do if findkey(roomstufflist, k) then local denizenPriority = targetPriorityList[v[1]] if type(denizenPriority) == "number" or (type(denizenPriority) == "string" and denizenPriority ~= "ignored") then if k == lasthunttarget then target = lasthunttarget targetimportance = -1000 end local numericPriority = tonumber(denizenPriority) or 99 -- default to 99 if not a number if numericPriority < targetimportance then target = k targetimportance = numericPriority end end end end return target end
function hasMoreHuntTargets(target)
local ignore = { ["a sharp-toothed gremlin"] = true, ["some other name"] = true }
local function roomHasNonIgnoredTargets() for _, item in pairs(inv_room or {}) do if not ignore[item.name] then return true -- found a valid (non-ignored) target end end return false end
--local hasMoreTargets = not (target == "") and not (table.is_empty(roomstufflist)) local hasMoreTargets = target ~= "" and not table.is_empty(roomstufflist) and roomHasNonIgnoredTargets()
debugEcho("white", string.format("Has more hunt targets: %s", tostring(hasMoreTargets))) return hasMoreTargets end
function attemptHuntSettingsRestore()
local jsonDir = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/json/" local backupPath = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/backup/huntsettings.json.bak"
if not fileExists(backupPath) then cecho("<red>[ERROR] Backup file not found: " .. backupPath .. "\n") cecho("<white>Please reconfigure your hunt settings manually using: <cyan>hunt configure\n") return false end
local f = io.open(backupPath, "r") if not f then cecho("<red>[ERROR] Could not open backup file for reading.\n") cecho("<white>Please reconfigure your hunt settings manually using: <cyan>hunt configure\n") return false end
local contents = f:read("*a") f:close()
local decoded, _, err = dkjson.decode(contents, 1, nil) if not err and type(decoded) == "table" then huntSettingsData = decoded cecho("<green>[SUCCESS] Restored hunt settings from backup.\n") return true else cecho("<red>[ERROR] Failed to decode huntsettings.json.bak: " .. function handleTargetsAndAttacks() updateWhoHere()
if not settings.systemLoaded or settings.systemPaused or inslowcuringmode() or balance_data.stunned.in_use then return end
-- 🎯 TARGET ACQUISITION -- Added a clear check: If we have NO target, or our target isn't in the room anymore, -- bypass the cooldown entirely to snap onto a living target instantly! local targetPresent = findkey(roomstufflist, target)
if not huntTargetCooldown or target == "" or not targetPresent or target == "none" then local nextTarget = findNextHuntTarget() if nextTarget and nextTarget ~= "" and nextTarget ~= target then target = nextTarget lasthunttarget = nextTarget send("settarget " .. target) hunttarget = target
huntTargetCooldown = true tempTimer(1.2, function() huntTargetCooldown = false end) elseif nextTarget == "" then -- Clear targets safely if the room is completely dead/empty target = "none" hunttarget = "none" end end
if huntSettingsData == nil then cecho("<yellow>[INFO] Hunt settings nil. Attempting to restore from backup.\n") local success = attemptHuntSettingsRestore() cecho((success and "<green>Hunt Restore Successful\n") or "<red>Hunt Restore Unsuccessful\n") end
-- ⚔️ COMBAT EXECUTION -- Ensure we aren't firing attacks into the ether if target is cleared to 'none' if target ~= "" and target ~= "none" and hasMoreHuntTargets(target) then handleRegularAttacks(target) handleBattlerageAttacks(target) end end
-- Main function to handle shield attacks. function handleShieldAttacks(target) -- 🛡️ Safeguard Gate: Prevent duplicate execution spam if shieldCommandSent then return end
-- Normalize Class/Form Keys local class = PLAYER:myclass() if type(class) == "string" then class = class:lower() else class = "" end
if class == "dragon" and gmcp.Char.Status.race then class = string.match(gmcp.Char.Status.race, "%a+"):lower() .. " dragon" elseif class == "monk" then -- 🥋 Dynamically update tracking state to detect "shikudo" or "tekura" updateMonkSubclass() end
-- Route database checks to the correct profile key while keeping 'class' as "monk" local profileKey = (class == "monk") and (monkSubclass or "shikudo") or class
-- Safeguard validation: Tekura behaves like every normal class, Shikudo slides right past! if not huntSettingsData[profileKey] and profileKey ~= "shikudo" then debugEcho("red", "Error: Class profile not found in huntSettingsData: " .. tostring(profileKey)) return end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- 🎯 TARGET FALLBACK SEQUENCE --------------------------------------------------------- local activeTarget = target
if type(activeTarget) ~= "string" or activeTarget == "" then activeTarget = (type(hunttarget) == "string" and hunttarget ~= "") and hunttarget or target end
-- Clean up wrapping types safely local currentTarget = type(activeTarget) == "string" and activeTarget or ""
-- Safeguard: If no target is tracked anywhere, abort to prevent bad command lines if currentTarget == "" or currentTarget == "none" then debugEcho("yellow", "Shield attack aborted: No active hunt target found.") return end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- ⚔️ COMBAT FORK --------------------------------------------------------- -- Standard database check for Battlerage shield breaks using our decoupled profileKey if huntSettingsData[profileKey] and huntSettingsData[profileKey]["rage shield break"] then local rageFired = tryBattleRageShieldBreak(profileKey, currentTarget) if rageFired then return end end
-- Passes your unmutated "monk" string downstream to your combo engine functions tryRegularShieldBreak(class, currentTarget) end
function tryRegularShieldBreak(class, currentTarget) -- 🚨 DEBUG START debugEcho("white", "Function tryRegularShieldBreak() called!") debugEcho("white", "Raw 'class' passed: <cyan>" .. tostring(class) .. "<white> | Raw 'currentTarget': <cyan>" .. tostring(currentTarget))
-- Safely parse out the target wildcards local cleanTarget = type(currentTarget) == "string" and currentTarget or "" debugEcho("white", "Processed cleanTarget: <cyan>" .. tostring(cleanTarget))
-- 🥋 MONK SUBCLASS RECOGNITION (Without modifying the 'class' variable) if class == "monk" then debugEcho("yellow", "Raw class is 'monk'. Refreshing tracker data...") -- Dynamically update tracking state to detect "shikudo" or "tekura" updateMonkSubclass() -- Default to 'tekura' if tracking variable is missing/unset monkSubclass = monkSubclass or "tekura" debugEcho("yellow", "Active Monk Subclass evaluated as: <cyan>" .. tostring(monkSubclass)) end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- 🥋 SHIKUDO MONK SHIELD BREAK --------------------------------------------------------- -- Check explicitly against the tracking variable instead of class if class == "monk" and monkSubclass == "shikudo" then debugEcho("green", "Success! Entered the Shikudo conditional block.")
-- Fallback initialization if variables are missing stance = stance or "oak" local targetCommand = "" debugEcho("green", "Current tracked stance value: <cyan>" .. tostring(stance))
if cleanTarget == "" then debugEcho("red", "Aborting: cleanTarget is an empty string!") debugEcho("yellow", "Error: No valid target for Shikudo shield break.") return false end
-- Dynamically build the shield-breaking combo based on the current stance if stance == "willow" then debugEcho("green", "Building Willow stance combo...") targetCommand = "queue addclear eqbal combo " .. tostring(cleanTarget) .. " shatter flashheel left hiraku" elseif stance == "rain" then debugEcho("green", "Building Rain stance combo...") targetCommand = "queue addclear eqbal combo " .. tostring(cleanTarget) .. " shatter frontkick left kuro right" elseif stance == "oak" then debugEcho("green", "Building Oak stance combo...") targetCommand = "queue addclear eqbal combo " .. tostring(cleanTarget) .. " shatter nervestrike risingkick head" else debugEcho("red", "Error: Invalid stance value during shield break: " .. tostring(stance)) return false end
debugEcho("white", "Target command built: <cyan>" .. tostring(targetCommand))
-- Send the command immediately down the pipe shieldCommandSent = true send(targetCommand)
-- Force a high-visibility line write to the main console screen debugEcho("green", "SUCCESS GATE REACHED! Command sent to game: " .. targetCommand .. "\n") return true end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- ⚔️ STANDARD CLASS LOGIC (Includes Tekura Monk branch) --------------------------------------------------------- -- Route database checks to the correct profile key while keeping 'class' pristine local lookupKey = (class == "monk") and monkSubclass or class local regularCmd = huntSettingsData[lookupKey] and huntSettingsData[lookupKey]["regular shield break"]
if not regularCmd or regularCmd == "" then debugEcho("yellow", "Shield break configuration missing or empty for " .. tostring(lookupKey)) return false end
if cleanTarget ~= "" then regularCmd = string.gsub(regularCmd, "@tar", cleanTarget) end
local targetCommand = "queue add eqbal " .. regularCmd
-- Send the entire line down the network pipe at once shieldCommandSent = true send(targetCommand) debugEcho("green", "Shield break command sent successfully: " .. targetCommand) return true end
function tryBattleRageShieldBreak(class, currentTarget) if not bragelist or not bragelist[class] then return false end
for skill, data in pairs(bragelist[class]) do if data.enabled and data.type == "shield break" and battlerage() >= data.rage then if not balance_data.balance.in_use then local attackString = data.command
if currentTarget ~= "" then attackString = string.gsub(attackString, "@tar", currentTarget) end
send(attackString) shieldCommandSent = true debugEcho("green", "[BRAGE] Sent pure shield break: " .. attackString) return true else debugEcho("yellow", "[BRAGE] Balance not ready for rage shield break.") end end end
return false end
function handleBattlerageAttacks(target) if shielded then debugEcho("yellow","[BRAGE] Target is shielded — not sending rage attack.") return end
local class = PLAYER:myclass() if class == "dragon" and gmcp.Char.Status.race then class = string.match(gmcp.Char.Status.race, "%a+"):lower() .. " dragon" end
if not bragelist[class] then return end
local sortedSkills = {}
for skill, data in pairs(bragelist[class]) do if data.enabled and type(data.type) == "number" and battlerage() >= data.rage then table.insert(sortedSkills, { priority = data.type, skill = skill, rage = data.rage, command = data.command, }) end end
table.sort(sortedSkills, function(a, b) if a.priority == b.priority then return a.rage > b.rage end return a.priority < b.priority end)
for _, data in ipairs(sortedSkills) do if data.command and not balance_data.balance.in_use then local targetCommand = data.command:gsub("@tar", target) send(targetCommand) debugEcho("green","[BRAGE] Sent rage skill: " .. targetCommand) return end end end

-- OAK STANCE LOGIC elseif stance == "oak" then debugEcho("green","Processing Stance: oak") if tonumber(kata) < 6 then targetCommand = "queue addclear eqbal combo " .. currentTarget .. " livestrike nervestrike risingkick head" debugEcho("green","Kata < 6 combo built.") else targetCommand = "queue addclear eqbal combo " .. currentTarget .. " livestrike nervestrike risingkick head transition willow" debugEcho("green","Kata >= 6 transition combo built.") end else debugEcho("red", "Error: Invalid stance value: " .. tostring(stance)) debugEcho("green","Aborting: Stance name matched nothing (" .. tostring(stance) .. "). Check string casing!") return end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- ⚔️ STANDARD CLASS LOGIC (Includes Tekura Monk branch) --------------------------------------------------------- else cecho("\n<orange>[DEBUG] Inside Standard Class/Tekura Block.")
-- Use an isolated key for data parsing so 'class' remains unmutated local lookupKey = (class == "monk") and monkSubclass or class
-- Debugging and safeguard if not huntSettingsData[lookupKey] then debugEcho("red","Error: Class profile not found in huntSettingsData: " .. tostring(lookupKey)) debugEcho("red","Aborting: huntSettingsData[" .. tostring(lookupKey) .. "] is nil.") return end
-- Validate regular attack configuration if huntSettingsData[lookupKey]["regular attack"] then local attackString = huntSettingsData[lookupKey]["regular attack"]
-- Use Lua's built-in string utility directly on the text line if currentTarget ~= "" then attackString = string.gsub(attackString, "@tar", currentTarget) end
targetCommand = "queue add eqbal " .. attackString debugEcho("orange","Standard command successfully built from DB: " .. targetCommand) else debugEcho("cyan","Configure Regular Hunt Attack (hunt configure)") debugEcho("red","Aborting: ['regular attack'] sub-key is missing in DB.") return end end

-- Function to print denizen priority list function printDenizenPriorityList(area) local area = area or gmcp.Room.Info.area currentPriorityArea = area -- Set the current priority area cecho("\n<green>" .. area .. " - Priority List") cechoLink( " <red>(i) ", function() printAreaHuntList() end, "Show Area Ignore List", true ) echo("\n") local denizens = targetMasterList[area] or {} -- Create a table to store denizens sorted by priority and name local sortedDenizens = {} local ignoredDenizens = {} for denizen, priority in pairs(denizens) do if priority == "ignored" then table.insert(ignoredDenizens, denizen) elseif priority ~= "hidden" then -- Exclude denizens with priority "hidden" table.insert(sortedDenizens, {name = denizen, priority = tonumber(priority)}) end end -- Sort the denizens by priority and name table.sort( sortedDenizens, function(a, b) if a.priority == b.priority then return a.name < b.name else return a.priority < b.priority end end ) -- Print the sorted list for _, denizenData in ipairs(sortedDenizens) do local denizen = denizenData.name local priority = denizenData.priority cechoLink( " <cyan>(+) ", function() setDenizenPriority(denizen, "raise") end, "Raise Priority", true ) cechoLink( " <cyan>(-) ", function() setDenizenPriority(denizen, "lower") end, "Lower Priority", true ) cechoLink( " <red>(i) ", function() setDenizenPriority(denizen, "ignore") end, "Set to Ignore", true ) if priority then cecho(" <white>[<green>" .. priority .. "<white>] " .. denizen .. "\n") else cecho(" " .. denizen .. "\n") end end -- Print ignored denizens last for _, denizen in ipairs(ignoredDenizens) do cechoLink( " <cyan>(+) ", function() setDenizenPriority(denizen, "raise") end, "Raise Priority", true ) cechoLink( " <cyan>(-) ", function() setDenizenPriority(denizen, "lower") end, "Lower Priority", true ) cechoLink( " <red>(i) ", function() setDenizenPriority(denizen, "ignore") end, "Set to Ignore", true ) cecho(" <white>[<red>i<white>] " .. denizen .. -- Function to set area to ignore

end
function setDenizenPriority(denizen, action) local area = gmcp.Room.Info.area
-- Check if the area matches the current priority area if area ~= currentPriorityArea then cecho("<red>Error: You are not currently in the area for this priority list.\n") return end
targetMasterList[area] = targetMasterList[area] or {} if action == "raise" then if targetMasterList[area][denizen] == "ignored" then local lowestPriority = getLowestPriority(targetMasterList[area]) + 1 targetMasterList[area][denizen] = tostring(lowestPriority) else targetMasterList[area][denizen] = math.max(tonumber(targetMasterList[area][denizen] or 1) - 1, 1) end elseif action == "lower" then if targetMasterList[area][denizen] == "ignored" then local lowestPriority = getLowestPriority(targetMasterList[area]) + 1 targetMasterList[area][denizen] = tostring(lowestPriority) else targetMasterList[area][denizen] = tostring(tonumber(targetMasterList[area][denizen] or 0) + 1) end elseif action == "ignore" then if targetMasterList[area][denizen] == "ignored" then targetMasterList[area][denizen] = "hidden" else targetMasterList[area][denizen] = "ignored" end end
saveTargetMasterList() updateDenizenPriorities() echo("\n\n") printDenizenPriorityList() end
-- Function to find the lowest priority in a given area
function getLowestPriority(areaList) local lowestPriority = math.huge for _, priority in pairs(areaList) do if type(priority) == "number" then lowestPriority = math.min(lowestPriority, priority) end end return lowestPriority end
-- Function to get the lowest priority in the targetMasterList
function getLowestPriority(targetList) local lowestPriority = math.huge for _, priority in pairs(targetList) do if type(priority) == "number" then lowestPriority = math.min(lowestPriority, priority) end end -- If lowestPriority is still set to math.huge, return 1 as the default return lowestPriority ~= math.huge and lowestPriority or 1 end
-- Update your local targetPriorityList based on the updated targetMasterList
function updateDenizenPriorities() if not gmcp or not gmcp.Room or not gmcp.Room.Info then return end

function setHuntSettings(type, cmd) local command = tostring(cmd):trim()
-- Match the UI's specialized form tracking logic exactly local class = PLAYER:myclass() if class == "dragon" and gmcp.Char.Status.race then class = string.match(gmcp.Char.Status.race, "%a+"):lower() .. " dragon" elseif class == "monk" then -- 🥋 Dynamically check GMCP for Monk specs (shikudo vs tekura) updateMonkSubclass() class = monkSubclass or "shikudo" end
-- Prevent setting text commands via aliases if the user is running Shikudo if class == "shikudo" and (type == "regular attack" or type == "regular shield break") then cecho("\n<yellow>[SHIKUDO] Manual command bypassed. Your attacks are fully hardcoded and automated!") return end
huntSettingsData = huntSettingsData or {} if not huntSettingsData[class] then huntSettingsData[class] = {} end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- 🎯 LITERAL PASSTHROUGH LAYER --------------------------------------------------------- if type == "regular attack" then huntSettingsData[class]["regular attack"] = command cecho("\n<green>You set your regular attack command successfully for " .. class:title()) setHuntSettingsData() elseif type == "regular shield break" then huntSettingsData[class]["regular shield break"] = command cecho("\n<green>You set your regular shield break command successfully for " .. class:title()) setHuntSettingsData() elseif type == "rage shield break" then local checkCmd = command:lower():trim() if checkCmd == "yes" or checkCmd == "true" then huntSettingsData[class]["rage shield break"] = true else huntSettingsData[class]["rage shield break"] = false end printBattleragePriorityList() cecho("\n<green>You set your hunt rage shield command successfully for " .. class:title()) end

function saveHuntSettings()
if not dkjson then cecho("<red>[ERROR] dkjson not loaded. Cannot save hunting data.\n") return end
if not huntSettingsData or type(huntSettingsData) ~= "table" then cecho("<yellow>[WARNING] huntSettingsData is empty or missing. Skipping save.\n") return end
local jsonDir = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/json/" local savePath = jsonDir .. "/huntsettings.json" local backPath = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Achaean System/system/libs/backup/"
-- Optional: backup old version if fileExists(savePath) then os.rename(savePath, backPath .. ".bak") cecho("<gray>Created backup: huntsettings.json.bak\n") end
local json = dkjson.encode(huntSettingsData, { indent = true }) local f, err = io.open(savePath, "w") if not f then cecho("<red>[ERROR] Failed to write hunt settings: " .. (err or "unknown") .. "\n") return end
f:write(json) f:close() cecho("<green>✅ Hunting settings saved to: " .. savePath .. "\n") end
