setActiveTab
Script.script: function Adjustable.TabWindow:setActiveTab(tabName) -- Ensure the tab exists in the tabs list for _, tab in ipairs(self.tabs) do if tab == tabName then self.current = tabName -- Set the current tab self:adjustTabStyle() -- Apply the updated styles return true -- Indicate success end end return false -- Tab not found end

Script.name: my timers
Script.script:
-- Start tracking personal balance time for a specific type function startPersonalBalanceAction(balanceType) personalBalanceStartTimes[balanceType] = os.clock() debugEcho("cyan",string.format("Starting balance timer for %s at time: %f", balanceType, personalBalanceStartTimes[balanceType])) end
-- Get remaining time for a specific personal balance type function getRemainingPersonalTimerTime(balanceType)
-- Check if the specified balance type exists in balanceTimes local balanceInfo = balance_data[balanceType] if not balanceInfo then debugEcho("red",string.format("Invalid balance type specified: %s", balanceType)) return -1 -- Using -1 to indicate an error end
-- Retrieve the start time for the specific personal balance action local start_time = personalBalanceStartTimes[balanceType] if not start_time then debugEcho("red",string.format("No start time set for %s, returning -1", balanceType)) return -1 -- Return -1 if the start time hasn't been set end
-- Calculate remaining time based on default time and elapsed time local current_time = os.clock() local elapsed_time = current_time - start_time local remaining_time = balanceInfo.avg_time - elapsed_time remaining_time = math.max(remaining_time, 0) -- Ensure remaining time is not negative
-- Round remaining time to two decimal places remaining_time = tonumber(string.format("%.2f", remaining_time))
debugEcho("green",string.format("Remaining time for %s: %f", balanceType, remaining_time))
return remaining_time end

Script.name: prio swaps
Script.script:
function prioswaps() -- 1. Prerequisites if not settings.systemLoaded or not target then return end
-- Get target class from NDB (your new system's source of truth) local enClass = NDB_getClass(target)
-- 2. Lock Detection Logic (Updated to use your 'myaffs' table) local isSoftlocked = (table.contains(myaffs, "impatience") and table.contains(myaffs, "asthma") and table.contains(myaffs, "slickness") and table.contains(myaffs, "anorexia") and not table.contains(myaffs, "paralysis"))
local isTruelocked = (isSoftlocked and table.contains(myaffs, "paralysis"))
-- 3. Class-Specific Logic (The "Swaps") if enClass == "Serpent" then -- Serpents rely on hypochondria/impatience to hide bigger affs curingPrio("impatience", 1) curingPrio("hypochondria", 2)
elseif enClass == "Priest" then -- Handle Inquisition Focus logic if table.contains(myaffs, "inquisition") then if (table.contains(myaffs, "stupidity") or table.contains(myaffs, "anorexia")) then send("curing focus on") else send("curing focus off") end end
elseif enClass == "Group" then -- In groups, paralysis is a death sentence curingPrio("paralysis", 1)
else -- Default priorities if class is unknown or not special-cased -- You can reset to a 'standard' list here if needed end
-- 4. Dynamic Herb Stacking Check (Optional helper call) -- This checks if you are getting "stacked" on a specific herb balance if getHerbStackCount("goldenseal") >= 4 then -- Logic to prioritize clearing goldenseal affs end
settings.needCuringSwap = false
end
function curingPrio(aff, rank) -- Only sends if the setting actually needs changing to save bandwidth send(string.format("curing priority %s %d", aff, rank), false) end
function getHerbStackCount(herb) local stacks = { kelp = {"asthma", "clumsiness", "hypochondria", "sensitivity", "weariness", "healthleech", "parasite"}, ginseng = {"addiction", "darkshade", "haemophilia", "lethargy", "nausea", "scytherus", "flushings"}, goldenseal = {"dizziness", "epilepsy", "impatience", "shyness", "stupidity", "depression", "shadowmadness"}, lobelia = {"agoraphobia", "guilt", "spiritburn", "tenderskin", "claustrophobia", "loneliness", "vertigo"} }
local count = 0 local list = stacks[herb:lower()] or {}
for _, aff in ipairs(list) do if table.contains(myaffs, aff) then count = count + 1 end end
-- Special handling for dynamic affs like 'horror' or 'unweaving' if herb == "goldenseal" then for _, aff in ipairs(myaffs) do if aff:find("horror") or aff:find("unweavingm") then count = count + 1 end end end
return count end
registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Afflictions", "prioswaps") registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Room.Info", "prioswaps")

Script.name: AffColorsCheck
Script.script:
--## Alphabetical Affliction UI Color Test function AffColorsCheck()
local sorted_affs = {}
-- 1. Pull all keys into a list for aff_id, _ in pairs(afflictions) do table.insert(sorted_affs, aff_id) end
-- 2. Sort the keys alphabetically table.sort(sorted_affs)
-- 3. Iterate through the sorted keys and echo for _, aff_id in ipairs(sorted_affs) do local data = afflictions[aff_id]
-- Ensure we handle the stackable variables in the string formatting local prompt_string = data.prompt
-- Construct the test string local test_echo = string.format("<white>Testing [%-20s]: %s", data.name, prompt_string)
-- cecho handles the <color> tags cecho(test_echo .. "\n") end
end

Script.name: pipes
Script.script:
-- ============================================================================== -- 2. HELPER FUNCTIONS FOR TRACKING -- ==============================================================================
-- Helper function to check if a pipe is already scheduled to be lit function is_scheduled_to_light(pipe_id) return pipes_to_light[pipe_id] ~= nil end
-- Helper function to add a pipe to the schedule function schedule_light(pipe_id) pipes_to_light[pipe_id] = true end
-- Helper function to remove a pipe from the schedule (THE CRITICAL CLEANUP) function unschedule_light(pipe_id) pipes_to_light[pipe_id] = nil end
-- ============================================================================== -- 3. UPDATED CORE LOGIC -- ==============================================================================
-- Trigger handler when the MUD confirms a pipe is lit function on_pipe_lit_trigger() -- If no pipes are scheduled to light, we return. if next(pipes_to_light) == nil then return end
-- Iterate over every pipe currently scheduled to be lit. for pipe_id, _ in pairs(pipes_to_light) do local pipe_name = nil
-- Find the pipe data in the main 'pipes' table using the ID. for herb, data in pairs(pipes) do if type(data) == "table" and data.id == pipe_id then pipe_name = herb break end end
if pipe_name then -- Set its status to 'lit' and remove it from the tracking queue. pipes[pipe_name].status = "lit" unschedule_light(pipe_id) debugEcho("green","[Pipe lit] <white>" .. pipe_name:title() .. " (" .. pipe_id .. ") - UNSCHEDULED") end end end
function refill_pipes()
if emptypipes then return end
if not settings.systemLoaded then debugEcho("red","[REFILL] System not loaded.") return end if settings.systemPaused then debugEcho("red","[REFILL] System paused.") return end if inslowcuringmode() then debugEcho("red","[REFILL] In slow curing mode.") return end if balance_data.stunned.in_use then debugEcho("red","[REFILL] Stunned — cannot act.") return end
for herb, data in pairs(pipes) do if type(data) == "table" and data.puffs then
debugEcho("red",string.format( "\n<white>[REFILL] Checking pipe: <green>%s <white>(id: <yellow>%s<white>, puffs: <green>%s<white>, status: <magenta>%s<white>)", herb, tostring(data.id), tostring(data.puffs), tostring(data.status) ))
local refill = data.refill or 3 local should_refill = data.puffs <= refill local can_act = not table.contains(mydefs, "selfishness") and not table.contains(myaffs, "paralysis") and not balance_data.stunned.in_use
if should_refill then debugEcho("red","[REFILL] -> Needs refill.") else debugEcho("green","[REFILL] -> Refill not needed.") end
if can_act then debugEcho("green","[REFILL] -> Can act.") else debugEcho("red","[REFILL] -> Cannot act (selfish or paralyzed).") end
if should_refill and can_act then debugEcho("green","[REFILL] -> Sending empty command.") send("empty " .. data.id .. " out") end
if data.status ~= "artf" and data.status ~= "lit" then
local pipe_id = data.id
-- NEW LOGIC: Check if pipe is already scheduled to be lit if not is_scheduled_to_light(pipe_id) then debugEcho("yellow","[REFILL] -> Lighting pipe: " .. herb)
local cmd = "light " .. pipe_id schedule_light(pipe_id) -- Schedule the command
-- pipecmd = data.id -- REMOVE THIS LINE send(cmd) else debugEcho("yellow","[REFILL] -> Light already pending for pipe: " .. herb) end else debugEcho("green","[REFILL] -> No need to light pipe: " .. herb) end debugEcho("red","[REFILL] -> Invalid pipe data for: " .. tostring(herb)) end end end
function refilled_pipe(herb)
local pipenames = { ["slippery elm"] = "elm", ["a valerian leaf"] = "valerian", ["a skullcap flower"] = "skullcap", ["a pinch of ground malachite"] = "malachite", ["a pinch of realgar crystals"] = "realgar", ["a pinch of ground cinnabar"] = "cinnabar", }
local herb = pipenames[herb]
pipes[herb].puffs = 10
if pipes[herb].status ~= "artf" then local pipe_id = pipes[herb].id
-- NEW LOGIC: Check if pipe is already scheduled to be lit if not is_scheduled_to_light(pipe_id) then schedule_light(pipe_id) -- Schedule the command send("light " .. pipe_id, false) pipes[herb].status = "lit" else -- If already scheduled, trust the previous command will go through pipes[herb].status = "lit" end end end
function parse_plist() local pipenames = { ["slippery elm"] = "elm", ["a valerian leaf"] = "valerian", ["a skullcap flower"] = "skullcap", ["a pinch of ground malachite"] = "malachite", ["a pinch of realgar crystals"] = "realgar", ["a pinch of ground cinnabar"] = "cinnabar", }
local id = tonumber(matches[3]) local herb = pipenames[matches[4]] local puffs = tonumber(matches[5]) local status = matches[2] or "out"
if not pipes then pipes = {} end
if herb and id and puffs and status then pipes[herb] = { id = id, puffs = puffs, status = status, name = herb, refill = 3 }
-- Initialize names array if it doesn't exist if not pipes.name then pipes.name = {} end
if not table.contains(pipes.name, herb) then table.insert(pipes.name, herb) -- Add the herb name to the names array end
if not (pipes[herb].status == "artf") and (pipes[herb].status == "out") then local pipe_id = pipes[herb].id
-- NEW LOGIC: Check if pipe is already scheduled to be lit if not is_scheduled_to_light(pipe_id) then schedule_light(pipe_id) -- Schedule the command send("light " .. pipe_id, false) pipes[herb].status = "lit" else -- If already scheduled, trust the previous command will go through pipes[herb].status = "lit" end end end end
-- ============================================================================== -- 4. OTHER FUNCTIONS (No Changes Needed Here) -- ==============================================================================
-- func --parselist parses, this is the end of parselist
function parse_plist_end() -- 1. Guard against the table being missing entirely if not pipes or not pipes.name then return end
if not settings.systemLoaded then return end
-- 2. Use the 'name' sub-table you already initialized for _, herbName in ipairs(pipes.name) do -- Check if this specific herb entry exists in the pipes table if pipes[herbName] then -- Here we ensure the data is properly formatted for your UI checks pipes[herbName].status = pipes[herbName].status or "unlit" pipes[herbName].puffs = tonumber(pipes[herbName].puffs) or 0 end end end
function puff_count(herb) if pipes[herb] == nil then send("plist") end
pipes[herb].puffs = pipes[herb].puffs - 1 cecho("\n<tomato> " .. herb:title() .. " <white>(<green>" .. pipes[herb].puffs .. "<white>) <green>puffs left")
end
function count_pipes(tbl) local count = 0 for k, v in pairs(tbl) do if type(v) == "table" and v.id and v.name then count = count + 1 end end return count end
-- empty out pipes function empty_pipes()
if not (settings.systemLoaded) then return end
if settings.systemPaused then return end
if inslowcuringmode() then return end
if balance_data.stunned.in_use then return end
for herb, data in pairs(pipes) do if type(data) == "table" then if not (selfishness) and not (table.contains(myaffs, "paralysis")) then send("empty " .. data.id .. " out ") end end end
end

Script.name: vitals
Script.script:
function vitalsGMCP() -- GMCP LOADED if not (settings.systemLoaded) then return end
instakillTimer = instakillTimer or nil
vitals = vitals or { health = {max = 0, current = 0, previous = 0, halflife = 0}, mana = {max = 0, current = 0, previous = 0, halflife = 0}, ep = {max = 0, current = 0, previous = 0, halflife = 0}, wp = {max = 0, current = 0, previous = 0, halflife = 0}, rank = {max = 0, current = 0, previous = 0, halflife = 0}, }
-- 1. Update Previous Values vitals.health.previous = vitals.health.current vitals.mana.previous = vitals.mana.current vitals.ep.previous = vitals.ep.current vitals.wp.previous = vitals.wp.current vitals.rank.previous = vitals.rank.current
-- 2. Update Current AND Max Values from GMCP vitals.health.current = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.hp) or vitals.health.halflife vitals.health.max = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxhp) or vitals.health.max or 1
vitals.mana.current = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.mp) or vitals.mana.halflife vitals.mana.max = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxmp) or vitals.mana.max or 1
vitals.ep.current = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.ep) or vitals.ep.halflife vitals.ep.max = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxep) or vitals.ep.max or 1
vitals.wp.current = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.wp) or vitals.wp.halflife vitals.wp.max = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxwp) or vitals.wp.max or 1
-- XP usually comes as a string like "75%", we strip the sign and treat max as 100 -- This just grabs the digits from the string and ignores everything else vitals.rank.current = tonumber(string.match(gmcp.Char.Status.xp, "%d+")) or 0 vitals.rank.max = 100
-- GMCP UPDATES updateCharStats() updateGUIGauges()
if systemPaused or inslowcuringmode() or balance_data.stunned.in_use then return end
-- Ensure sipping logic uses the new max values if settings.fullsipping then settings.siphealth = (vitals.health.current == vitals.health.halflife) and vitals.health.max or (vitals.health.max * 0.99) settings.sipmana = (vitals.mana.current == vitals.mana.halflife) and vitals.mana.max or (vitals.mana.max * 0.99) else settings.siphealth = (vitals.health.current == vitals.health.halflife) and vitals.health.max or (vitals.health.max * 0.83) settings.sipmana = (vitals.mana.current == vitals.mana.halflife) and vitals.mana.max or (vitals.mana.max * 0.73) end
-- Death/Respawn Logic if vitals.health.current > 0 then if settings.dead then settings.dead = false raiseEvent("characterRespawn") end else if not settings.dead then settings.dead = true raiseEvent("characterDeath") end end
recklessCheck() end
registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Vitals", vitalsGMCP)

Script.name: sipper
Script.script:
function sipper() if not (settings.systemLoaded) then return end
if settings.systemPaused then return end
if inslowcuringmode() then return end
if balance_data.stunned.in_use then return end
-- Check if we are bleeding and need to prioritize mana if bleedcheck() > 200 then if not (healthaffsabove == 99) then healthaffsabove = 99 send("CURING HEALTHAFFSABOVE 99") end -- Prioritize mana to clot bleeding handleSipping("mana") return end
-- Prioritize health or mana based on health and mana status local affToHeal = maxLimbDamage() if affToHeal and vitals.health.current >= settings.siphealth then if not(healthaffsabove == 49) then healthaffsabove = 49 send("CURING HEALTHAFFSABOVE 39") end --applyHealthToLimb(affToHeal) else -- Not a priority health case, handle mana sipping if necessary --if not (healthaffsabove == 99) then -- healthaffsabove = 99 -- send("CURING HEALTHAFFSABOVE 99") -- end handleSipping("health") end end
function handleSipping(sipPriority) if not (settings.systemLoaded) then return end
if settings.systemPaused then return end
if inslowcuringmode() then return end
if balance_data.stunned.in_use then return end
if not settings.sipbalance then return end
-- Default to health if no sip priority provided if not sipPriority then sipPriority = "health" end
local sipCommand = determineSipCommand(sipPriority) if sipCommand then settings.sipbalance = false if sippriority ~= sipCommand then sippriority = sipCommand send(sipCommand) end silentTempTimer( 4.5, function() settings.sipbalance = true end ) end end
function determineSipCommand(sipPriority) local healthLow = vitals.health and vitals.health.current and settings.siphealth and vitals.health.current <= settings.siphealth or false local manaLow = vitals.mana and vitals.mana.current and settings.sipmana and vitals.mana.current <= settings.sipmana or false
if sipPriority == "health" then if healthLow then return "curing priority health" elseif manaLow then return "curing priority mana" end else if manaLow then return "curing priority mana" elseif healthLow then return "curing priority health" end end return nil end
function handleMoss() local cs = settings.cmdsep
if not settings.mossbalance or not settings.mossenabled or balance_data.stunned.in_use or settings.systemPaused or inslowcuringmode() then return end
settings.mosshealth = vitals.health.max - 800 settings.mossmana = vitals.mana.max - 800
if (vitals.health.current <= settings.mosshealth) or (vitals.mana.current <= settings.mossmana) then local command = settings.cureMethod == "alchemical" and "outr potash"..cs.."eat potash" or "outr moss"..cs.."eat moss" send(command) settings.mossbalance = false end end

Script.name: fractures
Script.script:
-- function to get highest limb damage, fractures, tendons, etc check.
function maxLimbDamage() local highestCount = 0 local highestAff = nil local relevantAffs = { burning = false, pressure = false, temperedcholeric = false, temperedmelancholic = false, temperedphlegmatic = false, temperedsanguine = false, torntendons = true, wristfractures = true, skullfractures = true, crackedribs = true, } for aff, count in pairs(mystackableaffs) do if relevantAffs[aff] and count > 2 and count > highestCount then highestCount = count highestAff = aff end end return highestAff end
-- Function to apply health to the corresponding limb
function applyHealthToLimb(affliction)
if not (settings.systemLoaded) then return end
if settings.systemPaused then return end
if inslowcuringmode() then return end
if balance_data.stunned.in_use then return end
local limbMapping = { crackedribs = "torso", torntendons = "legs", wristfractures = "arms", skullfractures = "head" }
local limb = limbMapping[affliction] if limb then send("apply health to " .. limb) end end

Script.name: clotting
Script.script:
-- ============================================================================= -- TRACER-INJECTED CLOTTING MODULE (FIXED COOLDOWN PATHING) -- =============================================================================
function clotcheck() debugEcho("light_blue","CLOTTING [TRACE-1] Entering clotcheck()...")
if not (settings.systemLoaded) then debugEcho("red","[EXIT CLOTTING: systemLoaded is false/nil]") return end
if settings.systemPaused then debugEcho("red","[EXIT CLOTTING: systemPaused is true]") return end
if inslowcuringmode() then debugEcho("red","[EXIT CLOTTING: inslowcuringmode() is true]") return end
if balance_data and balance_data.stunned and balance_data.stunned.in_use then debugEcho("red","[EXIT CLOTTING: Character is stunned]") return end
if table.contains(myaffs or {}, "blackout") then debugEcho("red","[EXIT CLOTTING: Blackout active]") return end
-- Fallback check to ensure settings table exists if not settings then debugEcho("red","[EXIT CLOTTING: settings{} table does not exist]") return end
if settings.clot then debugEcho("red","[EXIT CLOTTING: settings.clot is true (using serverside clotting)]") return end
debugEcho("light_blue","CLOTTING [TRACE-2] Basic system state guards passed.")
-- Framework verification helper for willpower check local wpCurrent = 0 if vitals and vitals.wp then wpCurrent = vitals.wp.current or 0 elseif PLAYER and type(PLAYER.getResourceData) == "function" then wpCurrent = PLAYER:getResourceData("willpower").current or 0 else debugEcho("yellow","CLOTTING [WARN] Could not read willpower framework data. Defaulting to 0.") end
if table.contains(myaffs or {}, "paralysis") then debugEcho("red","[EXIT CLOTTING: Paralysis active]") return end
if table.contains(myaffs or {}, "haemophilia") and wpCurrent > 30 then debugEcho("red","[EXIT CLOTTING: Haemophilia active with WP > 30]") return end
debugEcho("light_blue","CLOTTING [TRACE-3] Affliction state checks passed.")
if not table.contains(myaffs or {}, "haemophilia") and not table.contains(myaffs or {}, "corruption") and not table.contains(myaffs or {}, "aeon") and not inslowcuringmode() then debugEcho("light_blue","CLOTTING [TRACE-4] Passive block limits cleared. Parsing opponent context...")
if enemyclass and enemyclass["alchemist"] and enemyclass["alchemist"].enabled then debugEcho("yellow","CLOTTING [TRACE-Alchemist] Alchemist target active. Validating vitals floor...")
local currentHP = tonumber(gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals and gmcp.Char.Vitals.hp or 0) local currentMP = tonumber(gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals and gmcp.Char.Vitals.mp or 0)
-- Support fallback to global variables if settings fields are blank local healthDangerLimit = tonumber(healthdanger or settings.healthdanger or 0) local manaDangerLimit = tonumber(manadanger or settings.manadanger or 0)
if currentHP >= healthDangerLimit and currentMP >= manaDangerLimit then debugEcho("green","CLOTTING [TRACE-Alchemist] Vitals clear. Proceeding to clotcalc().") clotcalc() else debugEcho("red","[EXIT CLOTTING: Alchemist safety limits triggered. HP: %d/%d, MP: %d/%d]", currentHP, healthDangerLimit, currentMP, manaDangerLimit) end else debugEcho("green","CLOTTING [TRACE-Default] Normal environment/class active. Dropping into clotcalc().") clotcalc() end else debugEcho("red","[EXIT CLOTTING: Blocked due to presence of haemophilia, corruption, aeon, or slowcuring]") end end
function clotcalc() debugEcho("light_blue","CLOTTING [TRACE-5] Inside clotcalc(). Processing calculations...")
local classreference = { alchemist = {bleed = 140, mana = 0.70, health = 0.66}, bard = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.75}, priest = {bleed = 220, mana = 0.80, health = 0.66}, shaman = {bleed = 180, mana = 0.51, health = 0.66}, apostate = {bleed = 220, mana = 0.51, health = 0.25}, blademaster = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.00, health = 0.75}, depthswalker = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.61, health = 0.50}, dragon = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.50}, druid = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.50}, jester = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.75}, magi = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.50}, monk = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.25}, occultist = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.75}, sentinel = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.66}, serpent = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.75}, sylvan = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.75}, unnamable = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.50}, runewarden = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.50}, infernal = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.50}, paladin = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.50},
-- 🟢 CONSOLIDATED SYSTEMS MATCHING REFACTORED STANDARD KEYS ["air elemental"] = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.75}, ["water elemental"] = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.75}, ["fire elemental"] = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.60, health = 0.66}, ["earth elemental"] = {bleed = 90, mana = 0.25, health = 0.50}, }
local bleed = bleedcheck()
if bleed <= 0 then debugEcho("green","[EXIT CLOTTING: Bleed calculation returned 0 or less]") return end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- ⏳ SAFETY-WRAPPED COOLDOWN CHECK --------------------------------------------------------- local currentClock = os.clock() local storedCD = settings.clotcd or 0
if storedCD > (currentClock + 5) then debugEcho("yellow","[CLOT WARNING] Corrupt timestamp detected in settings.clotcd! Resetting to 0.") settings.clotcd = 0 storedCD = 0 end
if currentClock < storedCD then debugEcho("red","[EXIT CLOTTING: Clotting on Cooldown]") return end
local MAX_CLOTS_PER_CALL = 20 local hp = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.hp or 0) local mp = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.mp or 0) local maxhp = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxhp or 1) local maxmp = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxmp or 1)
local clotCostPer = 60 if settings and settings.magiRobes then clotCostPer = 60 * 0.666 end
local clotsNeeded = math.floor(bleed / 30) clotsNeeded = math.min(clotsNeeded, MAX_CLOTS_PER_CALL) local totalClotCost = clotsNeeded * clotCostPer
local activeBleedConfig = tonumber(bleeddanger or settings.bleeddanger or 70) local activeEnemy = false local danger = {bleed = activeBleedConfig, mana = 0.25, health = 0.66}
if enemyclass then for k, v in pairs(classreference) do if enemyclass[k] and enemyclass[k].enabled then danger = v activeEnemy = true break end end end
settings.manaThreshold = maxmp * danger.mana settings.healthThreshold = maxhp * danger.health
local projectedHP = hp - bleed local projectedMP = mp - totalClotCost
debugEcho("white",string.format("[CLOT DEBUG] Bleed: %d | Clots: %d | Cost: %d | HP: %d | MP: %d", bleed, clotsNeeded, totalClotCost, hp, mp)) debugEcho("white",string.format("[CLOT DEBUG] HP danger: %.0f | MP danger: %.0f | Projected HP: %.0f | Projected MP: %.0f", settings.healthThreshold, settings.manaThreshold, projectedHP, projectedMP))
local targetDangerBleed = activeEnemy and danger.bleed or activeBleedConfig if bleed < targetDangerBleed then debugEcho("red","[EXIT CLOTTING: Bleed (%d) is below safety threshold limit (%d)]", bleed, targetDangerBleed) return end
if projectedHP < settings.healthThreshold and projectedMP < settings.manaThreshold then debugEcho("red","[EXIT CLOTTING: Hard resource lock. Both projected HP and MP hit critical floors]") return end
--------------------------------------------------------- -- DECISION PIPELINE --------------------------------------------------------- if projectedHP < settings.healthThreshold then settings.clotcd = os.clock() + 0.5 debugEcho("green","[CLOT EXECUTION] Emergency HP threshold breached! Forcing command pipeline.") sendClots(clotsNeeded) return end
if not activeEnemy or projectedMP >= settings.manaThreshold then settings.clotcd = os.clock() + 0.5 debugEcho("red","[CLOT EXECUTION] Standard parameters clear. Sending commands.") sendClots(clotsNeeded) else debugEcho("red","[EXIT CLOTTING: Clot execution failed to satisfy final threshold conditions]") end end
function sendClots(n) local num = n or 0 if num <= 0 then return end debugEcho("green",string.format("[CLOT PIPELINE] Sending %d clot commands to game server\n", num)) local cs = settings.cmdsep or ";" local cmd = {} for i = 1, num do table.insert(cmd, "clot") end send(table.concat(cmd, cs)) end
function bleedcheck() if not (settings.systemLoaded and gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals and gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats) then return 0 end local statStr = gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats[1] if not statStr or #statStr < 8 then return 0 end
local value = tonumber(statStr:sub(8)) return value and math.max(value, 0) or 0 end
function bleedcheckprompt() if not (settings.systemLoaded and gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals and gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats) then return "" end local statStr = gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats[1] if not statStr or #statStr < 8 then return "" end
local valueStr = statStr:sub(8) local bleedValue = tonumber(valueStr) local dangerThreshold = tonumber(bleeddanger or settings.bleeddanger or 70)
if not bleedValue or bleedValue == 0 then return "" end
if bleedValue > dangerThreshold then return string.format("<white>bld(<red>%d<white>) ", bleedValue) else return string.format("<white>bld(<yellow>%d<white>) ", bleedValue) end end
-- 🎯 FIXED: Rebuilt completely self-contained to avoid local variable scope bugs function testClot(hp, mp, bleed, class) gmcp = gmcp or {} gmcp.Char = gmcp.Char or {} gmcp.Char.Vitals = { hp = hp, mp = mp, maxhp = 5000, maxmp = 5000, charstats = {string.format("Bleed: %d", bleed)} }
if not enemyclass then enemyclass = {} end for k, v in pairs(enemyclass) do enemyclass[k].enabled = false end if class and class ~= "none" then enemyclass[class] = enemyclass[class] or {} enemyclass[class].enabled = true end
-- Flush cooldown flags so test runs instantly if settings then settings.clotcd = 0 end
clotcheck() end
if eventClotcheckId then killAnonymousEventHandler(eventClotcheckId) end eventClotcheckId = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Vitals", "clotcheck")

Script.script:
function recklessCheck() local cs = settings.cmdsep
-- Early exit if system is not loaded, paused, in slow curing mode, or stunned if not settings.systemLoaded or settings.systemPaused or inslowcuringmode() or balance_data.stunned.in_use then return end
-- Debugging: Print health and mana to check their values -- cecho("<yellow>Health: " .. vitals.health.current .. " / " .. (vitals.health.max or "N/A") .. "\n") -- cecho("<yellow>Mana: " .. vitals.mana.current .. " / " .. (vitals.mana.max or "N/A") .. "\n")
-- Check if health and mana are either at critical half-life or max if (vitals.health.current == vitals.health.halflife and vitals.mana.current == vitals.mana.halflife) or (vitals.health.current == vitals.health.max and vitals.mana.current == vitals.mana.max and vitals.wp.current == vitals.wp.max and vitals.ep.current == vitals.ep.max ) then --cecho("<green>Reckless Check triggered! Health and Mana at critical or max.\n")
-- Handle different reckless check stages if settings.reckless_check == 30 or settings.reckless_check == 60 or settings.reckless_check == 90 then cecho("\n<orange>Reckless Check: <red>" .. settings.reckless_check) end
-- Reset reckless_check if health or mana is not maxed or at half-life if settings.reckless_check > 0 and (gmcp.Char.Vitals.hp ~= gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxhp or gmcp.Char.Vitals.mp ~= gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxmp) then settings.reckless_check = 0 end
-- Increment the reckless check counter (try increasing the increment to 1 to speed it up) settings.reckless_check = settings.reckless_check + 1
-- When reckless_check reaches or exceeds 30 and recklessness isn't present, trigger prediction if settings.reckless_check >= 90 and not table.contains(myaffs, "recklessness") then -- Predict recklessness only if neither focus nor herb is in use if not balance_data.focus.in_use then -- send("focus") elseif not balance_data.herb.in_use then send("curing predict recklessness") end
-- Reset the reckless_check counter settings.reckless_check = 0 end else -- Reset reckless_check if health or mana conditions aren't met settings.reckless_check = 0 end
end

Script.name: restoreScenarios
Script.script:
function restoreScenarios() local myAffs = myaffs local contains = table.contains
if not (settings.systemLoaded) then return end
if settings.systemPaused then return end
if inslowcuringmode() then return end
local function shouldRestore() return not restoring and not balance_data.equilibrium.in_use end
local function attemptRestore() tryingtodo("RESTORE") send("restore") end
-- Scenario 1: Multiple specific afflictions if (contains(myAffs, "brokenrightarm") or contains(myAffs, "brokenleftarm")) and (contains(myAffs, "damagedleftarm") or contains(myAffs, "damagedrighttarm")) and contains(myAffs, "paralysis") and contains(myAffs, "slickness") and contains(myAffs, "asthma") then attemptRestore() end
-- Scenario 2: Damaged legs and broken arm if (contains(myAffs, "damagedleftleg") and contains(myAffs, "damagedrightleg")) and (contains(myAffs, "brokenleftarm") or contains(myAffs, "brokenrightarm")) and shouldRestore() then attemptRestore() end
-- Scenario 3: Damaged arms and broken leg if (contains(myAffs, "damagedleftarm") and contains(myAffs, "damagedrightarm")) and (contains(myAffs, "brokenleftleg") or contains(myAffs, "brokenrightleg")) and shouldRestore() then attemptRestore() end
-- Vivimode scenario if vivimode and shouldRestore() then attemptRestore() vivimode = false end
-- Broken arm scenario if (contains(myAffs, "brokenleftarm") or contains(myAffs, "brokenrightarm")) and not vivimode and shouldRestore() then attemptRestore() vivimode = false end end

Script.name: balances
Script.script:
function balanceGMCP()
if not (settings.systemLoaded) then return end
if settings.systemPaused then return end
--if inslowcuringmode() then --return --end
--if balance_data.stunned.in_use then -- return --end
-- Handle balance if gmcp.Char.Vitals.bal ~= "1" and not(balance_data.balance.in_use) then
settings.meditating = false balanceStart("balance",false) else if hunting and autohunting then if table.contains(myaffs, "blackout") then huntNext() end end
end
-- Handle equilibrium if gmcp.Char.Vitals.eq ~= "1" and not(balance_data.equilibrium.in_use) then balanceStart("equilibrium",false) end
end
-- Function to start a balance update function balanceStart(balanceType, highlight) -- Check if balance is already in use
if balance_data[balanceType].in_use then local remaining_time = getRemainingPersonalTimerTime(balanceType) if remaining_time > 0 then myTimerEcho(settings.debug, balanceType, "<white>" .. remaining_time, "white") return end end
--reset all timer stopwatches' on stun if balanceType == "stunned" then sipStopwatch = nil treeStopwatch = nil smokeStopwatch = nil fitnessStopwatch = nil herbStopwatch = nil salveStopwatch = nil focusStopwatch = nil balanceStopwatch = nil equilibriumStopwatch = nil shruggingStopwatch = nil stunStopwatch = nil dragonhealStopwatch = nil restoreStopwatch = nil antidoteStopwatch = nil end
-- Start balance process balance_data[balanceType].in_use = true
silentTempTimer(balance_data[balanceType].avg_time, function() balance_data[balanceType].in_use = false end)
-- create stopwatch balance_data[balanceType .. "Stopwatch"] = createStopWatch() --local stopwatch = balanceType .. "Stopwatch" --stopwatch = createStopWatch() -- Set up timer to trigger recoverFunction after average balance time local time_to_wait = 0
-- Adjust time to wait for specific afflictions if table.contains(myaffs, "lethargy") then time_to_wait = (balance_data[balanceType].avg_time * 1.25) else time_to_wait = balance_data[balanceType].avg_time end
if time_to_wait > 0 and table.contains(myaffs, "blackout") then tempTimer( time_to_wait, function() if balance_data[balanceType].in_use and table.contains(myaffs, "blackout") then balanceRecover(balanceType) end end ) end
-- Track last started type for health or mana if balanceType == "health" or balanceType == "mana" then lastSipType = balanceType settings.sipbalance = false end
if balance_data[balanceType].in_use then remedy:clearPipelineOnCommand(balanceType) end
--if balanceType == "tree" then --remedy:clearPipelineOnCommand("tree") --end
-- if balanceType == "shrugging" then -- remedy:clearPipelineOnCommand("shrugging") -- end
-- if balanceType == "dragonheal" then -- remedy:clearPipelineOnCommand("dragonheal") -- end
-- if balanceType == "fitness" then -- remedy:clearPipelineOnCommand("fitness") -- end
if highlight then highlightline(selectString(line, 1) > -1, "black", "orange", false, true) end
end
-- Function to recover from a balance update function balanceRecover(balanceType, highlight)
-- Reset balance in_use status and handle stopwatch balance_data[balanceType].in_use = false
remedy:clearPipelineOnCommand(balanceType)
local stopwatch = balance_data[balanceType .. "Stopwatch"]
if not(balanceType == "free") then -- Check if stopwatch exists before proceeding if stopwatch then -- Call stopStopWatch and check if it returns a valid number local stopwatchValue = stopStopWatch(stopwatch)
if stopwatchValue then local balanceTime = trimDecimal(stopwatchValue - getNetworkLatency())
-- Print balanceTime if no blackout affliction if not table.contains(myaffs, "blackout") then cecho("<white> :<PowderBlue>(<DarkSlateGray>" .. balanceTime .. "<PowderBlue>)") end else debugEcho("red","Warning: stopStopWatch returned nil for stopwatch " .. tostring(stopwatch)) end
-- Clean up the stopwatch deleteStopWatch(stopwatch) else debugEcho("red","Warning: Stopwatch does not exist for balanceType: " .. tostring(balanceType)) end
end
if getRemainingPersonalTimerTime(balanceType) > 0 then getRemainingPersonalTimerTime(balanceType) end
-- Determine the correct balance type for health or mana if balanceType == "health" or balanceType == "mana" then balanceType = lastSipType or balanceType settings.sipbalance = true end
if balanceType == "stunned" or balanceType == "balance" then commandSent = false shieldCommandSent = false if hunting and autohunting then huntNext() end end
if highlight then highlightline(selectString(line, 1) > -1, "black", "green", false, true) end end
-- Main function to handle balance updates function balanceTracker() local balances = { free = { ["start"] = {"NO DATA FOUND"}, ["end"] = {"^You stand up%.$"}, ["used"] = {"SAME AS START LINE"},
}, wake = { ["start"] = {"^You begin your struggle to escape from the dreamworld%.$"}, ["end"] = { "^You open your eyes and stretch languidly, feeling deliciously well-rested%.$", "^You open your eyes and yawn mightily%.$", }, ["used"] = {"SAME AS START LINE"}, }, writhe = { ["start"] = {"^You begin to struggle free of your entanglement%.$"}, ["end"] = {"^You have writhed free of your entanglement by %w+%.$"}, ["used"] = {"^You twist and turn as you attempt to escape from your entanglement%.$"}, }, stunned = { ["start"] = {"^You are too stunned to be able to do anything%.$"}, ["end"] = {"^You are no longer stunned%.$"}, ["used"] = {"SAME AS START LINE"}, }, balance = { ["start"] = {"USING GMCP"}, ["end"] = {"^You have recovered balance on all limbs%.$"}, ["used"] = {"^You must regain balance first%.$"}, }, equilibrium = { ["start"] = {"USING GMCP"}, ["end"] = {"^You have recovered equilibrium%.$"}, ["used"] = { "^You must regain equilibrium first%.$", "^You are recovering equilibrium and cannot move yet%.$" }, }, health = { ["start"] = { "^The elixir heals and soothes you%.$", "^You take some elixir from .+ and rub it into your %w+%.$" }, ["end"] = {"^You may drink another health or mana elixir%.$"}, ["used"] = { "^The elixir flows down your throat without effect%.$", "^The health elixir fizzles away without any discernable effect%.$", "^The elixir fizzles uselessly%.$" }, }, mana = { ["start"] = {"^Your mind feels stronger and more alert%.$"}, ["end"] = {"^You may drink another health or mana elixir%.$"}, ["used"] = {"^The elixir flows down your throat without effect%.$"}, }, tree = { ["start"] = {"^You touch the tree of life tattoo%.$"}, ["end"] = {"^You may utilise the tree tattoo again%.$"}, ["used"] = {"^Your tree of life tattoo glows faintly for a moment then fades, leaving you unchanged%.$"}, }, focus = { ["start"] = {"^You focus your mind intently on curing your mental maladies%.$"}, ["end"] = {"^Your mind is able to focus once again%.$"}, ["used"] = {"^You concentrate, but your mind is too tired to focus%.$"}, }, smoke = { ["start"] = {"^You take a long drag of %w+ off your pipe%.$"}, ["end"] = {"^Your lungs have recovered enough to smoke another mineral or plant%.$"}, ["used"] = {"^Your lungs have not yet recovered enough to allow you to smoke%.$"}, }, antidote = { ["start"] = {"^Mercifully, the voyria venom has been cleansed from your body%.$"}, ["end"] = {"^Your system is able to absorb antidotes once again%.$"}, ["used"] = {"SAME AS HEALTH AND MANA"}, }, salve = { ["start"] = {"^You take out some salve and quickly rub it on your %w+%.$"}, ["end"] = {"^You may apply another salve to yourself%.$"}, ["used"] = {"^You messily spread the salve over your body, to no effect%.$"}, }, herb = { ["start"] = { "^You eat [aA]n? .+flake%.$", "^You eat [aA]n? .+chip%.$", "^You eat [aA]n? .+grain%.$", "^You eat [aA]n? .+root%.$", "^You eat [aA]n? .+leaf%.$", "^You eat [aA]n? .+pellet%.$" }, ["end"] = {"^You may eat another plant or mineral%.$"}, ["used"] = {"^The plant has no effect%.$"}, }, shrugging = { ["start"] = {"^Focusing inward, you purge your body of afflictions%.$"}, ["end"] = {"^Your body has recovered enough to shrug afflictions once again%.$"}, ["used"] = {"^You may not shrug again so soon%.$"}, }, fitness = { ["start"] = {"^You inhale deeply, purging yourself of your asthmatic condition%.$"}, ["end"] = {"^You may purge your lungs once again%.$"}, ["used"] = {"^You may not purge your lungs again as of this time%.$"}, }, dragonheal = { ["start"] = {"^You let out a great keening, and cast the impurities from your form%.$"}, ["end"] = {"^You may purge your great form of afflictions once again%.$"}, ["used"] = {"^You have not yet recovered enough to purge your great form of afflictions%.$"}, }, fool = { ["start"] = {"^You press the Fool tarot to your forehead%.$"}, ["end"] = {"^You may heal another affliction%.$"}, ["used"] = {"^The Fool has no effect on you%.$"}, } }
local currentLine = getCurrentLine()
if currentLine == "You may eat another bit of irid moss or potash." then
settings.mossbalance = false if mossStopwatch then local mossTime = trimDecimal(stopStopWatch(mossStopwatch) - getNetworkLatency()) cecho("<white> :<PowderBlue>(<DarkSlateGray>" .. mossTime .. "<PowderBlue>)") deleteStopWatch(mossStopwatch) end highlightline(selectString(line, 1) > -1, "black", "orange", false, true) return
elseif currentLine == "You feel your health and mana replenished." or currentLine == "You eat some irid moss." or currentLine == "You eat a potash crystal." then
settings.mossbalance = true mossStopwatch = createStopWatch() highlightline(selectString(line, 1) > -1, "black", "green", false, true) return
else
for balanceType, actions in pairs(balances) do for action, patterns in pairs(actions) do for _, pattern in ipairs(patterns) do -- Check for an exact match with the pattern if string.match(currentLine, pattern) then if action == "start" then balanceStart(balanceType,true) return elseif action == "end" then balanceRecover(balanceType,true) return elseif action == "used" then balance_data[balanceType].in_use = true return end end end end end end end
function balanceTime(balanceType)
if balanceType == "nil" then cecho("\n<red>There is no balance type for:" .. balanceType) return end
local baseTime = balance_data[balanceType].avg_time local modifiers = get_aff_modifiers(balanceType) local modified = false local foundAffliction = "" local myaffsSet = {}
-- Check if there are any recorded balance times of given type if baseTime ~= 0 then -- Check if there are any modifiers for the given balance type for _, modifier in pairs(modifiers) do if myaffsSet[modifier.affliction] then foundAffliction = modifier.affliction baseTime = baseTime * (modifier.multiplier or 1) + (modifier.offset or 0) modified = true break -- Exit the loop as soon as an affliction is found end end end
if modified then myTimerEcho( settings.debug, balanceType, "\n<red>" .. balance_data[balanceType].echo_title .. "<red> has been modified by <white>" .. (baseTime - balance_data[balanceType].avg_time) .. " <red> seconds due to the affliction <white>" .. foundAffliction:upper() .. ".", "red" ) end
return baseTime end

Script.name: transmute
Script.script:
------------------------------------------------- -- Put your Lua functions here. -- -- -- -- Note that you can also use external Scripts -- -------------------------------------------------
function calctrans()
if not (systemLoaded) then return end
if systemPaused then return end
if inslowcuringmode() then return end
if balance_data.stunned.in_use then return end
local returnstring = "" local maxhp = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxhp) or "5500" local hp = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.hp) or "5500" local maxmana = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxmp) or "4500" local mana = tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.mp) or "4500"
if hp < transmutehp then
hpneeded = transmutehp - hp
if mana - hpneeded < manathreshold then
hpneeded = mana - manathreshold
end
returnstring = calculatetransmuteamount(hpneeded)
if not(string.find(returnstring, "transmute")) then
returnstring = ""
end
end
return returnstring
end
function transmoote()
transmutehp = 4500 --- amount of health you want to transmute to manathreshold = 500 --- dont drop below this mana level if not(calctrans () == "") then
tsend("queue add eqbal "..calctrans()) else
end end
function calculatetransmuteamount(amount) local cs = cmdsep
local producedstring = ""
while amount > 0 do
if amount > 1000 then
producedstring = producedstring..""..cs.."transmute 1000" amount = amount - 1000 else
producedstring = producedstring..""..cs.."transmute ".. math.floor(amount)
amount = 0
end
end
return producedstring
end

function handleAfflictionAdd() local templist = { insomnia = true, blindness = true, deafness = true, } local affName = gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Add.name
-- 1. If we already have it, don't process it again if table.contains(myaffs, affName) then return end
-- 2. Define our "Exception" rule -- We only care about blindness/deafness if mindseye is FALSE local isSensory = (affName == "blindness" or affName == "deafness") local needsSensoryCure = (isSensory and not settings.mindseye)
-- 3. The Gatekeeper -- We proceed if: It's NOT in the templist OR it's a sensory aff we need to cure if not templist[affName] or needsSensoryCure then
-- Handle Stackables local num = string.match(affName, "%((%d+)%)") if num then local baseName = string.match(affName, "^(.-)%s") if baseName then mystackableaffs[baseName] = tonumber(num) end else -- Handle Standard Afflictions table.insert(myaffs, affName) remedy:process()
-- Special case for blackout/disrupted if affName == "blackout" then if not table.contains(predictions, "disrupted") then table.insert(predictions, "disrupted") send("CURING PREDICT DISRUPTED") end end end
if settings.debug then remedy:echo("\nProcessed: " .. affName .. " (Total: " .. #myaffs .. ")") end end end

Script.name: remove
Script.script:
-- Function to handle the removal of afflictions
function handleAfflictionRemove()
local cs = settings.cmdsep
local affInfo = gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Remove
local affInfoTable = {} -- Create lookup table for affInfo
-- Populate affInfoTable for O(1) lookups
for _, aff in ipairs(affInfo) do
affInfoTable[aff] = true
end
-- Iterate backwards through myaffs to safely remove items while looping
for i = #myaffs, 1, -1 do
local removal = myaffs[i]
-- Check if the affliction exists in affInfoTable
if affInfoTable[removal] then
onCureSuccess(removal) -- Handle curing success
table.remove(myaffs, i) -- Remove from myaffs directly
if removal == "blackout" and hunting and autohunting then
commandSent = false
shieldCommandSent = false
huntNext()
huntNextRoom()
end
-- Check and reset priority in curinglist
if afflictions and afflictions[removal] then
local defaultPriority = afflictions[removal].priority
-- Check if curinglist[removal] is set correctly before resetting
if curinglist[removal] then
-- Only reset if the current priority is not the same as the default
if curinglist[removal] ~= defaultPriority then
-- Generate priority command
local command = "curing prio " .. removal .. " " .. defaultPriority
-- Add to sentPriorityCommands if not already sent
if not sentPriorityCommands[removal] then
sentPriorityCommands[removal] = defaultPriority -- Store the priority value
if tumbling then
-- do nothing
else
send(command)
end
end
end
end
end
end
end
-- **Failsafe check**: Ensure all afflictions in curinglist match their default priorities
onCureFailsafe()
-- Reset mystackableaffs if myaffs is empty
if #myaffs == 0 then
mystackableaffs = {
torntendons = 0,
skullfractures = 0,
crackedribs = 0,
wristfractures = 0,
pressure = 0,
burning = 0,
temperedsanguine = 0,
temperedmelancholic = 0,
temperedphlegmatic = 0,
temperedcholeric = 0,
unweavingmind = 0,
unweavingbody = 0,
unweavingspirit = 0,
horror = 0,
}
end
end
-- Function to handle failsafe check and ensure curinglist matches default priorities
function onCureFailsafe()
local cs = settings.cmdsep
local priorityCommandList = {} -- List to accumulate commands
-- **Failsafe check**: Ensure all afflictions in curinglist match their default priorities
for affliction, currentPriority in pairs(curinglist) do
-- Make sure the affliction is not in the `myaffs` table (not already cured)
if afflictions[affliction] and not table.contains(myaffs, affliction) then
local defaultPriority = afflictions[affliction].priority
-- If curinglist priority is not the same as the default, queue the reset command
if currentPriority ~= defaultPriority then
local command = "curing prio " .. affliction .. " " .. defaultPriority
-- Only add the command if it hasn't been sent already
if not sentPriorityCommands[affliction] or sentPriorityCommands[affliction] ~= defaultPriority then
sentPriorityCommands[affliction] = defaultPriority -- Mark as sent globally
table.insert(priorityCommandList, command)
end
end
end
end
-- Ensure we send all necessary commands
if #priorityCommandList > 0 then
send(table.concat(priorityCommandList, cs))
end
end
function onPriorityResetSent(affliction, priority)
-- This function will be triggered once we receive confirmation that the priority has been set
-- Example: "You have set the 'brokenrightarm' affliction to the 19 priority."
-- Clear the affliction from the sentPriorityCommands table after confirmation
if sentPriorityCommands[affliction] then
--cecho("<green>Confirmed: " .. affliction .. " priority set to " .. priority .. "\n")
sentPriorityCommands[affliction] = nil -- Remove the affliction from the table after confirmation
end
end
-- Register the GMCP event for removing afflictions
registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Remove", handleAfflictionRemove)

function diagnose() if settings.systemLoaded then myaffs = {} pipeline.afflictions = {} settings.hiddenaff = 0 mystackableaffs = { torntendons = 0, skullfractures = 0, crackedribs = 0, wristfractures = 0, pressure = 0, burning = 0, temperedsanguine = 0, temperedmelancholic = 0, temperedphlegmatic = 0, temperedcholeric = 0, } local templist = {"insomnia", "blindness", "deafness"} for i = 1, #gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List, 1 do if not table.contains(templist, gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List[i].name) then --and not table.contains(stackables, gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List[i].name) then if not table.contains(myaffs, gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List[i].name) then if string.find(gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List[i].name, "%(") then mystackableaffs[ string.sub( gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List[i].name, 1, string.find(gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List[i].name, " ") - 1 ) ] = tonumber( string.sub( gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List[i].name, string.find(gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List[i].name, "%(") + 1, string.find(gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List[i].name, "%(") + 1 ) ) else table.insert(myaffs, gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List[i].name) end end end end end
end

function afflictionCount(herb, amount) local herblist = { kelp = {"asthma", "clumsiness", "hypochondria", "sensitivity", "weariness", "healthleech", "parasite", "rebbies"}, ginseng = {"unweavingbody","addiction", "darkshade", "haemophilia", "lethargy", "nausea", "scytherus", "flushings"}, goldenseal = {"unweavingmind","dizziness", "epilepsy", "impatience", "shyness", "stupidity", "depression","dissonance", "shadowmadness", "mycalium", "sandfever", "horror"}, lobelia = {"agoraphobia", "guilt", "spiritburn", "tenderskin", "claustrophobia", "loneliness", "masochism", "recklessness", "vertigo"}, ash = {"confusion", "dementia", "hallucinations", "hypersomnia", "paranoia"}, bellwort = {"pyre","retribution","timeloop", "peace","justice","lovers","pacified","generosity","indifference"}, ginger = {"temperedcholeric","temperedmelancholic","temperedphlegmatic","temperedsanguine"}, }
local stack = herblist[herb:lower()] local count = 0 local amount = amount or 4
for k, _ in pairs(myaffs) do if (herb:lower() == "goldenseal" and (table.contains(stack, k) or string.starts(k, "unweavingm") or k == "horror")) or (herb:lower() == "ginseng" and (table.contains(stack, k) or string.starts(k, "unweavingb"))) or (herb:lower() ~= "goldenseal" and herb:lower() ~= "ginseng" and table.contains(stack, k)) then count = count + 1 end if count == amount then return true end end
return false end

Script.name: changeHandlePriorities
Script.script:
function changeHandlePriorities(curativeName, action, type) local foundHandles = {}
-- Iterate through the afflictions to find handles for the specified curative for afflictionName, details in pairs(afflictions) do -- Check if the current affliction has a name matching the curativeName if details.name == curativeName then for _, cure in ipairs(details.cures) do -- Accessing cures -- Store handles by type foundHandles[cure.type] = foundHandles[cure.type] or {} table.insert(foundHandles[cure.type], {handle = cure.handle, name = details.name}) --cecho("<green>Found handle: " .. cure.handle .. " for " .. curativeName .. "<green>\n") end end end
-- Check if we found any handles if next(foundHandles) == nil then cecho("<red>No handles found for curative '" .. curativeName .. "'!<red>\n")
-- Link to reopen main priority list cechoLink( "[Priority List]", function() curativePriorityList(type) end, "open main priority list", true )
echo "\n" return else cecho("\n<green>Handles for curative '" .. curativeName .. "':<green>\n")
-- Link to reopen main priority list cechoLink( "[Priority List]", function() curativePriorityList(type) end, "open main priority list", true )
echo "\n" end
-- Print the handles and their clickable options for each type for handleType, handles in pairs(foundHandles) do for _, handleData in ipairs(handles) do local handle = handleData.handle local name = handleData.name
cecho("\n<white>Handle: [" .. handleType .. "] " .. handle .. " for " .. name .. "<white>\n")
-- Link to raise the handle value cechoLink( "[Raise]", function() changeHandlePriority(name, "raise", handleType) end, "Raise Handle for " .. name, true )
echo " "
-- Link to lower the handle value cechoLink( "[Lower]", function() changeHandlePriority(name, "lower", handleType) end, "Lower Handle for " .. name, true )
echo "\n" end end end
function changeHandlePriority(curativeName, action, type) local found = false
-- Iterate through the afflictions to find the specified curative for afflictionName, details in pairs(afflictions) do if details.name == curativeName then for _, cure in ipairs(details.cures) do if cure.type == type then found = true if action == "raise" then -- Raise handle decreases the value (but no lower than 1) cure.handle = math.max((cure.handle or 1) - 1, 1) cecho("\n<green>Handle for " .. curativeName .. " raised to " .. cure.handle .. "<green>\n") elseif action == "lower" then -- Lower handle increases the value (but no higher than 100) cure.handle = math.min((cure.handle or 1) + 1, 100) cecho("\n<red>Handle for " .. curativeName .. " lowered to " .. cure.handle .. "<red>\n") end break end end if found then break end -- Exit the outer loop if found end end
if not found then cecho("\n<red>Curative '" .. curativeName .. "' not found for type '" .. type .. "'!<red>\n") return end
--saveTableToJSON(afflictions, PLAYER:myclass() .. "prios") saveTableToJSON(afflictions, "afflictions")
-- Refresh the display after changing handle priority changeHandlePriorities(curativeName, "refresh", type)
end

Script.name: curativePriorityList
Script.script:
function curativePriorityList(type) -- Debugging: Print the type received cecho("\n<green>Type Received: " .. type .. "<green>\n")
local foundCuratives = {}
-- Iterate through the afflictions to find matching types for afflictionName, details in pairs(afflictions) do for _, cure in ipairs(details.cures) do if cure.type == type then table.insert(foundCuratives, { name = details.name, priority = details.priority or 0 }) end end end
if #foundCuratives == 0 then cecho("\n<red>No curatives found for type '" .. type .. "'!<red>\n") return else cecho("\n<green>Found curatives for type '" .. type .. "':<green>\n") end
-- Sort the found curatives by priority and name table.sort(foundCuratives, function(a, b) if a.priority == b.priority then return a.name < b.name else return a.priority < b.priority end end)
-- --- NEW LAYOUT LOGIC START --- local function col2() moveCursor("main", 0, getLastLineNumber() - 1) moveCursorEnd("main") local curLine = getCurrentLine() local targetColumn = 35 -- Adjust this if the columns overlap local padding = targetColumn - #curLine if padding > 0 then cecho(string.rep(" ", padding)) end cecho("<white>|| ") end
local count = 0 for _, curativeData in ipairs(foundCuratives) do count = count + 1 local curative = curativeData.name local priority = curativeData.priority
-- [Raise] Button cechoLink("<green>[+]", function() changeCurativePriority(curative, "raise", type) end, "Raise Priority", true) echo(" ")
-- [Lower] Button cechoLink("<red>[-]", function() changeCurativePriority(curative, "lower", type) end, "Lower Priority", true)
-- Priority and Name cecho(" <white>[<green>" .. priority .. "<white>] " .. curative)
-- Handle Button cechoLink(" <DarkSlateGray>(h)", function() changeHandlePriorities(curative, "refresh", type) end, "Open handles", true)
-- Determine if we move to column 2 or end the row if count % 2 == 1 then col2() else echo("\n") end end
-- Ensure we finish the last line if there's an odd number of items if count % 2 ~= 0 then echo("\n") end -- --- NEW LAYOUT LOGIC END --- end
function changeCurativePriority(curativeName, action, type) local curativeFound = false
-- Iterate through all afflictions to find the matching curative for afflictionName, details in pairs(afflictions) do for _, cure in ipairs(details.cures) do -- Accessing the cures if cure.type == type and details.name == curativeName then curativeFound = true if action == "raise" then -- Raise priority decreases the value (but no lower than 1) details.priority = math.max((details.priority or 1) - 1, 1) cecho("\n<green>Priority for " .. curativeName .. " raised to " .. details.priority .. "<green>\n") elseif action == "lower" then -- Lower priority increases the value (but no higher than 26) details.priority = math.min((details.priority or 1) + 1, 26) cecho("\n<red>Priority for " .. curativeName .. " lowered to " .. details.priority .. "<red>\n") end send("curing prio "..curativeName.." "..details.priority) break end end if curativeFound then break end end
if not curativeFound then cecho("\n<red>Curative '" .. curativeName .. "' not found for type '" .. type .. "'!<red>\n") return end
-- Optionally save the updated curative list saveTableToJSON(curinglist, "curinglist")
saveTableToJSON(afflictions, "afflictions")
-- Define the base directory for the C: drive --saveTableToJSON(afflictions, PLAYER:myclass() .. "prios")
-- Refresh the display after changing priority curativePriorityList(type)
end

Script.name: displayDefenses
Script.script:
function displayDefenses(displayType)
-- Defensive failsafe: Reinitialize if defenses table is empty or invalid if not defenses or next(defenses) == nil or (getmetatable(defenses) and getmetatable(defenses).__jsontype == "array") then cecho("\n<red>Your defenses table was empty or corrupted. Reinitializing with default settings...")
-- Reload default defenses initializeDefensiveTable("save")
local profileName = gmcp.Char.Status and gmcp.Char.Status.name or "Unknown" local backupPath = string.format("C:\\Users\\Owner\\.config\\mudlet\\profiles\\%s\\Achaean System\\system\\libs\\backup", profileName)
cecho(string.format("\n<yellow>A backup copy of your original defenses may be available at:\n<white>%s\n", backupPath)) end
-- Validate displayType argument if displayType ~= "keepups" and displayType ~= "defups" then return end
-- Normalize `displayType` if displayType == "defups" then displayType = "enabled" elseif displayType == "keepups" then displayType = "keepup" end
echo("\n")
local columnWidth = 30 -- Adjust the width as needed local columnCount = 3 -- Number of columns to display local rowIndex = 0 -- Tracks the current row index
--------------------------------------------------------- -- 🥋 DYNAMIC MONK SUBCLASS SKILL FILTER --------------------------------------------------------- local currentClass = PLAYER:myclass() local baseSkills = {}
if currentClass == "monk" then -- Refresh subclass detection state ("tekura" or "shikudo") updateMonkSubclass()
-- Pull your core monk skills (kaido, telepathy) if they are registered in skillTreeList if skillTreeList["monk"] then for _, skill in ipairs(skillTreeList["monk"]) do if skill ~= "tekura" and skill ~= "shikudo" then table.insert(baseSkills, skill) end end end -- Inject the isolated valid subclass tree type dynamically table.insert(baseSkills, monkSubclass) else -- Default behavior for all other classes baseSkills = skillTreeList[currentClass] or {} end
-- Combine the filtered base class skills with generic defenses local list = table.n_union(baseSkills, {"vision", "free", "survival", "herb", "salve", "smoke", "resistance"})
-- Create tables to store defenses categorized by their types local categorizedDefenses = {}
-- Categorize defenses that are in the `list` for category, details in pairs(defenses) do -- Check if details.type is a string or a table if type(details.type) == "table" then -- Loop through each value in details.type if it's a table for _, defenseType in ipairs(details.type) do if table.contains(list, defenseType) then categorizedDefenses[defenseType] = categorizedDefenses[defenseType] or {} table.insert(categorizedDefenses[defenseType], details) end end else -- If details.type is a string, simply check and categorize it if table.contains(list, details.type) then categorizedDefenses[details.type] = categorizedDefenses[details.type] or {} table.insert(categorizedDefenses[details.type], details) end end end
-- Iterate over each defense type and its associated defenses for index, defenseTypeName in ipairs(list) do local defenseType = defenseTypeName local defenseList = categorizedDefenses[defenseType]
if defenseList then -- Add a single blank line before each section (except the first one) if index > 1 then echo("\n") end
-- Display the defense type as a header echo(defenseType:title() .. ":\n")
-- Reset row index for this section rowIndex = 0
-- Iterate over each defense in the defense list for _, details in ipairs(defenseList) do -- Adjust row and column if rowIndex % columnCount == 0 and rowIndex > 0 then echo("\n") -- Move to the next row after completing a set of columns end
-- Display opening bracket setFgColor(0, 150, 150) echo("[")
-- Display defense icon based on `displayType` and `details` if details[displayType] then if details.drain == "mana" then setFgColor(0, 0, 255) cechoLink("M", function() executeDefenseFunction(details, displayType) end, details.name, true) elseif details.drain == "endurance" then setFgColor(0, 255, 0) cechoLink("E", function() executeDefenseFunction(details, displayType) end, details.name, true) else setFgColor(255, 255, 255) cechoLink("X", function() executeDefenseFunction(details, displayType) end, details.name, true) end else setFgColor(200, 200, 200) cechoLink(" ", function() executeDefenseFunction(details, displayType) end, details.name, true) end
-- Display closing bracket setFgColor(0, 150, 150) echo("] ")
-- Display defense name setFgColor(200, 200, 200) echo(details.name)
-- Add padding to align columns local padding = columnWidth - utf8.len(details.name) - 10 echo(string.rep(" ", math.max(padding, 0)))
-- Increment row index rowIndex = 1 + rowIndex end
-- Ensure proper spacing between sections if getCurrentLine ~= "" then echo("\n") -- Add a new line at the end of a section end end
end echo"\n" end
function executeDefenseFunction(details, displayType) local data = details local logMsg = "" -- Temporary holder to prevent the UI from burying our text
if displayType == "keepup" or displayType == "enabled" then if data[displayType] then data[displayType] = false send("CURING PRIORITY DEFENCE " .. data.name .. " RESET") logMsg = string.format("\n<white>%s removed for %s (Server-side Reset Sent)", displayType:title(), data.name) send(data.relax) else data.keepup = true data.enabled = true
local targetPri = setDefensePrios(data.name) send("CURING PRIORITY DEFENCE " .. data.name .. " " .. targetPri) logMsg = string.format("\n<white>%s added for %s (Server-side Priority: %s)", displayType:title(), data.name, targetPri) end end
-- Save changes to your client profile database saveTableToJSON(defenses, "defenses")
-- Normalize and update UI windows (This redraws the whole grid) if displayType == "enabled" then displayDefenses("defups") elseif displayType == "keepup" then displayDefenses("keepups") end
-- NOW print the message so it sits safely underneath the updated UI grid if logMsg ~= "" then cecho(logMsg .. "\n") end end
function updateMonkSubclass() if not (gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals and gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats) then return end
local foundKata = false for _, statLine in ipairs(gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats) do if string.find(statLine, "Kata:") then foundKata = true break end end
if foundKata then monkSubclass = "shikudo" else monkSubclass = "tekura" end end

Script.name: setDefensePrios
Script.script:
function setDefensePrios(name) -- Normalize name input to prevent casing mismatch bugs local targetName = tostring(name):lower():trim()
-- Target the defense data directly out of your master table local defData = defenses[targetName]
if not defData then -- Safe fallback value if the defense data block is corrupted or missing return 25 end
-- 1. Check for the Speed exception rule if targetName == "speed" then defData.priority = 1 return defData.priority end
-- 2. Verify cooldown tracker sub-table exists to prevent nil string indexing errors if not defData.cooldown or type(defData.cooldown) ~= "table" then defData.priority = 25 return defData.priority end
-- Localize table hits to keep the execution blazing fast local hasEq = table.contains(defData.cooldown, "equilibrium") local hasBal = table.contains(defData.cooldown, "balance")
-- 3. Calculate server priority based on physical cooldown locks if table.contains(defData.cooldown, "free") or table.contains(defData.cooldown, "herb") or table.contains(defData.cooldown, "salve") or table.contains(defData.cooldown, "smoke") then defData.priority = 22
-- PRIORITY 23: Requires EITHER equilibrium OR balance, but NOT BOTH elseif (hasEq or hasBal) and not (hasEq and hasBal) then defData.priority = 23
-- PRIORITY 24: Requires BOTH equilibrium AND balance elseif hasEq and hasBal then defData.priority = 24
else defData.priority = 25 -- Catch-all baseline end
return defData.priority end

") ln_count = nil local count = 0 table.sort(worn_items) for _, v in ipairs(worn_items) do local name = v if match[3] then if string.find(v, match[3]:trim()) then cecho(string.format("<white>*<grey>(")) setUnderline(true) echoLink( string.format("%s", rpad(worn_table[name], 6)), [[appendCmdLine("]] .. worn_table[name] .. [[")]], "Append to Command line", true ) resetFormat() cecho(string.format(") %s
", name)) end else if #name >= 34 then name = truncate(v, 34) else name = v end count = count + 1 cecho(string.format("<white>*<grey> %s", align(name, {width = 38, alignment = 'left'}))) end if count == 2 then echo("
") count = 0 end end if inventory.pager['held'] and table.size(inventory.pager['held']) <= 1 then inventory.pager = nil inventory.page_command = nil send('show gold', false) end end

-- Table functions
function len(t) -- Count the items in a table local count count = 0 for ii, xx in pairs(t) do count = count + 1 end -- for return count end
-- tcount
function __genOrderedIndex(t) -- Generates index for ordering a table -- DO NOT CALL THIS FUNCTION local orderedIndex = {} for key in pairs(t) do table.insert(orderedIndex, key) end table.sort(orderedIndex) return orderedIndex end
-- genOrderedIndex
function orderedNext(t, state) -- Same as 'next' function, except returns the keys in the alphabetic order if state == nil then --generate index t.__orderedIndex = __genOrderedIndex(t) key = t.__orderedIndex[1] return key, t[key] end key = nil for i = 1, table.getn(t.__orderedIndex) do if t.__orderedIndex[i] == state then key = t.__orderedIndex[i + 1] end end if key then return key, t[key] end t.__orderedIndex = nil return end
-- orderedNext
function orderedPairs(t) -- Call THIS function return orderedNext, t, nil end
-- orderedPairs -- String functions
function trim(s) -- from PiL2 20.4 return (s:gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")) end
function pack2(...) return {n = select('#', ...), ...} end
function unpack2(t) return unpack(t, 1, t.n) end
rpad = function(str, len, char) if char == nil then char = ' ' end return string.rep(char, len - #str) .. str end
function truncate(s, num) return string.format("%s...", string.sub(s, 1, num)) end
-- Alignment
function align(str, options) --str is a string, options is a table --[[ If they sent anything but a table as the second argument, return useful info. But if they didn't send a second argument then that's ok, the defaults will be enough to get by and just center the txt ]] -- if (type(options) ~= "table") and (options ~= nil) then return "You call this with align(\"some text to format\", <table of options>. Pls check comments for what options and usage information" end options = options or {} --if they sent options, don't overwrite them options.width = options.width or 80 --default line length of 80 options.alignment = options.alignment or "center" --if we don't specify, it's centered options.cap = options.cap or "" --default endcap of nothing (an empty string, technically) options.spacer = options.spacer or " " --default spacer is.. well.. space options.inside = options.inside or false --by default, when centering, formation as spacers|cap|text|cap|spacers if not options.mirror == false then options.mirror = options.mirror or true end --by default, we do want to use mirroring for the caps local strLen = string.len(str) local leftCap = options.cap local rightCap = options.cap local leftPadLen = math.floor((options.width - strLen) / 2, 1) - 1 local rightPadLen = leftPadLen + ((options.width - strLen) % 2) local maxPad = 0 local capLen = string.len(options.cap) if capLen > leftPadLen then --if the cap is bigger than the left total padding options.cap = options.cap:sub(1, leftPadLen) -- trim it up right! capLen = string.len(options.cap) end --otherwise, don't mess with it if options.alignment == "center" then --we're going to center something leftPadLen = math.floor((options.width - strLen) / 2, 1) - 1 --get the padding needed on the left rightPadLen = leftPadLen + ((options.width - strLen) % 2) --and on the right if options.mirror then --if we're reversing the left cap and the right cap (IE {{[[ turns into ]]}} ) rightCap = string.gsub(rightCap, "<", ">") rightCap = string.gsub(rightCap, "%[", "%]") rightCap = string.gsub(rightCap, "{", "}") rightCap = string.gsub(rightCap, "%(", "%)") rightCap = string.reverse(rightCap) end --otherwise, they'll be the same, so don't do anything str = string.format(" %s ", str) elseif options.alignment == "right" then --we'll right-align the text leftPadLen = options.width - strLen - 1 rightPadLen = 0 rightCap = "" str = string.format(" %s", str) else --Ok, so if it's not center or right, we assume it's left. We don't do justified. Sorry. leftPadLen = 0 rightPadLen = options.width - strLen - 1 leftCap = "" str = string.format("%s ", str) end --that's it, took care of both left, right, and center formattings, now to output the durn thing. if options.inside then --if we're placing the repated spacer inside --"=====endcap some text endcap=====" --"=====endcap some text pacdne=====" --"=================endcap some text" --"some text endcap=================" return leftCap .. string.rep(options.spacer, (leftPadLen - capLen)) .. str .. string.rep(options.spacer, (rightPadLen - capLen)) .. rightCap else --otherwise, it''s be the spaces on the 'inside' -- "endcap===== some text =====endcap" -- "endcap===== some text =====pacdne" -- "endcap================= some text" -- "some text =================endcap" return string.rep(options.spacer, (leftPadLen - capLen)) .. leftCap .. str .. rightCap .. string.rep(options.spacer, (rightPadLen - capLen)) end end
