Script.name: tattoos
Script.script:
-- ============================================================================= -- TATTOO MANAGEMENT SYSTEM -- =============================================================================
-- Global tracking variables tatQ = tatQ or {} inking = inking or false tattoos = tattoos or {} settings = settings or {} if settings.systemPaused == nil then settings.systemPaused = false end
function initializeTattooSettings() -- Define every tattoo that SHOULD appear in the menu local allTattoos = { "a bell tattoo", "a boar tattoo", "a brazier tattoo", "a chameleon tattoo", "a cloak tattoo", "a crystal tattoo", "a feather tattoo", "a firefly tattoo", "a hammer tattoo", "an hourglass tattoo", "a megalith tattoo", "a mindseye tattoo", "a moon tattoo", "a moss tattoo", "a prism tattoo", "a shield tattoo", "a starburst tattoo", "a tentacle tattoo", "a tree tattoo", "a web tattoo", "an ox tattoo" }
-- Only set them to false if they don't exist yet -- This prevents wiping your current [X] marks tattooSettings = tattooSettings or {} for _, name in ipairs(allTattoos) do if tattooSettings[name] == nil then tattooSettings[name] = false end end end
function getTattooCharges(name) if not tattoos or #tattoos == 0 then return "0" end
local total = 0 local isPermanent = false
for _, slot in ipairs(tattoos) do if slot.name == name then if type(slot.charges) == "number" then total = total + slot.charges elseif slot.charges == "n/a" or slot.charges == "∞" then isPermanent = true end end end
return isPermanent and "∞" or tostring(total) end
function displayTattooMenu() -- 1. Safety Checks if not tattooSettings then cecho("\n<red>Error: tattooSettings not initialized!") return end
local currentCount = 0 for _, enabled in pairs(tattooSettings) do if enabled then currentCount = currentCount + 1 end end
local maxSlots = getMyTotalSlots()
cecho("<white>Looking over yourself, you see the following tattoos:") echo("\n") cecho("<white>Presets: [ ") cechoLink("<green>Hunting", function() setTattooPreset("hunting") end, "Load Hunting Set", true) cecho("<white> | ") cechoLink("<red>Combat", function() setTattooPreset("combat") end, "Load Combat/Raiding Set", true) cecho("<white> ]\n")
local color = currentCount >= maxSlots and "<orange>" or "<DarkSlateGrey>" --cecho(color .. "Tattoo Management [" .. currentCount .. "/" .. maxSlots .. " Slots Used]:\n")
-- 2. Sort keys for a consistent menu local keys = {} for k in pairs(tattooSettings) do table.insert(keys, k) end table.sort(keys)
local count = 0 for _, fullName in ipairs(keys) do local isActive = tattooSettings[fullName] local baseName = fullName:gsub("^an? ", ""):gsub(" tattoo$", ""):title()
-- Use the helper to get charges from the 'tattoos' table local charges = getTattooCharges(fullName) local displayName = string.format("%s [%s]", baseName, charges)
-- Draw checkbox setFgColor(0, 150, 150) echo("[") if isActive then setFgColor(255, 255, 255) cechoLink("X", function() toggleTattoo(fullName) end, "Disable " .. baseName, true) else setFgColor(100, 100, 100) cechoLink(" ", function() toggleTattoo(fullName) end, "Enable " .. baseName, true) end setFgColor(0, 150, 150) echo("] ")
-- Draw Name and Charges setFgColor(200, 200, 200) echo(displayName)
-- Padding logic: Ensure display name isn't nil before checking length local len = (displayName and utf8.len(displayName)) or 0 echo(string.rep(" ", math.max(1, 24 - len)))
count = count + 1 if count % 3 == 0 then echo("\n") end end
--echo("\n") if currentCount > 0 then cechoLink("<white>(click here to apply) ", function() expandAlias("fixtats") end, "Start Tattooing", true) --cecho("<cyan>Run 'fixtats' to begin inking/wiping.") else cecho("<red>Select tattoos above to begin.") end echo("\n") send("") end
function toggleTattoo(name) local currentCount = 0 for _, enabled in pairs(tattooSettings) do if enabled then currentCount = currentCount + 1 end end
local maxSlots = getMyTotalSlots()
if not tattooSettings[name] then if currentCount >= maxSlots then cecho("\n<red>!! MAX SLOTS REACHED (" .. maxSlots .. "/" .. maxSlots .. ") !!") return end tattooSettings[name] = true else tattooSettings[name] = false end
displayTattooMenu() end
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Utility: Table to String (Debugging) -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- function table.tostring(tbl, level) level = level or 1 local str = "{\n" for k, v in pairs(tbl) do str = str .. string.rep(" ", level) str = str .. "[" .. tostring(k) .. "] = " if type(v) == "table" then str = str .. table.tostring(v, level + 1) elseif type(v) == "string" then str = str .. '"' .. v .. '",\n' else str = str .. tostring(v) .. ",\n" end end str = str .. string.rep(" ", level - 1) .. "}" if level == 1 then str = str .. "\n" end return str end
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Command Executor: inkTattoo -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- function inkTattoo() if #tatQ > 0 and not inking then local tattoo = tatQ[1] if tattoo then send(tattoo) inking = true table.remove(tatQ, 1) end end end
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Main Logic: processTattoos -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- function processTattoos() tatQ = {} local availableEmptySlots = {} local currentTattoosOnBody = {} local missingTattoos = {} local unwantedTattoos = {} local tattoosToWipe = {}
-- --- MEDITATION & PRE-INK CHECK --- if settings.meditating then settings.meditating = false settings.fullwillandmana = true send("stand") send("curing insomnia on") end
-- Build the optimal list from your menu settings local optimalList = {} for fullName, enabled in pairs(tattooSettings) do if enabled then table.insert(optimalList, fullName) end end
local tatConvert = { ["a mindseye tattoo"] = "mindseye", ["a boar tattoo"] = "boar", ["a tree tattoo"] = "tree", ["a cloak tattoo"] = "cloak", ["a starburst tattoo"] = "starburst", ["a moon tattoo"] = "moon", ["a shield tattoo"] = "shield", ["a moss tattoo"] = "moss", ["a bell tattoo"] = "bell", ["a web tattoo"] = "web", ["a brazier tattoo"] = "brazier", ["a firefly tattoo"] = "firefly", ["a feather tattoo"] = "feather", ["a hammer tattoo"] = "hammer", ["a crystal tattoo"] = "crystal", ["a tentacle tattoo"] = "tentacle", ["a chameleon tattoo"] = "chameleon", ["a prism tattoo"] = "prism", ["a megalith tattoo"] = "megalith", ["a hourglass tattoo"] = "hourglass", ["an ox tattoo"] = "ox", ["<empty>"] = "empty" }
-- PASS 1: Categorize every individual slot on your body for _, slot in ipairs(tattoos) do local isLowCharge = false
if type(slot.charges) == "number" and slot.charges <= 5 then if slot.name ~= "a starburst tattoo" then isLowCharge = true end end
if slot.name == "<empty>" then table.insert(availableEmptySlots, slot.part) elseif isLowCharge then -- LOW CHARGE: Mark for wipe table.insert(tattoosToWipe, {name = slot.name, part = slot.part}) cecho("\n<orange>!! Low Charges: Marking " .. slot.name .. " for wipe (" .. slot.charges .. " left).") elseif not tattooSettings[slot.name] then -- UNCHECKED in menu: Mark for wipe table.insert(tattoosToWipe, {name = slot.name, part = slot.part}) else -- VALID: Keep it table.insert(currentTattoosOnBody, slot.name) end end
-- PASS 2: Determine what is missing for _, requiredTat in ipairs(optimalList) do if not table.contains(currentTattoosOnBody, requiredTat) then table.insert(missingTattoos, requiredTat) end end
-- --- PASS 3: QUEUE COMMANDS --- local commands = {}
-- 3A. Process Wipes (and recover those slots immediately) for _, wipeTarget in ipairs(tattoosToWipe) do local shortName = tatConvert[wipeTarget.name] if shortName then table.insert(commands, "wipe off " .. shortName)
-- THE FIX: Put the limb back into the available pool table.insert(availableEmptySlots, wipeTarget.part) end end
-- 3B. Process Inks for _, missingTat in ipairs(missingTattoos) do -- Check the pool (which now includes the limbs we just queued for wiping) local targetPart = table.remove(availableEmptySlots, 1) if targetPart then local tattooID = tatConvert[missingTat] if tattooID then table.insert(commands, "ink " .. tattooID .. " on " .. targetPart .. " of me") end else -- If we still don't have a slot, we are actually full. cecho("\n<red>!! No slots available for " .. missingTat .. " !!") end end
-- --- EXECUTION --- for _, cmd in ipairs(commands) do table.insert(tatQ, cmd) end
if #tatQ > 0 then if not settings.systemPaused then settings.systemPaused = true send("curing off") cecho("\n<red>System Paused: Handling Tattoos.") end inkTattoo() else cecho("\n<green>Tattoos: Everything is already optimal.") end end
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Event Handler: onInkingComplete -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- function onInkingComplete() inking = false
local isWipe = line:find("disappears") local finishedTat = nil
-- Capture the name if it exists in the trigger matches if matches and (matches[2] or matches[4]) then finishedTat = matches[2] or matches[4] end
-- Handle Touching (Only if it wasn't a wipe) if finishedTat and not isWipe then finishedTat = finishedTat:gsub("a ", ""):gsub(" tattoo", "")
local tats2ignore = { "talon", "shield", "crystal", "tree", "chameleon", "hammer", "firefly", "tentacle", "web", "hourglass", "brazier", "moss", "boar", "moon", "starburst", "bell", "cloak", "mindseye", "megalith" }
if not table.contains(tats2ignore, finishedTat) then send("touch " .. finishedTat) end end
-- THE FIX: Check the queue length BEFORE unpausing if #tatQ > 0 then -- If there are more commands (like the 'ink' command after a 'wipe'), keep going! inkTattoo() else -- ONLY unpause if the queue is truly empty if settings.systemPaused then settings.systemPaused = false send("curing on") cecho("\n<green>System Unpaused: All tattooing tasks complete.") end end end
function setTattooPreset(type) -- 1. Wipe current selections to start fresh for name, _ in pairs(tattooSettings) do tattooSettings[name] = false end
local maxSlots = getMyTotalSlots()
-- 2. Define the lists local coreKits = {"a tree tattoo", "a mindseye tattoo", "a moss tattoo", "a shield tattoo", "a starburst tattoo", "a boar tattoo"}
local presets = { hunting = {"a firefly tattoo", "a crystal tattoo", "a moon tattoo", "an ox tattoo", "a bell tattoo"}, combat = {"a megalith tattoo", "a cloak tattoo", "a tentacle tattoo", "a web tattoo", "a brazier tattoo"} }
-- Helper to count currently checked items local function countActive() local active = 0 for _, val in pairs(tattooSettings) do if val then active = active + 1 end end return active end
-- 3. Apply Core Tattoos first for _, name in ipairs(coreKits) do if countActive() < maxSlots then tattooSettings[name] = true end end
-- 4. Apply the specific Preset Fillers local kit = presets[type] if kit then for _, name in ipairs(kit) do if countActive() < maxSlots then tattooSettings[name] = true end end cecho("\n<green>Tattoo Preset Loaded: " .. type:upper()) else cecho("\n<red>Error: Preset '" .. tostring(type) .. "' not found.") end
-- 5. Force a menu refresh to show the new [X] marks displayTattooMenu() end
function getMyTotalSlots() -- Defaulting to 11 if the table is empty for some reason. return (tattoos and #tattoos > 0) and #tattoos or 11 end

Script.name: roomFindEchoArea
Script.script:
function mmp.roomFindEchoArea(query) if query:ends('.') then query = query:sub(1, -2) end
local result = mmp.searchRoom(query) if not next(result) then return end
local roomsTable = {}
-- Build roomsTable with area data for roomID, roomName in pairs(result) do local areaID = getRoomArea(roomID) -- Get the area ID from the room ID local roomArea = areaID and mmp.areatabler[areaID] or "Unknown Area" table.insert(roomsTable, {num = tonumber(roomID), area = roomArea, name = roomName}) end
-- Sort roomsTable by area name table.sort(roomsTable, function(a, b) return a.area < b.area end)
for _, roomData in ipairs(roomsTable) do roomID = roomData.num roomName = roomData.name roomArea = roomData.area end
cechoLink( string.format("\n <DarkSlateGray>[ <%s>%s <DarkSlateGray>]","white", roomArea), string.format([[mmp.gotoRoom(%d)]], roomID), string.format("Go to %s in %s", roomName, roomArea), true )
end
function mmp.roomFindEchoNumber(query) if query:ends('.') then query = query:sub(1, -2) end
local result = mmp.searchRoom(query) if not next(result) then return end
local roomsTable = {}
-- Build roomsTable with area data for roomID, roomName in pairs(result) do local areaID = getRoomArea(roomID) -- Get the area ID from the room ID local roomArea = areaID and mmp.areatabler[areaID] or "Unknown Area" table.insert(roomsTable, {num = tonumber(roomID), area = roomArea, name = roomName}) end
-- Sort roomsTable by area name table.sort(roomsTable, function(a, b) return a.area < b.area end)
for _, roomData in ipairs(roomsTable) do roomID = roomData.num roomName = roomData.name roomArea = roomData.area end
cechoLink( --string.format("\n <DarkSlateGray>[ <%s>%s <DarkSlateGray>]","white", roomArea), string.format([[mmp.gotoRoom(%d)]], roomID), --string.format("Go to %s in %s", roomName, roomArea), true )
end
function mmp.getAreaNameFromQuery(query) if query:ends('.') then query = query:sub(1, -2) end
local result = mmp.searchRoom(query) if not next(result) then -- cecho("<red>No results found for query: " .. query .. "\n") return "Unknown Area" end
-- Iterate through the rooms found by the query for roomID, _ in pairs(result) do local areaID = getRoomArea(roomID)
-- Debugging output to check the room ID and area ID --cecho("<yellow>Room ID: " .. roomID .. ", Area ID: " .. tostring(areaID) .. "\n")
if areaID then -- Debugging to check the area name local areaName = mmp.areatabler[areaID] -- cecho("<green>Area Name: " .. tostring(areaName) .. "\n") return areaName or "Unknown Area" end end
return "Unknown Area" -- Fallback if no valid area found end
function mmp.getRoomNumber(query) if query:ends('.') then query = query:sub(1, -2) end
local result = mmp.searchRoom(query) if not next(result) then return end
local roomsTable = {}
-- Build roomsTable with area data for roomID, roomName in pairs(result) do local areaID = getRoomArea(roomID) -- Get the area ID from the room ID local roomArea = areaID and mmp.areatabler[areaID] or "Unknown Area" table.insert(roomsTable, {num = tonumber(roomID), area = roomArea, name = roomName}) end
-- Sort roomsTable by area name table.sort(roomsTable, function(a, b) return a.area < b.area end)
for _, roomData in ipairs(roomsTable) do roomID = roomData.num if roomID then return roomID end end
return "Unknown Room Number"
end
-- Function to find the room associated with a person's name function findRoomByPerson(personName) -- Iterate through areas for areaName, locations in pairs(groupedByArea) do -- Iterate through locations in each area for _, locationData in ipairs(locations) do -- Check if the person exists in the 'people' list if table.contains(locationData.people, personName) then return locationData.room -- Return room ID if found end end end return "room not found" -- Return a default value if person is not found end

Script.name: getClickableLink
Script.script:
function mmp.getClickableLink(room, area)
--display(room)
-- Perform the same search and filtering steps local t = mmp.searchRoomExact(room) if area then t = mmp.filterRooms(t, area) end
-- Prepare the result local result = " (" mmp.echonums(room, area) result = result .. ")"
-- Lowercase results for k, v in pairs(t) do if tonumber(k) then t[k] = v:lower() else t[k:lower()] = v end end
if not (t[room:lower()] or table.contains(t, room:lower())) then return result end
result = result .. "\n"
-- If only one match, return the formatted clickable link if table.size(t) == 1 then local k, v = next(t) result = result .. "<red>From your knowledge, that room is in <orange_red>" .. mmp.cleanAreaName(mmp.areatabler[getRoomArea(type(k) == "number" and k or v)] or "?") .. "<red>." else -- If multiple matches, provide all the possible areas local k, v = next(t) local areas = {} if type(k) == "number" then for k, _ in pairs(t) do areas[mmp.areatabler[getRoomArea(k)] or "?"] = true end else for _, k in pairs(t) do areas[mmp.areatabler[getRoomArea(k)] or "?"] = true end end local flattened_areas = {} for k, _ in pairs(areas) do if k ~= "" then flattened_areas[#flattened_areas + 1] = mmp.cleanAreaName(k) end end result = result .. "<red>From your knowledge, that room might be in <orange_red>" .. table.concat(flattened_areas, ", or ") .. "<red>." end
-- Return the final result with the clickable link return result end

Key.name: huntToggle
Key.script:
expandAlias("mstop")
-- State 1: We are totally off -> Turn on Manual Hunting if not hunting then toggleHuntingMode("manual") -- autohunting is already false, no need to touch it
-- State 2: Manual is on, Auto is off -> Turn on Auto Hunting elseif hunting and not autohunting then toggleHuntingMode("auto")
-- State 3: Both are on -> Turn everything completely off else -- If hunting is true, calling 'manual' turns it false toggleHuntingMode("manual") -- If autohunting is true, calling 'auto' turns it false toggleHuntingMode("auto") end
